Exploration mode offers the chance to take control of Hello Kitty and explore a 3D city, complete with streets, buildings, shops, neighborhood characters, and public transportation that Hello Kitty can ride. Different locations within the city will trigger a variety of mini-games for Hello Kitty to play. Completing these mini-games will earn friendship points which Hello Kitty can then use to ride the bus or train, purchase new outfits and items, decorate and customize her apartment, and progress in her journey. In order to keep her friends happy, Hello Kitty will have to stay in touch by checking her mail frequently.

Game.Name: Hello Kitty: Birthday Adventures
Game.Overview:
Help Hello Kitty find the perfect birthday presents!
Collect stamps and stickers for Hello Kitty's birthday book by playing mini-games, helping friends, and finding special objects. By winning the mini-games you will get hints for birthday gifts. Attend special holiday parties throughout the year. Deliver birthday presents to your favorite Sanrio Characters.
Features
â€¢ Spend time visiting friends, hanging out, and shopping for gifts in 5 different locations: Central Square, Forest, Grassy Hill, Main Street, and Downtown â€¢ Includes many Sario Characters â€¢ Over 100 mini-game styles: varies for each character or goal â€¢ Fully realized Hello Kitty world â€¢ Blow out the birthday candles using the DS microphone

Game.Name: Hello Kitty: Daily
Game.Overview: The new Hello Kitty title presents an easy way to manage modern day lives spent on the go and has all the tools necessary for young Hello Kitty fans to learn time management and get organized. Hello Kitty Daily is ideal for managing busy schedules, storing friendsâ€™ contact information, taking notes, keeping track of spending money and even improving efficiency, all with the unique style that Hello Kitty is known for around the world

Game.Name: Hello Kitty no Gotouchi Collection: Koi no DokiDoki Travel
Game.Overview: Hello Kitty no Gotouchi Collection: Koi no DokiDoki Trouble is an Action game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Hello Kitty no Oshare Party: Sanrio Character Zukan DS
Game.Overview:
Hello Kitty no Oshare Party: Sanrio Character Zukan DS (Japanese: ãƒãƒ­ãƒ¼ã‚­ãƒ†ã‚£ã®ãŠã—ã‚ƒã‚Œãƒ‘ãƒ¼ãƒ†ã‚£ãƒ¼: ã‚µãƒ³ãƒªã‚ªã‚­ãƒ£ãƒ©ã‚¯ã‚¿ãƒ¼ãšã‹ã‚“ï¼¤ï¼³), is a video game for Nintendo DS produced by FromSoftware, Inc. It was only released in Japan.
The name of the game translates as Hello Kitty's Smartly Dressed Party The game has a detailed illustrated encyclopedia, which documents over 300 Sanrio characters and brands. The game also has a dress-up feature where players can dress-up Hello Kitty. The player can choose to buy new clothes and accessories using points.
Points can be earned by playing minigames, including "Sanrio Quiz" (Japanese: ã‚µãƒ³ãƒªã‚ªã‚¯ã‚¤ã‚º), "Memory Game" (Japanese: ããŠãã‚Šã‚‡ãã‚²ãƒ¼ãƒ ), "Calculation Game" (Japanese: ã‘ã„ã•ã‚“ã‚²ãƒ¼ãƒ ), Spot the Difference (Japanese: ã¾ã¡ãŒã„ã•ãŒã—) and "Jigsaw Puzzle" (Japanese: ã‚¸ã‚°ã‚½ãƒ¼ãƒ‘ã‚ºãƒ«). Each minigame can be played on an easy, medium, or hard difficulty. The amount of points that the player obtains may depend on the difficulty of the minigame (with a x2 multiplier for normal mode and a x3 multiplayer for hard mode) and the amount of correct answers given.
The game has a "fortune-telling" feature, where the player can pick a card and have the game tell a Sanrio character that will/has described their day, with a keyword and'key point' description. For example, the key-word for the Osaru no Monkichi card is "popular person" and suggests in the key point description that today the user will talk more than usual on the day they receive the card. The fortune-telling feature also suggests a lucky game. The player normally has to wait until the next to select a new card.
The game has a stamp feature where the player can mark each day they play the game with a stamp, such as a stamp of Hello Kitty or her ribbon, or a star, or a musical note or an apple. All stamps can be red, blue, green, pink or black.
The player can communicate with another player for a minigame battle, or for exchanging letters.

Game.Name: Hello Kitty no Paku Paku & Logic
Game.Overview: Hello Kitty no Paku Paku & Logic (ãƒãƒ­ãƒ¼ã‚­ãƒ†ã‚£ã®ãƒ‘ã‚¯ãƒ‘ã‚¯&ãƒ­ã‚¸ãƒƒã‚¯) is a puzzle game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2009. The game features two puzzles: Paku Paku, which is a puzzle in the vein of Dr. Mario and Puyo Puyo, and nonograms. Solving the puzzles unlocks Hello Kitty-themed stickers, which are sorted in a memoir.

Game.Name: Hello Kitty no Panda Sports Stadium
Game.Overview: Hello Kitty no Panda Sport Stadium is a Sports game, developed and published by Dorasu, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Hello Kitty: Party
Game.Overview:
The party starts here with Hello Kitty and her adorable Sanrio friends! Get together with this cute and playful group as they shop, sew, cook, dance, make dresses, dress up and much more in 25 different games. Find out whatâ€™s made the beloved Hello Kitty franchise a worldwide hit!
More than 25 different easy-to-pick-up-and-play mini-games starring Hello Kitty and her Sanrio friends: Keroppi, Badtz-Maru, My Melody and more Have a Party â€“ Send out personalized invitations to any of Hello Kitty's friends. Dress Making â€“ Sew, iron, cut patterns, and play the button, maze or material hoopla games! Go to the Shop â€“ Pick items from your list and shop for your party. Cooking â€“ Satisfy your culinary appetite by cooking, slicing, frying, washing and even cleaning up, because every good party leaves a mess! Party Time â€“ Party down by dancing and playing spot the difference, the slide puzzle or the memory game. Dress Up â€“ Dress up Hello Kitty in a variety of outfits and accessories (including jewelry, hats and handbags) and then take photos that can be saved to your album

Game.Name: Hello, Pocoyo
Game.Overview: Hello Pocoyo! is not just fun but also a creative exercise for both children and adults. The adventure begins when Pocoyo accidentally makes his friends disappear with a magic pencil. You will travel along with Pocoyo in the environments extracted from the TV series and help Pocoyo find all his missing friends, who join him one by one until he finds them all.

Game.Name: Hell's Kitchen: The Game
Game.Overview:
Based on the FOX network television show, chef Gordon Ramsay hosts a cooking competition for aspiring chefs.
Play through several time management tests in the kitchen and dining room such as taking orders, cooking, serving meals, and cleaning up to the standards of Chef Ramsay or risk his scorn. In the kitchen section, the player has to put different ingredients into the right pots and pans timed so all dishes at one table will be ready around the same time. The player is rated on a five star scale and can work up from a dishwasher to Senior Chef at a 5-star dining establishment.
Unlock 35 recipes from the US TV show, try them at home, or share them with friends.

Game.Name: Hell's Kitchen Vs.
Game.Overview: Hellâ€™s Kitchen Vs. recreates the showâ€™s pressure-cooker atmosphere as two players battle head-to-head in an arcade-style kitchen challenge. Try to conquer your opponent in each time management test, with legendary chef Gordon Ramsay judging and rating your performance at every stage of the game. Please note that elements of this software may have been featured in previously released software.

Game.Name: Henry Hatsworth in the Puzzling Adventure
Game.Overview:
In Henry Hatsworth in the Puzzling Adventure players embark on single player fun like no other. Here Henry Hatsworth, a quirky, lighthearted character serves as your guide on a journey through a new style of gaming on your Nintendo DS that combines the action of an adventure game with the challenge of a puzzle game.
In this two-in-one extravaganza players explore five exotic worlds, fight a variety of opponents, and venture through more than 30 levels, including nearly a dozen hidden levels while taking on outrageous world-ending bosses.

Game.Name: Heracles: Battle with the Gods
Game.Overview: Heracles is rescuing his best friend Pegasus from the evil Poseidon, God of the sea. Only by succeeding in his quest can his banishment from Mount Olympus be undone.

Game.Name: Herbie: Rescue Rally
Game.Overview:
Herbie the Love Bug rides again! In this racing title for the Nintendo DS, Herbie's new owner Louise Noble is trying to find a way to save her family's animal sanctuary from being turned into a garbage dump by the sinister E. Vile corporation. In order to save the sanctuary, Louise and Herbie must win a cross state race against Edward Vile himself, for a $1 million dollar reward.
The game itself allows players to drive across four courses, each with different paths with unique triggered events in each race, such as avalanches, tornadoes or other natural disasters.
Players can compete in four different race modes: Car circuit races (one or two player - both players need a copy of the game to play) - A race against a human opponent to cross the finish line before the rest of the cars.
Head to head races (one or two player - both players need a copy of the game to play) - A race against a human opponent to cross the finish line first.
Time trials (one player) - A race to see how long players can race before time runs out. Collecting clock tokens adds more time.
Speed trials (one player) - A race to see how far a player can get in a certain time. Speed boosts add more acceleration to Herbie.

Game.Name: Heroes of Hellas 2: Olympia
Game.Overview:
Long ago, the Briarey, a multi-armed demon, rose up from Tartarus, stole the Rod of Discord and used it to cause fear and corruption across Hellas. The tiny realm of Olympia was spared, but it needs a ruler who can help it grow from a small settlement into a thriving metropolis. Only then will it be possible to defeat Briarey, recover the rod and restore peace.
Heroes of Hellas 2: Olympia is the sequel to Heroes of Hellas. Unlike the first game, increasing population through city building is the primary objective. Attract new settlers by using gold to buy food, buildings and fortifications. The people will rejoice and build a beautiful new palace with elements chosen by the player.
At its heart, this is a tile matching game in which at least three alike hex-shaped tiles must be selected and removed. It uses the same gameplay mechanic as the first game (click-hold-drag-release). When a chained grouping is removed, all upper tiles drop down and more tiles fall from the top to fill in the blanks. A gold coin appears at end of chains containing five or more tiles. These coins match to any other tile and be used to complete or lengthen a chained selection. Similarly, randomly appearing bombs, lightning rings, and hourglasses can be part of a group of other tiles.
Individual screens for puzzle objectives have been added as well as bonuses for reaching those goals quickly (hero, expert and master). Failed attempts can be restarted. Up to five puzzles can be skipped entirely. Special feats (for removing an unusually long chain of tiles, for instance) are rewarded with trophies and displayed in the trophy room.
New are the four level types. The first three are timed, while the last is not. They are: Classic: standard match and removal Locket: Contains several sub-levels in which a piece of a locket must be collected. When the locket is complete, powers of one deity become available to help with future puzzle-solving. Optional mini-games (hidden object or jigsaw) for each god/goddess can be solved to earn gold and unlock desktop wallpapers. Treasure Hunter: A quick-draw type level. Free as many treasure chests as possible in one minute. Puzzle: Logic-based, untimed puzzle with only one correct solution Charge up a god's powers by removing tiles specific to him/her. In the former game a god's power could not be used until charged completely. In this sequel only a partial charging is required, but not as effective.
Heroes of Hellas 2: Olympia features three difficulty levels (easy, normal and hard), dynamic visual effects, an original musical score and sound effects.

Game.Name: Heroes of Mana
Game.Overview:
Breathing new life into the vaunted Mana franchise, Heroes of Mana takes the beloved series into an entirely new dimension. In the first real-time strategy title for the series, generals will plan, plot and strategize their way to victory on the battlefield. Command an army of heroes, creatures and beloved rabites with the use of the Nintendo DS Touch Screen, and experience an all-new perspective on the ever-evolving Mana saga. Players can see how they rank among others in the country by accessing the Heroes of Mana servers via the Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.
Also known as Seiken Densetsu: Heroes of Mana.

Game.Name: Hero of Sparta
Game.Overview: You are King Argos, a Spartan hero whoâ€™s not afraid to defy the gods themselves. Take up the maddest challenge in this colossal, full 3D odyssey and face the most phenomenal mythical creatures!Let this epic action game take you from mythical lands to the depths of the Underworld for hours of gaming and visual enjoyment. Collect and upgrade 4 mythic weapons, and unleash your heroâ€™s special powers by performing combos. It's your chance to write your own legend... if you can survive the adventure.

Game.Name: Hero's Saga: Laevatein Tactics
Game.Overview: The Story So Far... When a strange girl hands Ernesto, the young prince of Valencia, a mysterious sword and tells him to save his friends, he thinks nothing of using the magical blade to fight off an undead attack. Little does he know that such a small choice will spark a war that will rage across the continent of Yulamecca and beyond... "Hero's Saga Laevatein Tactics really brings back the spirit of SRPGs of old," said Frank "Bo" deWindt II, Project Lead, Aksys Games. "You can definitely see bits and pieces of many SRPGs, like Ogre Battle and Tactics Ogre, lending their influence to help inspire a stellar game."

Game.Name: Het Huis Anubis: De Donkere Strijd
Game.Overview: In this game based on the TV series The House Anubis it all comes down to solving mysteries! Play as the five stars of the show and use their senses to guide them in their quests. Each character excels at one of the five major senses: hearing, sight, smell, taste and touch and the player will have to combine all of them for this great adventure!

Game.Name: Het Huis Anubis: Het Geheim van Osiris
Game.Overview:
The residents of Het Huis Anubis need your help!
Welcome to the house Osiris. The house Osiris is a boarding school where you have recently become a resident. The landlord has grounded you. If necessary, you had to hang out again ... If only you had not sprayed it wet with the garden hose ... You are now stuck in your room but there is not really time to get bored. Adventure is in the air!
House of Anubis - The Secret of Osiris takes you to an abandoned inn, a beautiful garden full of ancient artifacts and even distant Egypt. You make a wonderful journey through time and you end up in the world of the original inhabitants of the house Anubis; the couple Winsbruggen-van Hennegouwen and their daughter. Can you solve the riddles, find the treasures and solve the Secret of Osiris?

Game.Name: Hexe Lilli Entdeckt Europa
Game.Overview: Go on a journey of discovery with the witch Lilli! Lilli visits a museum with Hector at night because Hector would cause too much of a stir during the day. Hector is excited and flies around excitedly. He discovers a great map of Europe on the wall and immediately wants to travel to a country. He flies onto the edge of the map and when Lilli recites a spell, he loses his balance and falls down with the map! Lilli makes a slip of the tongue while doing magic and then disaster strikes: Important buildings and works of art in four European countries have been altered! Now it's Lilli's turn and she has to put everything back in order in one night. Of course, Hector will help her... An exciting and fun adventure with the witch Lilli on your Nintendo DS! Features:* Game with the well-known TV license "Hexe Lilli"* Trains children's combination and thinking skills, teaches basic geography and general knowledge* Also: Skill and painting games, high score list, free play mode and much more* Logic, Search and Jump'n Run elements in one game

Game.Name: Hidamari Sketch: Doko Demo Sugoroku x 365
Game.Overview: Hidamari Sketch: Doko Demo Sugoroku x 365 is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Hidden Expedition: Titanic
Game.Overview:
On April 14, 1912 the massive ship, RMS Titanic, collided with an iceberg and sank within three hours. The remains of the ship have been investigated several times, but many mysteries still remain hidden in the depths of the dark wreck.
You have now been assigned a mission to explore it! Descend to the ocean bed and discover the fantastic secrets waiting to be revealed in this once majestic ship. Conduct your research over 14 missions in 17 locations and try to unveil the secrets of the Titanic.
Can you find the crown?

Game.Name: Hidden Mysteries: Buckingham Palace: Secrets of Kings and Queens
Game.Overview: 30+ unique Buckingham Palace locations to explore for clues 45+ levels - each level can be visited again and again for more clues and increased playability 100s of hidden objects that appear randomly throughout the game - use the objects found to unlock additional clues Combine special items to solve puzzles Each act is completed with a unique puzzle

Game.Name: Hidden Mysteries: Salem Secrets: Witch Trials of 1692
Game.Overview: Hidden Mysteries: Salem Secrets, Witch Trials of 1692 is a fantastic example of how PC adventure games can be translated across to the Nintendo DS without any real loss in detail or quality. Filled to the brim with an intriguing storyline, plenty of brain-teasing mini-games, enjoyable free-roaming gameplay and hidden object puzzles, this is definitely one for fans of the genre to add to their shopping list.

Game.Name: Hidden Mysteries: Titanic: Secrets of the Fateful Voyage
Game.Overview: Puzzle-solving challenges compel you to watch your inventory and use your mind! Your character's interaction with other people aboard the ship enables you to gather information and key items 15 chapters in the story each with multiple scenes and mini-games Waterline progression gives each scene a different look as time passes Dialog choices give you options to follow different paths within the game and multiple endings are created based upon those choices

Game.Name: Hidden Mysteries: Vampire Secrets
Game.Overview: What is intended as a relaxing vacation to Savannah , Georgia for Claire Donnelly wuickly turns into one of adventure and mystery. Upon her arrival, Claire starts experiencing unusual visions, which grow to vivid depiction of visions of evil forces living among the citizens of Savannah. Dark Shadows: A Vampire's Tale mixes hidden object gameplay with adventure elements. The dark and mysterious storyline will capture the attention of casual gamers and vampire fanatics alike

Game.Name: Hidden Object Show
Game.Overview:
The Hidden Object Show: Season 2 is a hidden object game with a TV show theme. As a contestant in a game show, the player has to click on the assorted paraphernalia concealed in the scenery, finding the ones from a list of required objects at the bottom of the screen within a time limit.
After finishing each screen, a fortune teller appears that randomly selects one of the 11 bonus games with his crystal ball. They include common variations of the seek-and-find gameplay, like marking the differences between two similar scenes, and finding objects by their silhouettes. There are some unique games: one called Letter Getter, where the letters for the list must be collected to complete the name of the objects; and Find 10, where a riddle describes ten objects sharing the same characteristics the must be clicked.
The locations also have bonus items that can be collected. Questions marks give extra hints, carnival tickets can be exchanged for toys and star chips skip one of the bonus games at the fortune teller.

Game.Name: Hidden Objects: Mystery Stories
Game.Overview:
Find the clues... Solve the crime... Unravel the mystery!
Hidden object game with a good mix of puzzles and types of hidden object scenes.
Storyline starts on a tropical island with a mystery involving a Mayan curse. It continues in Berlin, delving into long buried secrets.

Game.Name: Hidden Photo
Game.Overview:
Snap - Create - Play!
Hidden Photo tests your powers of observation with fun brain-twisting challenges. Locate hidden objects, words and faces in a variety of photos, or spot the difference between two photos. Use your Nintendo DSi systemâ€™s built-in camera to make your world the centerpiece of unique challenges.
Unleash your creative talents by snapping photos of yourself, friends, objects, pets or anything in your environment. Hidden Photo will create new puzzles for you to solve and share with your friends. The clock is ticking, so donâ€™t admire your photographic genius for too long.

Game.Name: High School Musical 2: Work This Out!
Game.Overview: You play as Troy, Gabriella, Ryan, Sharpay, Chad and Taylor, helping them perform a series of different daily tasks during their working holiday at the Laval Springs Resort. Your goal is to ultimately win the Star Dazzle talent show. The game mostly consists of rhythm-based mini-games such as picking up golf balls, making sandwiches, watch over sunbathers (you tap on their umbrellas to open them up), grab basketballs and dance by tapping circles, all to the beat of the music. You also collect hidden items in the Lava Springs Resort and rehearse dance routines. You can also unlock songs from the movie, playable using the included jukebox that you can listen to while the DS is closed.

Game.Name: High School Musical 3: Senior Year
Game.Overview:
Join the Wildcats in this touch-based music and rhythm game based on the film.
Players play through each of the movie's 11 songs by sweeping a pie-shaped icon into the notes of the music as they stream toward the center of the top screen. As the music picks up, so does the pacing of this game, and players must keep up or risk being unable to progress towards their ultimate goal -- graduation!
Along the way, players are also challenged with various activities, including some different musical minigames, yearbook assembly, and quizzes that test how well their personalities match with the High School Musical characters. Since the game offers both a Junior Varsity and Varsity mode, gamers of all experience levels will be able to play through the game with ease.
The game also features a multiplayer "BFF quiz mode" where players see how well they know each other, a jukebox mode that lets players just listen to unlocked songs, as well as support for Dgamer unlockables, honors, and online chat.

Game.Name: High School Musical: Makin' the Cut!
Game.Overview: High School Musical: Makin' the Cut! is a stylus and touch screen dance game based on the 2006 television movie High School Musical. You dance along with the movieâ€™s songs as Troy, Gabriella, Sharpay, Ryan, Chad or Taylor. Circular icons appear on the screen that fill in with color, you tap with the stylus when they're full, matching the beat of the current song. In Dance mode you drag a basketball to an on-screen hoop or trace patterns in a notebook. You can also create and choreograph your own videos by changing camera angles and adding special effects in order to win the national title. You can then save the video and trade it with your friends (they must also own the game). The game also feature character customization.

Game.Name: High Stakes Texas Hold'em
Game.Overview: Hudson proudly presents the definitive Texas Holdâ€˜Em game on DSiWare with High Stakes Texas Holdâ€˜Em! High Stakes allows players of any level to enjoy Texas Holdâ€˜Em gameplay. The popular No-Limit rule set used in many tournaments is packed in, so anyone can play with the big boys! With the added functionality of DS Wireless Communications, players can compete with others and test their skills. Itâ€™s the core Texas Holdâ€˜Em experience on your Nintendo DSi system; anytime, anywhere!

Game.Name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Ichi Kan: Tatari
Game.Overview: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Ichi Kan - Tatari is an Adventure game, developed and published by Alchemist, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Ni Kan: Sou
Game.Overview: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Ni Kan - Sou is an Adventure game, developed and published by Alchemist, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai San Kan: Rasen
Game.Overview: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni takes place during June 1983, at a fictional rural village called Hinamizawa, which has a population of approximately 2000. The main character, Keiichi Maebara, moves to Hinamizawa and befriends his new classmates Rena Ryugu, Mion Sonozaki, Rika Furude, and Satoko Hojo. Keiichi joins their after-school club activities, which consist mostly of card and board games (and punishment games for the loser, usually him.) Hinamizawa appears to be a normal, peaceful, rural village to Keiichi. However, the tranquility abruptly ends after the annual Watanagashi Festival, a celebration to commemorate and give thanks to the local god, Oyashiro-sama. Keiichi learns that every year for the past four years, one person has been murdered and another has gone missing on the day of the Watanagashi Festival. Keiichi himself soon becomes drawn into the strange events surrounding the Watanagashi Festival and Oyashiro-sama. In each story arc, he or one of his friends become paranoid, and a crime is committed. Usually, the crime involves the murder of one of their own friends. While it seems impossible to tell their delusions apart from the mystery of Hinamizawa, slowly the truth is revealed.

Game.Name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Yon Kan: Kizuna
Game.Overview: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kizuna: Dai Yon Kan - Kizuna is an Adventure game, developed and published by Alchemist, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Hi! HamTaro: Ham-Ham Challenge
Game.Overview: Join Hamtaro and all his friends in a variety of fun and educational brain-training games. Children will develop their memory, word comprehension, math skills and many other abilities as they play through 12 engaging, interactive games. Parents can monitor their childâ€™s growing abilities, adjust the difficulty level to match their childâ€™s skills, and reward them with special items. Hamtaro and his friends make learning fun!

Game.Name: Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi: The Genie & the Amp
Game.Overview:
Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi: The Genie & the Amp is a 2006 action game for the Nintendo DS handheld video game console based on the Cartoon Network animated television series Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi.
The player must navigate various levels by using the d-pad to move. Throughout the levels, the player will come across a variety of enemies trying to stop them. To attack, the player can either use the Nintendo DS's buttons or use the guitar strings that appear on the touchscreen. The game also features a two-player cooperative mode.

Game.Name: Hiiro no Kakera DS
Game.Overview:
The protagonist is a teenage girl (Tamaki) who revisits a small village she remembers from her childhood and gets caught up in her family's history and the supernatural dangers surrounding it.
While walking along the hillsides waiting for the person who her grandmother sent to fetch Tamaki to the village, Tamaki comes across a small, white round object which has sticks for limbs and can talk. It runs off soon after with Tamaki chasing after it. Soon Tamaki finds herself in a place where "it does not feel like the world I came from." She gets attacked by three slime creatures, and a mysterious man comes charging in to save her by clamping his hands around her body and mouth then telling her to be quiet. After the young man (Takuma) saves her he walks her to the village where her grandmother is staying. Soon after her arrival she meets with her grandmother. It's later explained that she has to continue the role of ancestor princess (Tamayori), to seal the sword Onikirimaru with the help of her five guardians.

Game.Name: Hints Hunter
Game.Overview:
Hints Hunter is an easy, casual game that you can play any time and anywhere. The objective is simply to find the keys hidden around the game. To do this, you will have to work out the meaning of the hints in each level.
You can play the game using the stylus only.
Most of the hints in the game are helpful and may require you to think about the time of the day, game functions like tapping or dragging or the principle of opening or closing. Make sure you examine the most minute details very carefully, including the name of a level or even a tiny flower!

Game.Name: Hip Hop King: Rytmik Edition
Game.Overview:
Hip Hop King is an application for creating rhythmical and melodic themes and for composing whole songs.
Its user interface blends the fast and well-arranged interface of classic drum machines with flexible pattern interface of popular trackers and with modern sound library. It contains more than 170 carefully selected sound samples of drums, percussions, bass, melodic instruments and gramophone scratches.
With Hip Hop King you can quickly and easily create the basic building stone â€“ an audio clip. It consists of musical notations for up to four instruments that you may transpose, select their location in the stereo field, and modify their volume, reverse, shuffle (rhythm twist) and polyphony (with extended polyphony handling), chorus/widening stereo effect and echo. You may arbitrarily combine up to 128 such clips in four tracks and create complex pieces of music.
Hip Hop King is not only for playing with sounds; in the hands of a skilful musician it can become a serious musical instrument â€“ surprisingly powerful pocket music station. For the best musical experience we recommend connecting headphones or quality speaker system. Youâ€™ll become the Hip Hop King of the party in no timeâ€¦
Features
â€¢ Pocket music station â€¢ Library of more than 170 sound samples

Game.Name: Hiraki Kazuo Sensei (Tokyo Daigaku) Kanshuu: Sukusuku Kosodate DS: Akachan to Asobou!
Game.Overview: Hiraki Kazuo Sensei (Tokyo Daigaku) Kanshuu: Sukusuku Kosodate DS: Akachan to Asobou! is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Marvelous Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Hirameki Action: Chibikko Wagyan no Ooki na Bouken
Game.Overview:
Hirameki Action: Chibikko Wagyan no Ooki na Bouken is a Nintendo DS game that blends platforming and puzzle-solving elements. Players control Wagyan, a small dragon, as they navigate various levels filled with obstacles and enemies.
The game includes interactive stages and puzzles that are easy enough to be accessible for younger audiences.

Game.Name: Hiromichi Oniisan no Oyako Taisou Navi: Oyako no Skin-Ship & Tairyoku Zukuri
Game.Overview: Hiromichi Oniisan no Oyako Taisou Navi: Oyako no Skin-Ship & Tairyoku Zukuri DS (often shortened to Hiromichi Oniisan no Oyako Taisou Navi) is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS game released in 2008, focusing on parent-child bonding exercises and physical fitness through "skin-ship" (physical closeness) and stamina building, presented by the famous Japanese children's fitness personality Hiromichi Oniisan, featuring interactive exercises for families.

Game.Name: Hissatsu Kung Fu: Kanji Dragon
Game.Overview: Hissatsu Kung Fu: Kanji Dragon is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Beyond Interactive and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 1: Shinseiki Evangelion: Magokoro o, Kimi ni
Game.Overview: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 1: Shinseiki Evangelion: Magokoro o, Kimi ni DS is a gambling simulation game developed by Bisty and published by D3Publisher, released exclusively in Japan on 21 February 2008. It serves as a digital recreation of the popular Neon Genesis Evangelion: Magokoro o, Kimi ni pachislot machine for the Nintendo DS.

Game.Name: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 2: CR Shinseiki Evangelion: Shito, Futatabi
Game.Overview: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 2: CR Shinseiki Evangelion: Shito, Futatabi DS is a gambling simulation game released exclusively in Japan for the Nintendo DS. Developed and published by D3 Publisher, it was released on 12 June 2008.

Game.Name: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 3: Shinseiki Evangelion: Yakusoku no Toki
Game.Overview: Hisshou Pachinko*Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 3: Shinseiki Evangelion - Yakusoku no Toki is a gambling simulation game developed and published by D3Publisher, released for the Nintendo DS on 4 December 2008.

Game.Name: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 4: CR Shinseiki Evangelion: Saigo no Shisha
Game.Overview: Hisshou Pachinko*Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 4: Shinseiki Evangelion - Saigo no Mono is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Hisshou Pachinko Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 5: Shinseiki Evangelion: Tamashii no Kiseki
Game.Overview: Hisshou Pachinko*Pachi-Slot Kouryaku Series DS Vol. 5: Shinseiki Evangelion - Tamashii no Kiseki is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: HMH Vokabeltrainer: Englisch
Game.Overview:
The "HMH Vocabulary Trainer â€“ English" is equally suitable for beginners and advanced foreign language enthusiasts. It offers thematic vocabulary training for levels A1, A2, B1 and B2 of the European Framework of Reference for Languages. The vocabulary trainer contains more than 4,000 words and over 4,000 context sentences, which are clearly arranged in categories suitable for everyday use and manageable learning packages. All vocabulary has been recorded by native speakers and can be called up at any time.
In addition, the "HMH Vocabulary Trainer" contains numerous effective but also playful vocabulary and vocabulary exercises, dictation exercises in four levels of difficulty, a language laboratory and a well-assorted dictionary with 15,000 keywords and more than 250,000 inflected word forms. Another special feature is the language and country quiz with 600 questions on country-specific topics such as art, culture, geography and lifestyle. The vocabulary trainer is the ideal companion for anyone who wants to learn English as a foreign language and/or want to brush up on their English.
FEATURES: * Thematic vocabulary training for beginners and advanced learners * Vocabulary training for levels A1,A2, B1 and B2 with more than 4,000 English words (spoken by native speakers) * Over 4,000 contextual English sentences * Effective vocabulary exercises such as cloze text, listening comprehension or vocabulary cards * Varied vocabulary games such as letter mix, slide puzzle and color link * Vocabulary writing exercises in 4 levels of difficulty (A1, A2, B1, B2) * Contextual dictations in 4 levels of difficulty (A1,A2, B1, B2) * Language laboratory with recording and playback function of your own voice recordings * Extras! Language and country quiz with different levels of difficulty * Extras! Dictionary (D-E and E-D) with 30,000 headwords and approx. 200,000 inflected word forms * Modern and easy to use interface * Word input via the NDS touch pen or a virtual keyboard * Voice recording and voice playback function * Vocabulary and contextual sentences spoken by native speakers * For beginners and advanced.

Game.Name: HMH Vokabeltrainer: Franzoesisch
Game.Overview:
The "HMH vocabulary trainer - French" is equally suitable for beginners and advanced foreign language enthusiasts. It offers thematic vocabulary training for levels A1, A2, B1 and B2 of the European Framework of Reference for Languages. The vocabulary trainer contains more than 4,000 words and over 4,000 context sentences, which are clearly arranged in categories suitable for everyday use and manageable learning packages. All vocabulary has been recorded by native speakers and can be called up at any time. In addition, the "HMH vocabulary trainer" contains numerous effective but also playful vocabulary and vocabulary exercises, dictation exercises in four levels of difficulty, a language laboratory and a well-assorted dictionary with 15,000 keywords and more than 250,000 inflected word forms. Another special feature is the language and country quiz with 600 questions on country-specific topics such as art, culture, geography and lifestyle. The vocabulary trainer is the ideal companion for anyone who wants to learn French as a foreign language and/or want to brush up on their French. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED rating: "Vocabulary trainers are now a well-established genre on the Nintendo DS and it should actually be difficult for any newcomer to establish themselves in the highly competitive market. But a simple, serious presentation, a thematic vocabulary training based on the European reference level and a concept based on the 'Travel Coach Europe', which has also been available for the Nintendo DS since the summer, make 'HMH Vocabulary Trainer English' the best virtual vocabulary trainer currently available grab." (nintendo-online.de via "HMH Vocabulary Trainer â€“ English") Features:

Language and country quiz with different levels of difficulty Extra! Dictionary (D-F and F-D) with 15,000 keywords and approx. 250,000 inflected word forms Modern and easy-to-use interface Word input via the NDS touch pen or virtual keyboard Voice recording and voice playback function Vocabulary and contextual sentences spoken by native speakers For beginners and advanced learners

Game.Name: HMH Vokabeltrainer: Spanisch
Game.Overview:
The "HMH Vocabulary Trainer â€“ Spanish" is suitable for beginners and advanced language learners alike. It offers thematic vocabulary training for levels A1, A2, B1, and B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. The vocabulary trainer contains more than 4,000 words and over 4,000 contextual sentences, clearly organized into everyday categories and manageable learning packages. All words are recorded by native speakers and can be accessed at any time. In addition, the "HMH Vocabulary Trainer" includes numerous effective yet playful vocabulary and vocabulary exercises, dictation exercises at four levels of difficulty, a language lab, and a well-organized dictionary with 15,000 keywords and more than 250,000 inflected word forms. Another special feature is the language and country quiz with 600 questions on country-specific topics such as art, culture, geography, and lifestyles. The vocabulary trainer is the ideal companion for anyone who wants to learn Spanish as a foreign language and/or brush up on their Spanish.

Game.Name: Hokkaidou Hatsu!! Dosanko Wide ga DS ni Narimashita! Hoshizawa Sachiko no Temanashi Raku Raku Gohan
Game.Overview: Hokkaidou Hatsu!! Dosanko Wide ga DS ni Narimashita! Hoshizawa Sachiko no Temanashi Raku Raku Gohan is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Comolink, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Hokuto no Ken: Hokuto Shinken Denshousha no Michi
Game.Overview:
Hokuto no Ken - Hokuto Shinken DenshÅsha no Michiâ€‹ is a video game released by Spike for the Nintendo DS on February 14, 2008 in Japan. Advertised as a "vital point striking" action game, the player takes control of Kenshiro and must use the DS's touch screen to strike the vital points of adversaries to defeat them.
The game's graphics consists entirely of colorized panel art from the original manga. The story mode consists of 22 chapters and adapts the manga's storyline from the beginning and up to the conclusion of Raoh saga. Other game modes includes a Battleship-style Versus Mode between two players, a Quiz mini-game, and a database of characters and famous lines from the manga.
Akira Kamiya and Kenji Utsumi both return to provide their voices as Kenshiro and Raoh, with Shigeru Chiba as the narrator as well.

Game.Name: Holly Hobbie & Friends
Game.Overview:
Do you have what it takes to be a member of the "Hey Girls Club?" Now girl gamers on the go can find out in Holly Hobbie & Friends for the Nintendo DS! Play as Holly Hobbie in 14 fun mini-games that involve Holly's best friends and family. You can even use your journal to record your daily activities and test yourself with Holly Hobbie trivia!
â€¢ Based on the contemporized brand from American Greetings that includes: toys; DVDs; storybooks; craft & activity books; confections; cards; stationery; personal care products and much more!
â€¢ Play as the fun and creative Holly Hobbie and get to know her friends (Carrie & Amy), family (mom, dad and brother Robbie) and everyone's pets (Bonnet, Doodles, Cheddar and Cider).
â€¢ Use the Touch Screen to play 14 different mini games with young girl themes: designing posters, dance competition, planning a sleepover party, selling lemonade, in-line skating, biking, cooking, dressing up, and more!
â€¢ Record notes and high scores in your personal Holly Hobbie Journal.
â€¢ Take the Holly Pop Quiz and see how well you know your Holly Hobbie Trivia.

Game.Name: Hollywood Files: Deadly Intrigues
Game.Overview: Modern style Hidden Object games in Hollywood Find the clues to solve the mystery Unique graphic style pictures 10 mini-games to help you gather information

Game.Name: Home designer: Perfekt Gestylte Zimmer
Game.Overview:
Experience the dream job of an interior designer up close. In the creative game "Home Designer - Perfectly Styled Rooms" you can decorate and furnish numerous rooms. Design rooms for different customers - each client has their own ideas and wishes. With 500 pieces of furniture and accessories, there really is something for every taste. Furnish children's rooms, bedrooms or living rooms, design work rooms and studios. Let your creativity run free! With the Nintendo DSi's camera, you can personalize the rooms: take a picture and hang it on the wall in a picture frame!
Your customers have a variety of wishesFeatures:
Three different game modes: career, move-in and creative Great 3D graphics with trendy designs and cool tracking shots through the designed rooms You can use your own photo to decorate the room via the Nintendo DSi Share your creations with friends via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection

Game.Name: Homie Rollerz
Game.Overview:
Homie Rollerz is a fast-paced, mayhem-laden kart racer where players can pick one of the 10 most popular Homies, customize their slick rides, then trick, hop, and battle through courses with settings, shortcuts, and secrets as unique as the Homies themselves.
Features
â€¢ Trick Out and Roll Out: Earn respect points by doing stunts and winning races, then cash them in to trick out your car. Use the stylus to paint and mod your ride, fit your car with a better engine and exhaust system for more speed, beef up your suspension and hydraulic systems for better turning and cooler tricks when racing.â€¢ Rivalries and Respect: Challenge your fellow Homies on their turf. Beat Jokawild under the big top in the Homie Circus or drag race down Venice Beach against Big Loco. To win, youâ€™ve got to learn the hoods, find the shortcuts, earn respect, and show your Homies who owns the street.â€¢ Multiplayer: Is one of your friends challenging your street cred? Show them who owns the hood with up to 8 players via Local Wireless or four players via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. Homie Rollerz also supports Download Play, so you and another Homie can play a trial version using only one cart!â€¢ Get to Know the Homies: Play as one of 10 slick Homies and enter the â€œWizard Circuit,â€ a mysterious racing series through which the winner is granted a single wish by the wise and legendary Homie known as Wizard. Each character has a unique vehicle that can be upgraded in the garage for improved stats. Learn whatâ€™s motivating each of your Homies: Why is Alien Ese stuck on Earth and how can he get back home? How did Zombie become undead and will he ever return to the land of the living?

Game.Name: Honda ATV Fever
Game.Overview: In some respects, Honda ATV Fever is certainly a better title than ATV Quad Kings. The vehicles seem to drive a little faster, and there is more to take into account when selecting your ATV. However, it shares too many similarities with its sub-par predecessor.

Game.Name: Honeycomb Beat
Game.Overview:
ENERGIZE YOUR MIND!
Honeycomb Beat puts your brain power to the test with a cool fusion of music and addictive puzzle action. Solve puzzles by clicking on honeycomb tiles to match their color to the playfield. Sounds easy? Multiple puzzles increase the challenge and fun for even the smartest of players!
Features
â€¢ Easy to pick up and play with 200+ different puzzles to solveâ€¢ Arcade-style Infinite mode - stop the honeycomb tiles from advancing to the top as you clear them away â€¢ Built-in Tutorial helps you learn basic rules and better techniques â€¢ Unlock new music, backgrounds and visualization themes as you advance â€¢ Rise through the ranks of "Brain Evolution" as you play better

Game.Name: Hurry Up Hedgehog!
Game.Overview:
Hurry Up Hedgehog is not what you expect it to be when you hear the title. Naturally, you first think itâ€™s a Sonic rip-off, given the â€œspeedinessâ€ of the title. Itâ€™s easy to assume it might be some type of platform jumper, but that couldnâ€™t be more wrong. Itâ€™s actually based on the German board game Igel Argern, which was released in the 1990s.
Not too many people have played Igel Argern (also known as Egelrace), mainly because it was (obviously) never released in the rest of the world. Plenty of board games are available for the DS platform, but most are popular titles like Scrabble or Monopoly. Hurry Up Hedgehog is somewhat of a backgammon meets checkers type thing, and will provide a different type of board game from what you are used to. Plus, it has a silly name that makes you want to give it a try. To that end, Oxygen Games gets a few points for originality in deciding to bring American audiences a German game instead of something weâ€™ve seen a million times. The question is whether or not it holds its own as a standalone video gameâ€¦

Game.Name: Hysteria Hospital: Emergency Ward
Game.Overview:
Hysteria Hospital is a Time Management game in the style of Diner Dash or Cake Mania.
You choose to play as a male or female nurse, recently graduated from the University of California, and start your career in a small medical ward in Maryville. Finding a job wasn't at all hard, and you soon find out why - you're the only nurse on call.
Gameplay is virtually identical in all platforms, being that the main differences between them come in the shape of rendered 3D visuals for the Wii and PC, while the DS sports pixel-art type 2D graphics. The music and much of the sound effects are also different between the handheld version and the others, a more bleepy old-school approach having been taken in the DS while the PC and Wii feature a more hi-definition approach. A few of the treatment machines also differ between the DS and the rest, but in the end the gameplay remains virtually the same, sporting no platform-specific mechanics.
Through a quick tutorial you learn the basics: patients must be taken to triage/diagnosis, and then different treatments will be in order using your DS stylus, Wii-mote or plain mouse.
Some patients demand more attention than others, and your limited equipment, when compared to the large and continuous flow of in-patients, means you have to juggle treatments, prescriptions and clean-up phases. An unchanged Quick Treatment bed means no other patients can use it, which can quickly lead to a high number of angry patients. If you let too many leave in wrath, then it's bye-bye money and try again (you are fired over and over, but they let you at it again since you're the only nurse available anyway).
Hysteria Hospital: Emergency Ward sports a casual atmosphere typical of Time Management games, something which is also reflected in the level of content and customisation available - add new sets of medical equipment to increase the number of patients you can treat; patients for which there is no treatment available can be sent to another center by means of an ambulance; buy items to keep in-patients happier for longer; and last but not least, change the color of your work uniform.
There isn't really much beyond this, and in the later, multi-floored levels you'll find yourself spending as much as you can in order to tend to the highest number of patients as humanly possible.
Then you become a legendary nurse.

Play as the duo and help them out of trouble by serving wacky dishes to crazy customers in a fast-paced, action puzzle game that dishes out all the random hilarity from the show!
Game Features:
â€¢ Prepare endless dishes and serve them to quirky customers before time runs out! â€¢ Interact with the entire iCarly cast and earn special upgrades to have Sam trigger â€œRandom Dancingâ€, see Gibby charge shirtless into lines of customers and more! â€¢ â€œBattleâ€ 20 types of crazy hungry customers including costumed web mascots, troublesome goop throwing students, and intimidating prisoners from King County Prison! â€¢ Serve more than 20 imaginative food creations including Spaghetti Tacos, Doughnuts on a Stick, and Fudge Balls! â€¢ Match wits with characters like arch nemesis Nevel Papperman, mean teacher Ms. Francine Briggs, Lewbert the nasty doorman and T-Bo as they bring the pressure to serve with extra special panache. â€¢ Enjoy frantic fun in five locations from the iCarly show, including the popular Groovy Smoothie, Webicon, Ridgeway High School, King County Prison and Crown Ridge Mall! â€¢ Explore an abundant variety of dishes to serve in Spencerâ€™s customizable food prep guide and create your menu at the start of each location! â€¢ Utilize Freddieâ€™s customer database to understand the unique preferences of each customer and concoct the perfect strategy to feed the crowd! â€¢ Master your serving skills and earn up to 50 game achievements to unlock bonus content like special abilities, additional dishes, helper utilities and other awesome upgrades from Gibbyâ€™s shop!

Game.Name: Ice Age 2: The Meltdown
Game.Overview:
This puzzle-adventure game follows the story of the film, where three companions must navigate a dangerous, thawing world.
Players play as all three animal friends, and can switch between them at will to use their distinct abilities to solve each level's terrain hazards. Manny the mammoth can use his great strength to push large boulders, or swim through deep lakes; Diego the sabertooth tiger can swipe his way through thorny bushes and leap chasms; Sid the sloth can melt ice blocks, climb walls, and cross cracking iceflows.
Breaking up the puzzle-solving action are several Scrat levels, where players control the hyper rodent through insanely-fast sidescroller levels where he leaps, tunnels, and flies through the scenery to collect his precious acorns.
There are over 30 adventure levels, boss levels, and a half-dozen Scrat levels.

Game.Name: Ice Age: Continental Drift: Arctic Games
Game.Overview: When their island is set adrift in the midst of continental upheaval, Manny and the herd encounter a ragtag menagerie of seafaring pirates with a secret treasure. Having trouble deciding on how to split the treasure evenly, they collectively decide to settle the problem through a series of off-the-wall sporting events including ski jumping, ice smashing, and glacial hopping. Ultimately, the winner of the most events will be entitled to the prize. As the prehistoric games begin, players must side with Manny and the herd, or the seafaring pirates to determine the fate of the riches.

Game.Name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
Game.Overview: Based on the computer-animated movie starring the voices of Ray Romano and John Leguizamo, Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs is a 3D platform game that has you controlling multiple prehistoric protagonists across more than 15 levels of lighthearted action. Help Manny, Sid, Diego, Scrat, and friends navigate their way through the lush jungles of a world lurking underneath the ice: a tropical world inhabited by dinosaurs. Master each character's distinct moves while exploring caves, riding a pterodactyl, avoiding a rampaging Tyrannosaurus rex, running atop a ball of ice, and more. Those having difficulty during certain sequences can receive tips from woolly mammoth Ellie as well as possums Crash and Eddie. In addition to the single-player campaign, Ice Age 2 offers eight competitive mini-games supporting up to four players.

Game.Name: Ice Hockey Slovakia 2011
Game.Overview:
Challenge your friends to the ultimate Table Hockey game on your Nintendo DSi.
Find out how many computers you can defeat with Championship mode, or challenge your friends in Multiplayer mode and show them whoâ€™s the true champ! This is the game Hockey fans have been waiting for!

Game.Name: Ichido wa Yon de Okitai: Nihon Bungaku 100-sen
Game.Overview: Ichido wa Yonde de Okitai: Nihon Bungaku 100-sen (translated as "100 Selections of Japanese Literature You Should Read Once") is an e-book collection for the Nintendo DS released exclusively in Japan on 26 July 2007. Developed and published by Spike, the title functions as a portable library of 100 classic Japanese literary works.

Game.Name: Ico Soccer
Game.Overview:
ICO Soccer reminds me of those classic soccer games on the Amiga 500 and the SNES, not just from the graphics but rather the gameplay which easily allows gamers of all levels the ability to play this title from the get go. Best of all, the developers have ensured that the stylus is not just an afterthought and actually enhances the gaming experience and will have you kicking goals in no time... well, almost.
The developers have boasted an old-school approach to this game and even from the opening scene, the game is extremely retro and actually suits the approach they have taken.
Gameplay wise, you can start a quick match or start a World Cup mode which is quite short. Getting straight into the mechanics of soccer in this title, the top screen is used to display the gameplay itself and information, with the stylus screen used to control your match. The touch screen is where the game is reminiscent of those classic top-down views with icons displayed for various soccer maneuvers.

Game.Name: Idaten Jump DS: Moero! Flame Kaiser
Game.Overview: Idaten Jump DS: Moero! Flame Kaiser is a Racing game, developed and published by Taito Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: I Did It Mum! Picture Book
Game.Overview: I Did it Mum! Picture Book is a new spin-off of the popular series featuring eight different delightful stories based on classic European and Asian fairy tales. As well as offering youngsters the opportunity to improve their reading, Picture Book also contains interactive drawings for players to colour in and fun mini games to keep inquisitive minds busy. Finally, for parents who want to read the stories to their children, there's an option to turn off the in-game narration; perfect for a spot of bedtime storytelling.

Game.Name: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai III Remix
Game.Overview: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai III Remix is a handheld version of the arcade game Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai III. You play strip mahjong against young, attractive female opponents. However, it's not a port, as there are many modifications. First, there is no nudity. While your opponents strip, they only strip down to their swimsuits. In the Nintendo DS version, the cutscenes and swimsuit scenes are presented as slideshows, there is no spoken dialogue during cutscenes, instead displaying text, and there are no vocal tracks. There is also a free battle mode, an album mode to view the swimsuit scenes, a sound test to listen to the music tracks, a dress-up with Miyuri minigame, and a mode in which Miyuri talks about the various characters in the game.

Game.Name: Igor: The Game
Game.Overview: Welcome to Malaria, where every year the evil scientists compete to see who will win the annual invention fair! Igor has the chance to win it but his great monster invention, Eva, has been kidnapped! Can you save her in time? If you do, you may become the most Evil Scientist in the land?

Game.Name: I Heart Geeks
Game.Overview: Produced in cooperation with Marc Ecko Entertainment, the game features a tongue-in-cheek story and hip art style where the brainy geek overcomes the brawny (and bullying) jocks, winning the heart of the beautiful cheerleader. A friendly interface and helpful tutorials along with the gradual introduction of puzzles of ever-increasing difficulty and complexity, multiple solutions, and wireless support to allow players to face off against one another in timed puzzle-solving races round out the features

Game.Name: IkachanDS
Game.Overview:
Ikachan DS is a port of Ikachan, a freeware minigame originally created by developer Daisuke Amaya under the art name Pixel.
In the game, you play a squid named Ikachan, who swims through a cave, meeting and helping other creatures.

Game.Name: Ikamono Tantei: Ikatan
Game.Overview: Ikatan: Ikamono Tantei is an Adventure game, developed by Edge WORKS and published by CyberFront, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Ike! Ike!! Hamusuta
Game.Overview:
Ike! Ike!! Hamster is a side-scrolling action game where you control a hamster inside a hamster ball, making it run to reach the goal of each level.
It was developed and published by Tom Create, and released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Ikibago
Game.Overview:
Ikibago: The Caribbean Jewel is a color-matching game with a pirate theme. On the central window, lots of multi-colored barrels bob down the sea towards the right side of the screen, where an arrow is waiting to collect them. The main objective is to arrange columns of kegs by color, dragging and dropping them before they reach the arrow. At least three barrels of the same color must be aligned on the column before hitting the right side, otherwise the player loses a life.
There are boss battles, where rival buccaneers try to destroy the barrels with cannons, or send their henchmen to dance on the kegs locking them in place.
Special barrels appear on some levels. Unchained kegs can't be moved until they are unlocked with keys attached to other barrels. Ring barrels turn the whole column to gold.
The goal of each level is displayed at the start of each round, and usually is to collect a number of stocks (columns with three barrels) or superstocks (five barrels columns). Depending on the score, at the end of each stage the game unlocks one of the six extra modes. They are gameplay variations, with certain aspects removed or added to the story mode. For example, the classic mode has a series of continuous levels, and the endless mode has infinite lives.

Game.Name: IKOU: Intelligenztrainer fuer Kids
Game.Overview:
CAN YOU TRAIN INTELLIGENCE? Today we know that the nerve cords in the brain can be networked again and again through targeted stimulation and training. This is called "brain plasticity". Lifelong learning is also possible through this process. Since these training opportunities are even more pronounced in children than in adults, it makes particular sense here to systematically train mental performance as a prerequisite for successful learning. WHAT DOES THE CHILD PRACTICE WITH "IKOU"? The intelligence trainer trains the most important areas of general mental performance, which support and promote successful learning at primary school age. "IKOU - Intelligence trainer for kids" is based on an IQ test that is widespread in Germany, the HAWIK-IV (Hamburg-Wechsler intelligence test for children), which determines the academic performance of students in the 6 to 16 age group. With the intelligence trainer, the children train the basic skills that u. also be tested in the intelligence test: differentiated perception, logical thinking, working memory (short-term memory) and processing speed (rapid comprehension). For this purpose, the children in the program deal with ten different educational games.
THE STORY ABOUT THE INTELLIGENCE TRAINING: In addition to the squid called 'Grips', the IKOU kids also live on Gripsinsel. These have their headquarters at the top of a lighthouse that has 30 doors. In order for the player to get there, he must unlock all the doors. Once the "grip level" at the upper end of the lighthouse has been reached, he becomes a member of the IKOU kids and can have a real club button sent to him by post. Features:
Goal: Children can train their IQ in a playful way and without pressure Scientifically based exercises, 10 forms of exercise with increasing difficulty Intelligent Autoleveling: The level of difficulty automatically and imperceptibly adapts to the level of the player All exercises were developed by psychologists especially for children and are based on classic intelligence tests Child-friendly design and setting All exercises offer a strategy help button and a progress bar Multiplayer level for 2 kids on one console After half an hour of play, the system prompts the children to take a break Recommended by family & Co. From 6 years

Game.Name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Birds of Prey
Game.Overview:
Take back the skies!
Experience the rush of aerial combat as you engage in history's most iconic airborne missions. Annihilate your enemies as you launch into massive dogfights and aerial bombing missions. Battle for supremacy over stunning landscapes from the patchwork fields of Southern England to the smoking ruins of Stalingrad.
Battle hundreds of enemy aces for control of the skies in intense multiplayer dogfights and bombing sorties Choose a difficulty level to match your experience from adrenaline-fueled arcade action to realistic simulations Relive the golden age of military aviation piloting 13 classic aircraft through 42 death-defying missions

Game.Name: Illu-Logi VOW
Game.Overview: Illu-Logi VOW (also known as Iraroji Vow) is a logic puzzle game for the Nintendo DS, originally released in Japan on 24 May 2007. Developed and published by FromSoftware, the game is part of the "Illustration Logic" (Nonogram/Picross) genre, where players use numbers to fill in grids and reveal hidden pictures.

Game.Name: Illust Logic DS + Colorful Logic
Game.Overview: A DS Nonogram/Picross game from Hudson released in 2007 after they stopped using it's "puzzle Series" branding. It features both standard picross style puzzles and color based puzzles with a range of categories including puzzles that re-create sprites from classic Hudson games.

Game.Name: I Love Babies
Game.Overview: Have you always wanted to take care of a baby? This is your chance! Changing diapers, bathing, and feeding are all part of your daily chores as well as shopping, cooking, cradling your baby to sleep, dressing the little cutie or teaching him to crawl, stand and walk. Most of all, your baby needs your love to be really happy: lots of cuddles, playing and care taking will make him recognize you as his parent.

Game.Name: I Love Beauty: Hollywood Makeover
Game.Overview:
The Stars in Hollywood know where to go to make them look their best. Now you will too! Meet them all as youâ€™re styling their hair and applying the perfect lipstick and eye-shadow. Donâ€™t stop there, they need your help choosing the right accessories for a Hollywood movie premier. Does that necklace go with those earrings? Paint their fingernails to match their outfit for that perfect look for either the big night out on the Sunset strip or shopping on Rodeo Drive. Itâ€™s all up to you to decide. Get to know all of the famous stars and find out how they liked your job.
Features
â€¢ 36 different make-upsâ€¢ Test your skill in three challenging styling competitions in Contest mode.â€¢ Compete in 21 make-up & hair styling mini games with over 100 variations.â€¢ Choose the right accessories; earrings, necklaces, etc. for the best look.

Game.Name: I Love Horses
Game.Overview:
Welcome to the Ranch!
Explore the amazing world of Greenhill Ranch, home to championship horses. Discover 20 fun mini-games that let your teach, train and groom your horse. With the right training, you and your horse will take the crown at the big tournament. Life at the ranch has never been this much fun.
20 Amazing Adventures: Train, play with and care for your horses in 20 fun mini-games! Dash across raging rapids, play hide and seek, and even sing along with the Greenhill horse choir! Touch and Train: Interact with your horses through simple DS stylus controls! Capture the Memories: Photograph your horses and view the pictures in your photo album. Fun & Games: Navigate the obstacle course, tackle agility challenges and learn to do fantastic tricks as you develop a bond with your horse that can never broken.

Game.Name: I Love Puppies
Game.Overview:
Explore the amazing world of Puppyville. Experience 20 fun filled mini-games where you get to train, play with, and groom your puppies. With simple stylus controls you'll be raising show-worthy puppies in no time. Raising puppies has never been so fun and easy!
- 20 Amazing Adventures: Bathe and groom your puppies, play hide and seek, and more! - Touch and Train: Use the stylus to flick biscuits, play fetch and toss flying discs!

Game.Name: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
Game.Overview: Face surprising, dangerous and creepy challenges in order to take care of your camp Create your own character and use them to take on the jungle! Challenge your friends in multiplayer mode using the wireless function, prove that your king...or queen of the jungle! Play in adventure mode and take on all that the jungle has to throw at you pick your own challenges in arcade mode.

Game.Name: Imagine: Animal Doctor
Game.Overview: Another game in the Ubisoft's Imagine series of games that show female children and early teenagers the basics of some of the professions culturally assigned to women. This time the player assumes the role of a veterinarian and director of a veterinary hospital. You have the responsibility to diagnose and cure the animals that visit your hospital, but you can also play with them if you prefer. As a hospital director you can decide on things like who to hire or what equipment to buy, and even interact with the pet owners and their families. In addition, Animal Doctor can communicate with Petz HorseZ 2 and import horses to cure and train from this game.

Game.Name: Imagine: Animal Doctor Care Center
Game.Overview: Diagnose and treat a wide variety of animals that come through your hospital: dogs, cats, rabbits, foals, tiger cubs, pandas, even baby seals! Collect information on each animal to find their nutritional and health needs, every consultation is unique! Set up patients for regular check ups, like a real doctor, and use a variety of medical tools and devices to ensure their health

Game.Name: Imagine: Artist
Game.Overview:
Become a world famous artist! Learn to draw, paint, and create collages through various fun mini-games and lessons. Manage your budding career as you fulfill client commissions, attend events and more. Share your designs with the world by uploading them to the online Imagine Online Gallery where you can enter contests!
Features
â€¢ Draw, Paint, Create â€“ Learn a variety of techniques for drawing, painting, and collage through fun mini-games in color mixing, shading, and composition. â€¢ Live the life of an Aspiring Artist- Create beautiful works of art, maintain your studio and fulfill clientsâ€™ wishes as you build your reputation and your portfolio. â€¢ Share your Creations â€“ Upload your creations to your own virtual gallery on the Imagine Town website for your friends to see. â€¢ Art Made Easy â€“ Simple user interface will allow the player to create rich, detailed artwork using a handful of easy-to-use tools and techniques. â€¢ Nintendo DSi Compatible â€“ Use the Nintendo DSi camera to take a photo and incorporate it into your art.

Game.Name: Imagine: Babysitters
Game.Overview:
Be Everyone's Favorite Babysitter!
Babysit the neighborhood's adorable babies and you could be part of the town's new daycare! Develop a loving relationship with the babies and follow their growth and development as you help them learn new skills. Dress the babies in cute outfits then organize play dates with two babies in new multiplayer mode!

Game.Name: Imagine: Babyz
Game.Overview: Imagine Babyz is the first simulation game focused on caring for babies. Players take on the challenges of raising a baby throughout all stages of development and will also be able to take photos and exchange tips and clothing through a unique online component.

Game.Name: Imagine: Babyz Fashion
Game.Overview:
Youâ€™ve played with them and cared for them, now itâ€™s time to turn them into stars! Prepare for fashion contests, photoshoots, and runway lights. Choose the perfect outfit for each contest theme and coordinate accessories to match!
Features
â€¢Nurture and Care â€“ Care for and interact with adorable babies. â€“Feed them, play with them, and soothe them to sleep so they are the happiest babies. â€¢ Toddler Fashions â€“ Design one-of-a-kind tops, bottoms, and accessories to create a matching look from head to toe! â€“Customize the style, color, and fabric of adorable fashions for little boys and girls! â€¢ Nintendo DSi Compatible â€“ Take a picture of a real world pattern to incorporate in your designs for a unique look! â€¢ Make Them Stars â€“Show your model babies how to rock the runway shows and photoshoots as you select music and dance moves for them. â€“Enter to win fashion contests for great prizes!

Game.Name: Imagine: Ballet Star
Game.Overview: Ballet Star begins by allowing players to choose between three female characters each with their own unique personalities and dancing specialties. All three characters offer their own narrative arc, a feature that gives the game a moderate amount of replay value even if the game actually plays the same way no matter which character you choose. The ultimate goal for each of the three girls is simple, to become a professional ballerina by upgrading skills and competing in various ballet rehearsals and recitals every month.

Game.Name: Imagine: Boutique Owner
Game.Overview: Design unique gifts like flower bouquets, jewelry, and stuffed toys. - Help customers select the perfect gift for every occasion. - Add personal touches to each purchase to keep customers coming back!

Game.Name: Imagine: Cheerleader
Game.Overview: With the school's sports teams losing game after game, and no crowd support, the player, along with her best friend Sam, must do something about it! Together, the two start a cheerleading squad to help motivate crowds and cheer the teams to victory! In this rhythm-based memory/mimic game, the player goes head to head against rival cheerleading squads and test reaction times in increasingly difficult routines. As the team improves and gains fame, the player gets to grow the team and increase its membership to perform increasingly complex maneuvers required to match up with the cheerleading opponents! Throughout the adventure, the player can customize characters, outfits, hairstyles, and cheer styles, unlocking more options for each category through progress and currencies earned at the end of each cheerleading match. It is also possible to challenge other cheerleading squads to practice skills and prepare for the next big game!

Game.Name: Imagine: Detective
Game.Overview:
Live the thrill and adventure of being a teenaged private investigator fighting for truth and justice! Solve puzzling cases by playing through fun minigames and brain teasers. Use your wit to follow leads, discover clues, take photographs, question witnesses; itâ€™s up to YOU to solve the ultimate mystery! Become a Detective â€“ Play as Kirsten Spark, a smart and independent 14 year old student at Summer Hill High School. Use your sharp sixth sense and investigative skills to clear your school from bullies and your town from bandits.
Solve the Mystery â€“ Solve fun and intricate cases ranging from pure fun to brain teasers, all while gathering clues that will lead you to the ultimate mystery. - Follow leads and explore the town - Piece together clues in fun mini-games like Spot the Difference, Tangram Match, Fingerprinting, and much more. - Take photographs as events unfold - Question witnesses to find out who, what, when, where, and why
Social Networking on your DS â€“ Document all your findings in your own virtual blog! Gain popularity by solving mysteries. - Post the Who, What, Where, When, and Why on your blog and track your traffic. - Earn money from sponsors as you get more visitors to your site. - Customize your bedroom!

Game.Name: Imagine: Family Doctor
Game.Overview:
Become the Favorite Doctor in Town!
Become the new favorite doctor in town! Meet and care for patients as you learn about their symptoms and medical history. Diagnose them in fun mini-games, then provide proper treatment and prescriptions. Design a welcoming office for your patients to feel comfortable in. Then discover and defeat a mysterious virus that is plaguing the town!

Game.Name: Imagine: Fashion Designer
Game.Overview:
Another game in the Ubisoft's Imagine series of games that show female children and early teenagers the basics of some of the professions culturally assigned to women.
This time the player learns to be a fashion designer and a boutique owner. The process of creating a clothing line goes from designing the patterns and colors of the clothes, to choosing the make up and the hairstyle of the models, producing the catwalk shows and even directing the photo shoots for your portfolio.
In addition, the game allows sending your creations to other NDSs through the wireless connection.

Game.Name: Imagine: Fashion Designer: New York
Game.Overview: Play as a young fashion designer starting a career in a famous fashion agency in New York City. Discover the glamorous world of fashion and create trendy designs to become the hippest fashion designer ever.

Game.Name: Imagine: Fashion Designer: World Tour
Game.Overview:
Design the next big thing in fashion and travel the world to build it into a worldwide fashion label. Create unique fashion collections; even use the Nintendo DSi to take pictures and apply them to your designs! As a young designer, launch your international brand, open boutiques around the world, and design the hottest, most wanted fashion in the world!
Features
â€¢ Travel the World â€“ Promote your fashion brand all over the world as you set up runway shows, photoshoots, and celebrity endorsements â€“ Open boutiques in iconic fashion cities, promote your brand by taking part in local fashion events. â€“ Dress the hottest celebs in your designs and be seen on the red carpet. â€¢ Design your Brand â€“ Create a fashion collection under your own label. â€“ Choose your brand name and customize your own logo from a variety of fonts, backgrounds, and colors. â€“ Design amazing collections of different themes, you can even take pictures of patterns in the real world and apply them to your designs with the Nintendo DSi. â€“ Go shopping - Accessorize with shoes and jewelry, hats and purses. â€¢ Become a Fashion Expert â€“ Become a world famous fashion trends expert as you travel the world looking for the hottest fashions. â€“ Dress models all over the world, makeup, nails, hair, and fashion.

Game.Name: Imagine: Fashion Stylist
Game.Overview: Live the thrilling life of a fashion stylist. Express your creativity by finding the perfect outfits for your clients based on their specific requests and styles, whether preppy or elegant. Plus, run the greatest fashion mall in town by opening glamorous boutiques, working with celebrities, and organizing fashion shows. Become the Ultimate Fashion Expert: Find the perfect outfit for your customers based on their specific requests and tastes, whether preppy or elegant. Plus, stay fashion savvy by keeping tabs on the latest fashion trends in magazines. Expand & customize your very own Fashion Mall: Open new glamorous clothing, cosmetic and accessory boutiques. Unleash your creativity by arranging your fashion boutiques' shop windows and change your stores' styles. Run your Mall YOUR way! Stock boutique shelves with the trendiest brands and choose which it items to advertise in your mall. Plus, organize gorgeous fashion shows to entertain customers! Send items to the Imagine Town virtual world to continue your life as a fashion stylist: As you progress through the game, unlock codes for clothing items on ImagineTown, the Imagine virtual world site.

Game.Name: Imagine: Figure Skater
Game.Overview:
Another game in the Ubisoft's Imagine series of games that show female children and early teenagers the basics of some of the professions culturally assigned to women.
This time the player learns to compete in the world of artistic skating. You start by choosing one of the three characters available and train her until she becomes a champion. You can choose the hairstyle and clothes for your character and music and moves for your performances. The game is completed with a storyline that shows part of the life of the chosen skater out of the rin

Game.Name: Imagine: Gymnast
Game.Overview: Train in all types of gymnastic activities, such as the uneven bars, balance beam, and trampoline in Imagine Gymnast. Learn gymnastics under the instruction of Olympic Gold Medalist Shannon Miller Play through 12 chapters on your way to the World Championship Finals Compete in Vault, Balance Beam, Uneven Bars, Floor, and Rhythmic Gymnastics events Customize your look, routine and team Use the DSi camera to take a picture and use it to customize your own leotard!

Game.Name: Imagine: Ice Champions
Game.Overview:
Become a World Champion Figure Skater!
Ever dreamed of gliding across the ice as a professional figure skater? Now you can, with Imagine Ice Champions! Perform jumps, spins and skating combos on your Nintendo DS as you progress through competitions all over the world. Skate all the way to the grand championship finals and become a worldwide figure skating sensation!

Game.Name: Imagine: Interior Designer
Game.Overview:
Design your Dream Home!
In Imagine Interior Designer, you can design and decorate beautiful rooms! Express your creativity in a variety of workshops that let you design furniture, sew curtains, paint walls, create pottery, and more for your clients.

Game.Name: Imagine: Makeup Artist
Game.Overview:
Become an aspiring makeup artist! Start as an amateur and train yourself in different makeup techniques. Make your clients happy and beautiful by catering to their needs. Research the perfect looks, participate in contests and build your reputation as a professional makeup artist!
