Featuring dialogue from the films, players will experience the same cinematic thrills and excitement they witnessed in the award-winning film series. Whether longtime fans, or newcomers to the The Lord of the Rings saga, family members of all ages will undoubtedly enjoy the humorous, playful touch that TT Games has imparted upon this epic story.

Game.Name: Lemyuoul no Renkinjutsushi
Game.Overview: Remyuouru no Renkinjutsushi is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by OTOMURASOFT, which was released in 2013.

Game.Name: L' Enigmistica
Game.Overview: L'Enigmistica is a collection of traditional all-age puzzles, including hundreds of crossword puzzles, rebus puzzles, sudoku, and quizzes, as well as spot the difference, connect the dots, and coloring activities for younger players.

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Grundschule Englisch: Der Vokabeltrainer
Game.Overview: Lernerfolg Grundschule English Vokabeltrainer is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Tivola, which was released in Europe in 2010.

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Grundschule: Englisch: Klasse 1-4
Game.Overview: The successful CD-ROM series is finally available for the Nintendo DS! Based on 10 different topics, the player deals with the subject matter of classes 1-4. The player can decide for himself which class he wants to enter. Appealingly packaged in tasks, tests and games, all topics of the current syllabus of the respective class level are taken up. A clear structure, varied tasks and exercises, clear feedback combined with lovely illustrations and a cheerful atmosphere make practicing a lot of fun. USP * The two publishers Klett and Tivola complement each other perfectly in this series of learning software: Ernst Klett Grundschulverlag designs textbooks for classes 1 to 4 for the entire federal territory. Tivola is the most successful international children's software publisher in Germany: edutainment, knowledge and detective games on CD-ROM for children and young people are now exported to a total of 76 countries. - Tailored to the curriculum of classes 1-4 - Improves performance through targeted practice - Easy, intuitive operation - Varied exercise forms - Motivating atmosphere - 4 fun games await as a reward - 1st-4th Class

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Grundschule Konzentration Der Aufmerksamkeitstrainer
Game.Overview:
Increase your own performance in a playful way? Tivoli makes it possible! The basic prerequisite for successful learning is the ability to concentrate. More than a third of elementary school students have problems concentrating, some of which are considerable. Â»Learning success primary school concentration - the attention trainerÂ« for Nintendo DS specifically trains the child's ability to concentrate. With this title, Tivola expands the award-winning series of educational games with another edutainment hit that specifically avoids stressful situations and pressure to perform. Features:
First concentration trainer in the award-winning Nintendo DS edutainment series Designed under the supervision of the Society for Brain Training e.V. Hamburg Daily training (5 to 10 minutes) guarantees full concentration Real long-term fun with increasing difficulty Narrator supports reading-impaired students More than 1 million children are already practicing successfully with the "Learning Success" series
Playfully promote concentration
Which animals go well together?Increase concentration - anywhere and anytime With Â»Learning Success Primary School Concentration - The Attention TrainerÂ« primary school children can train their concentration in a variety of tasks - this noticeably improves attention and helps to absorb new learning content around school more easily. The game is colorful and attractively designed. Tasks are formulated clearly and simply. Difficulty levels that can be set at different levels enable the child to train individually. It plays at its own pace, so there is no pressure of time or performance.
The tasks are easy to solve at first, but gradually become more difficult over time. At the beginning there are ten different task types available, with good performance unlocking more exercises. Of course, Freddy, the popular learning vampire from the Â»Learning Success Primary SchoolÂ« series, shouldn't be missing. He guides you through the tasks and always has a helpful hint ready. In order to achieve a good ability to concentrate in everyday life, the children receive useful tips for a clear head. These tips relate, for example, to the topics of sleep, nutrition and exercise. tasks of all kinds The player either has the opportunity to master individual tasks without time and performance pressure, or to test his ability to concentrate in a 3-minute training session. In doing so, he encounters a wide variety of exercise forms, such as Â»ear sharpenersÂ«: Here the player sees a beautiful picture with different animals. Then a typical noise of the respective animal sounds and you have to tap the right animal on the picture with the stylus. With Â»TroubleshootingÂ«, on the other hand, you have two images in front of you that are inevitably the same, with a few errors having crept into the copy. Can the child find all the mistakes in the copied picture?
Rewards for good performance Thanks to the clear statistics, the player can track his progress in training at any time and is thus motivated to get even better. If you solve many tasks correctly, you will also get beautiful sticker motifs that you can stick in the virtual sticker book. This ensures a lot of collecting fun and makes Â»Learning Success Elementary School Concentration - The Attention TrainerÂ« an all-round successful edutainment game. The concentration trainer is recommended for use before homework. 5 to 10 minutes of daily training is enough to be fully concentrated.
Where are the mistakes hidden?

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Grundschule Mathematik Intensive Klasse 1-4
Game.Overview: Lernerfolg Grundschule Mathe Klasse 1-4 is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Tivola, which was released in Europe in 2008.

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Grundschule: Musik: Little Amadeus
Game.Overview:
Simply brilliant: playing the piano with Little AmadeusDiscover the world of sheet music with little Mozart In Â»Learning Success in Primary School Music - Little AmadeusÂ«, the pupils are introduced to the world of music. They learn to read music, tap rhythms and recognize instruments in a playful way with the cartoon character Little Amadeus, known from the children's channel (KI.KA), and his friends. If you consistently master the many different games, you can even play children's songs on a keyboard and compose your own pieces for up to five instruments. Thanks to the Nintendo DS stylus, every game can be operated very intuitively.
At the beginning of the game, the music novices find themselves in the Mozart city of Salzburg. There are many educational games waiting for you on the market square, in the grocery store or in the Mozart House. Together with the clever Little Amadeus you have to master all these games. The aim is to get hold of the valuable golden clefs. These keep unlocking new rooms, all the way to Hohensalzburg Fortress, in which a magnificent piano awaits to be played in a throne room. In this lovingly designed world, the player meets many characters from the well-known animated series, for example Sister Nannerl, the cheeky rat Monti or Little Amadeus' competitor Mario. Learning by doing Thanks to the many different games, the student gets a great insight into music theory. In doing so, it fills in missing notes, recognizes harmonic triads or traces notes on the touchscreen. In addition, there are numerous quiz questions about Mozart's musical world and a lot of information about the classical instrument families. In doing so, Tivola uses all the possibilities of the Nintendo DS optimally, so that an all-round successful learning experience can arise.

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Vorschule: Capt'n Sharky
Game.Overview:
Even little pirates have to go to school at some point! Luckily Captain Sharky helps with the preparation. In this game, the player learns how to deal with letters and numbers, trains his memory, practices dealing with money and plays small logic games. As a reward for successful learning, the player unlocks more and more levels and bonus games.
Features:
Playfully prepare for elementary school with Captain Sharky No reading skills required, as the game uses continuous voice output Children learn their first letters and numbers Memory and logical thinking are trained For all preschoolers from 4 years Based on the award-winning PC edutainment series Captain Sharky voice actors: Dirk Bach (German) and Fatih Ã‡evikkollu (Turkish)

Game.Name: Lernerfolg Vorschule: Prinzessin Lillifee
Game.Overview:
Even little princesses have to exchange the fairy wand for a pen and go to school. Luckily, Princess Lillifee and all her friends are helping preschoolers prepare for elementary school in a fun way. Learning numbers and letters, basic arithmetic and reading, even the first English terms are taught to the players in the most beautiful places in Princess Lillifee's palace garden. And practice pays off: the more the player gets right, the more levels and bonus games she unlocks.
Features:
Learning the first letters and numbers together with Princess Lillifee, Pupsi & Company Thanks to voice output, no reading skills are required Train memory and logical thinking For all preschoolers from 4 years Motivating atmosphere Varied forms of exercises

Game.Name: Les aventures de T'choupi Ã l'Ã©cole
Game.Overview:
It's back to school. T'choupi is going to school for the first time this year. It's a big event for him and his whole family! T'choupi is very excited at the idea of â€‹â€‹reuniting with his best friends with whom he will be able to learn, play and spend unforgettable moments. The school bag is ready, the sun is shining and breakfast is over: it's time to start a great school year!
T'choupi's adventures at school are 15 varied early learning activities that help develop the following abilities:
Address: Help T'choupi avoid obstacles and make the right choices, at home or on his bike! Memory: Assemble identical images, reconstitute models and learn from your mistakes so as not to fall into the same traps Thinking: Solve puzzles based on combinations of objects Observation: Analyze the environment and flush out hidden objects Listening: Work on your musical ear by reproducing the sounds of various instruments In addition, all the instructions are read aloud and underlined in writing and three levels of difficulty are available so that the game adapts perfectly to your child's age.

Game.Name: Les Incollables CE1 - CE2
Game.Overview: Les Incollables CE1 - CE2 sur DS contains a range of questions and answers intended to test the capacities of the youngest. With 3000 questions and as many answers, the title offers 18 different and original game modes, such as treasure hunts, timed games, highest score and even a multiplayer mode.

Game.Name: Les Incollables CM1 - CM2
Game.Overview: Les Incollables CM1 - CM2 on DS contains a range of questions and answers intended to test the capacities of the youngest. With 3000 questions and as many answers, the title offers 18 different and original game modes, such as treasure hunts, timed games, highest score and even a multiplayer mode

Game.Name: Les Incollables: CP
Game.Overview: Les Incollables CP is an edutainment game for Nintendo DS. The aim of the title is to stimulate neurons via mini-games and questions adapted to the level of children of 6-7 years old. The game contains more than 1200 exclusive questions with correction to learn while playing alone or with a friend via wi-fi.

Game.Name: Les Nouvelles Aventures de T'choupi et ses Amis
Game.Overview: The New Adventures of T'choupi and his Friends is a compilation of mini-games for toddlers on DS. In the countryside, by the sea or in the mountains, we find T'choupi in about fifteen colorful and easy-to-learn proofs. Many souvenir photos will reward the most skillful and persevering budding gamers.

Game.Name: Let's Create! Pottery
Game.Overview:
Let's Create! Pottery is a game about ceramics where the player gets to create his own pottery items. It is played with touch controls and the player uses his fingers to transform a lump of clay into a vase or similar ceramic object. Dragging up and down changes the height while dragging in or out affects the width of the part that is touched. Once satisfied with the form, the object is put into the oven for the baking process. The player can then afterwards paint the object in different colours or use brushes to draw lines.
The player gets orders from customers through an in-game inbox. These include an image of the objects that the player has to try and mimic. A star rating shows how close to original the player's object is. Once completed the objects can be sold on auction and the money that is earned can be used in the shop to buy new items. Items that can be bought include paint of different colours, brushes that allows for different patterns, materials and ornaments such as lids and handles. Players can upload their creations to a web based community portal where they can be rated by other players. The portal also features rankings and contests where players can compete.

Game.Name: Let's Draw!
Game.Overview:
Based on the popular Japanese book series that teaches kids how to draw by combining basic shapes, Letâ€™s Draw! offers a perfect mix of learning and entertainment. With more than 100 objects to draw and fun art related mini games, young players can learn to draw anywhere, at any time.
Features
â€¢ Portable art studio: Because Nintendo DS is a portable system, kids can enjoy drawing at any time, anywhere without the need for paper and crayons!â€¢ Touch and animate your pictures: Once a drawing is completed, touch it and bring it to life with animation and sound. Watch the elephant running, the rocket taking off, bird chirping, and more!â€¢ Kid friendly voice instructions: Even a small child who canâ€™t read yet can play by simply following the voice instructions throughout the menus and game.â€¢ Play fun mini games, with YOUR creations!: Play 10 fun-filled mini games such as â€œCar Racingâ€, â€œWhack-a-Moleâ€ or â€œAir Hockeyâ€ featuring the very characters youâ€™ve drawn.â€¢ Flex your creative muscles: Once youâ€™ve mastered your drawing skills in â€œLearn to Drawâ€ mode, itâ€™s time to unleash the creativity! Draw whatever you like! Once completed, each picture is stored in the Album for you to view later.

Game.Name: Let's Golf!
Game.Overview: Grab a club, take a swing and pray for a birdie! Discover a fun-filled experience accessible to anyone. Choose from 4 customizable characters and challenge 45 holes in 3 locations in full 3D: Fiji Beach, the English Countryside and the Scottish Lochs. Enjoy simple controls and even blow into the microphone to add spin to your ball. Take photos with the Nintendo DSi Camera to add them to your profile. Play Hot Seat Multiplayer with friends (on the same Nintendo DSi system) & see who's the best!

Game.Name: Let's! Mangaka DS Style
Game.Overview: Let's Mangaka DS Style is an Adventure game, developed and published by Columbia Music Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Let's Pilates!
Game.Overview: Increase your strength and flexibility, learn how to do Pilates and keep up with your training wherever you go. The game features 40+ easy-to-follow workouts to tone and strengthen your body and the ability to customize your routine to match your fitness goals.

Game.Name: Let's Play Ballerina
Game.Overview:
Lets Play Ballerina is a short and sweet story about Julia, a 12 year old girl just starting Ballerina school. She wants to become a famous Ballerina dancer. Along the way she meets Nathan, a boy she falls in love with, but Julia's rival Sofia tries to get both Nathan and the title away from her. Players have to help Julia work hard and get that promotion and possibly Nathan as well.
Learn different ballerina techniques in mini games. Learn steps by following the rhythm. Dance to earn points and get a promotion Buy Ballerina outfits and customize your look. Open up your own shop.

Game.Name: LET'S PLAY ENGLISH WORD WITH PICTURE
Let's Play Fashion Designer
Game.Overview:
Have a nice day! Welcome to Lets Play Fashion Designer, feel free to browse around and try a few things on.
In Lets Play Fashion Designer, the player plays a young fashion mad student. Her dream is to become one of the best know fashion designers in the business, and one day manage her own prestigious boutique.
Spurred on by her friends' enthusiasm, she decides to open up a local boutique. Little does she know that one day her boutiques will become bigger and better, until she has her own prestigious stores and collaborations with some of the greatest names in fashion.
Custom design necklaces, rings, bracelets, earrings, hats, and more to your customer's specification
Take care not to make mistakes. Features 12 Scripted missions with 3 to 5 clients per mission creating orders for accessories. Keep customers happy to unlock extra accessories. 15 creation workshops: necklaces, rings, bracelets, earrings, hats, etc View the Gallery containing your own personal creations.

Game.Name: Let's Play: Flight Attendant
Game.Overview:
Please place your luggage above your head, bring your seat to the upright position and fasten your seatbelt...
In Let's Play Flight Attendant, you could have the chance to serve a famous person in 1st class! Will it be a millionaire or a movie star?
- Put up your hair, choose your lipstick, color and dress yourself in your favorite uniform - Serve customers fresh drinks and tasty sandwiches - Show the passengers the safety instructions - Succeed and earn stars to become the best flight attendant!

Game.Name: Let's Play Garden
Game.Overview: Maintain and grow your very own garden from a lonely patch of grass to a lush environment teeming with activities in this simulation game for the Nintendo DS. Breathe life into your garden through multiple seasons by simply enjoying yourself in a series of fun and fast paced minigames. Along the way youâ€™ll expand your knowledge and learn fun facts about plants, crops and gardening. So, pick up your shovel and put on your gardening boots, itâ€™s time to put your green thumb to the test and have some fun!

Game.Name: Let's Play: Journalists
Game.Overview:
Get your camera ready and keep your note pad close by, its time to investigate the mysterious case of the missing animals!
- Use the dark room to process your photos and select the best pictures for your story. - Each day brings new missions and adventures for you to complete. - Collect evidence to find out who is stealing dogs and cats in your town. - Get the chance to interview interesting people who can help you on the case!

Game.Name: Let's Play Pet Hospitals
Game.Overview: Let's Play Pet Hospitals is a pet care simulation video game produced by Portuguese studio Biodroid Productions and published by Deep Silver for the Nintendo DS and Microsoft Windows. Let's Play Pet Hospitals is full of interesting facts regarding different kinds of pets and their specific needs. Animals which have either run away or been abandoned, and may therefore be undernourished, ungroomed, and sick, are brought to the pet hospital. There, the player will need to take care of them and find them new homes, or return them to their original owners. PC or Nintendo DS vets will receive money for successful treatment, advising customers, and thus finding good homes for the pets under their care. This money can be used to build new condos and improve the pet center, for example by painting the walls, renewing the flooring and purchasing new furniture, or even clothes for the player character.

Game.Name: Let's Play with Numbers! Magic Square and Image Calculation
Let's Ride!: Friends Forever
Game.Overview: Best friends forever! Every girl needs a best friend, and yours is your horse! Practice hard to perfect your riding and jumping skills as you prepare for the all-important regional jumping competitions. Go for the blue ribbon!

Game.Name: Let's Yoga!
Game.Overview: Let's Yoga makes it so easy to learn yoga that you'll feel like you have your very own personal instructor. You can set your DS down next to you and let the vocal instructions tell you exactly what to do, or just read the subtitles. If you're confused by how to do something, you can always rotate the image on the screen 360 degrees to see all angles of the pose. The vocal instructions will even tell you when to inhale or exhale or you can look at the flower symbols on the screen.

Game.Name: Letter Challenge
Game.Overview:
Test your brain with Letter Challenge! A fantastic collection of four of the best classic word games that will keep your gray matter busy for hours and hours!
Includes fast paced favorites like WordBlast and Pickletter and updated versions of Hangman and Wordfinder - the very best "pick-up-and-play" word games with "challenge mode" and over 100,000 words to that can even educate and take your word puzzle experience to a different level!

Game.Name: Lettriq: Ã‰valuez votre QI lettrique
Game.Overview:
The principle is simple. It is a question of composing words, of four letters at least, from those which are in your grid. So far all is well, we know how to do it, no problem. ;-) Where it gets tough is that the letters are distributed to you at random and the faster you compose your words, the faster they will arrive. If the letter grid is full, like in Tetris, it's lost. And believe me when you miss, for example, an "E." to finish your word it is anguish! Fortunately the game's dictionary accepts conjugate forms and contains around 450,000 words (including conjugations). If you make a spelling mistake the letters automatically return to the grid.
To help you in your difficult task, you can earn jokers, during challenges, which can replace any letter. These challenges take place every two minutes and if you answer them quickly enough you can earn two jokers. Be careful, they are not simple either. There are five kinds. For example, you may be asked to write a word, four or five letters long, but backwards.

Game.Name: Level 5 Premium: Gold
Game.Overview: This desirable collection contains demos of two Level 5 games Inazuma Eleven and Professor Layton and the Devil's Box and, most thrillingly of all, a totally original Layton side story. Professor Layton and the Holiday in London features the good Professor in his London office, reflecting on his worldwide adventures with Luke, and solving a dozen new puzzles in the process.

Game.Name: Level 5 Premium: Platinum
Game.Overview: Trial version software (Layton, Ni no Kuni & Inazuma Eleven 2) distributed free of charge at the Tokyo Game Show 2009 Level 5 booth.

Game.Name: Level 5 Premium: Silver
Game.Overview: Limited Edition DS cartridge, which featured the Tokyo Game Show 2007 demo of upcoming soccer RPG Inazuma Eleven. It also contains the side story in the Professor Layton series.

Game.Name: L'Histoire de France pour les Nuls
Game.Overview: If you are convinced that Napoleon Bonaparte is first cousin to Louis XIV and that Charles De Gaulle defeated the Ottoman Empire, L'Histoire de France pour les Dulls on DS is for you. Intended for an adult audience, this edutainment game composed of 4-answer MCQs allows you to review the basics of French history and to deepen each event to quench your inexhaustible thirst for knowledge.

Game.Name: Libera Wing
Game.Overview: Earth Union is the controlling force in the majority of outer space. Terror strikes when, unexpectedly, it loses connection with a number of its stations and rumours begin to spread of enemy ships approaching. Become the Captain of Libera Wing and save Earth Union from destruction in this Tower Defense-style action-strategy game. Your objective is to combine the right strategy, usage of items and abilities of your command ship. There are 36 story levels and 24 quickplay levels awaiting your leadership...

Game.Name: LifeSigns: Surgical Unit
Game.Overview:
LifeSigns is similar to Trauma Center medical games, but focuses more on the story and character development, almost like a soap opera. You play as Dr. Tendo, a second year intern at a hospital, performing surgeries on patients while at the same time balancing relationships with fellow doctors and nurses.
The gameplay for the surgery is a more step-by-step-style minigames, performing certain tasks during the surgery for it to be a success, but you also have to examine the patient beforehand to figure out the problem they are suffering from. Between surgeries, you also have to juggle romantic relationships with female doctors and nurses, saying the right things or buying them romantic items in order to succeed. You can also play mini-games like fishing and cooking to relieve stress from the hospital as well.

Game.Name: Lilpri DS: Hime-Chen! Apple Pink
Game.Overview: Lilpri DS: Hime-Chen! Apple Pink is an Adventure game, developed by Family Entertainment and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Lina no Atelier: Strahl no Renkinjutsushi
Game.Overview: Lina no Atelier: Strahl no Renkinjutsushi is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Gust, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Linda Hyde: Vampire Mansion
Game.Overview: A mix of Hidden Object and Adventure Missions in France , Switzerland, Spain, Italy and England 40 Hidden Object boards 5 additional mini-games(in several variations) Over 400 objects to find including about 35 special items to use

Game.Name: Line Rider 2: Unbound
Game.Overview:
Based off of the original flash game, this version is revamped for the home consoles with colorful graphics. Once again the player must draw a line on the screen and patch in missing sections to get the rider around on the level (40 total) to collect coins and make it to the end of the level with three different modes to choose from: Story, Puzzle and Freestyle.
The player uses their respective console's control to draw these lines: the Wii utilizes the Wii-remote, the PC version uses the mouse while the DS uses the stylus pen and the dual-screen capabilities.

Game.Name: Lingo Deluxe
Game.Overview: Let Lucille Werner take you to the world of Lingo. This Nintendo DS version of the popular game offers you as a player unprecedented possibilities to experience Lingo! Play the career mode and win several Lingo seasons to become the best Lingo player of all time. Features: - Test your knowledge of different dialects with the unique Lingo Dialects version - Dialects including Frisian, Gronings, Twents, Limburgs, Achterhoeks and Straattaal. - Very educational for children who learn to read and write. - A game suitable for the whole family. - 3 in 1: Lingo Original, Lingo for children and Lingo Dialect.

Game.Name: Lingo met Lucille Werner
Game.Overview: Lingo for NDS is the official adaptation of one of the most popular word based TV shows of all time. The game features Dutch show hosts Lucille Werner and JP. Enter a full Lingo season and guess the right words to build a reputation for yourself. Or play one of the more unique game modes to become the best Lingo player of all time.

Game.Name: Lingo voor Kinderen
Game.Overview: Lingo for Kids is the official adaptation of one of the most popular word based TV shows of all time, made suitable to be played by younger children. The game features Dutch show hosts Lucille Werner and JP. The word length and the words themselves are especially adapted to match the average vocabulary of children, without taking anything away from the challenge!

Game.Name: Link 'n' Launch
Game.Overview: Blast off to new heights of fun with a puzzler that is truly out of this world! In Link â€˜nâ€™ Launch, you must propel a rocket into space by flipping and rotating tiles to link fuel to the rocketâ€™s engines. In Mission Mode, you have just three minutes to reach the next planet, quickly linking tiles while keeping your rocket on course. Think your way around unmovable tiles and collect special tiles that upgrade your rocket or grant additional time. In Puzzle Mode, work out a path that will use up all the fuel and pipe tiles and clear the screen. With 100 puzzles to complete, it's a challenge of galactic proportions!

Game.Name: Lionel Trains: On Track
Game.Overview: The gameplay of Lionel Trains: On Track is very similar to Sid Meier's Railroad Tycoon series of computer games. In the game, you are the head of an unspecified railroad, and your objective is to connect different cities together through rail, using the funds you start off with, and later earn. There are several separate modes of gameplay, with varying objectives.

Game.Name: Lise no Atelier: Ordre no Renkinjutsushi
Game.Overview: Lise no Atelier: Ordre no Renkinjutsushi is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Gust, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Little Bears
Game.Overview: How sweet the little baby bears in the Zoo are-if only I could take one home with me! Now you can with Little Bears for Nintendo DS! Take your baby bear home and spend the whole day together. Feed, wash, play with and rock your baby bear to sleep and they'll love you forever! With Little Bears for Nintendo DS, you get to explore a whole world of activities for you and your Little Bear

Game.Name: Little Charley Bear: Toybox of Fun
Game.Overview: 15 exciting games and activities 3 levels: Easy, Medium and Hard to suit all ages Encourages the development of memory, logic, creative and problem solving skills

Game.Name: Little League World Series Baseball 2008
Game.Overview: The first officially licensed Little League video game to hit next-generation consoles. Players will bat, pitch and field their way from local sandlot slugger to Little League World Series Champion. Featuring eight U.S. and eight international teams, extraordinarily deep character customization, World Series Mode, and a variety of skill based challenges, Little League World Series offers an exciting, authentic baseball experience. Motion-sensing controls on the Wii make it accessible for Little League players and parents alike, while the DS version gives players the freedom to get on the diamond anywhere.

Game.Name: Little League World Series Baseball 2009
Game.Overview:
Step up to the plate and swing for the fences!
Players return to the baseball diamond with improved controls, more stadiums, more teams, new talents, new skill challenges and more fun than ever before!

Game.Name: Little League World Series Baseball: Double Play
Game.Overview:
Compilation of two baseball games; Little League World Series Baseball 2008 & Little League World Series Baseball 2009.
Players will bat, pitch and field their way from local sandlot slugger to Little League World Series Champion. Featuring eight U.S. and eight international teams, deep character customization, World Series Mode, and a variety of skill based challenges.

Game.Name: Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ
Game.Overview:
Something has gone terribly wrong in fairy tale land. It's up to Little Red Riding Hood to defeat twisted versions of fairy tale characters in Little Red Riding Hood's Zombie BBQ.
Choose from Little Red Riding Hood or legendary Japanese Hero Momataro, each with unique special moves. Defeat waves of zombies, ghosts, and more with simple touch screen controls! Take on undead versions of the Three Little Pigs, Pinocchio, Santa Clause and More.
Red Riding Hood is no damsel in distress! Take down twisted creatures with machine guns, shotguns, bombs, and more. Tackle your enemies in Story, Survival, and Boss Attack Modes.

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop
Game.Overview: Experience your favourite Littlest Pet Shop pets in a whole new way! Now you can enjoy Littlest Pet Shop on the go on your Nintendo DSi. Play catch with your pets and their favourite toys, dress them up in adorable new accessories, and keep them happy by brushing and feeding them treats! You can even throw a little dance party for your pets and help them rock out to cool songs!

Ten fun and challenging mini games are your petsâ€™ tickets to the big time. Practice makes perfect as you help your pets become the best gymnasts, models, ice skaters, dancers, flyers, fashion designers, and more. Then pack up their cute team uniforms and the dozens of super-fun accessories youâ€™ve customized because itâ€™s time to hit the road! The Biggest Stars competition is the event of year, when the pet-triplet judges look for teams that are a triple threat; cute, peppy and totally talented! Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Beach Friends
Game.Overview: The second edition of the LITTLEST PET SHOP video game brings the party to you with a new cast of quirky pets and their best friends. Venture on quests, deliver invitations, serve up ice cream, and style your pets as you get ready for the biggest LITTLEST PET SHOP party of the year. Plus no party is complete without a few special surprises!

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: City Friends
Game.Overview: The second edition of the LITTLEST PET SHOP video game brings the party to you with a new cast of quirky pets and their best friends. Venture on quests, deliver invitations, serve up ice cream, and style your pets as you get ready for the biggest LITTLEST PET SHOP party of the year. Plus no party is complete without a few special surprises!

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Country Friends
Game.Overview: Littlest Pet Shop: Country Friends features 2-player multiplayer wireless support via a Nintendo Wi-Fi connection. Collect all-new pets packed full of personality! Meet the Great Dane, the Peacock, the Collie, the Ladybug, and many more of your favorite pets. Now each pet has a best friend that helps them prepare for the party. Plus enhanced multiplayer features allow you and your real-life best friend to enjoy the fun together. An all-new story guides you along your journey as you play mini-games and accomplish tasks to get closer to the celebration. Style Out Your Pets - For the first time, you can design your own accessories and style out your pets in your own unique way.

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Garden
Game.Overview: Collect and name 20 pets - including brand new Fanciest, Cuddliest, Sportiest, Chilliest and more! Dress up your pets with over 100 accessories to make them even cuter. Explore 4 unique pet-sized worlds! Compete in mini games with your little pets to earn Kibble Coins! Play 16 fun and challenging games with your pets to unlock accessories, playsets, and new pets too!

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Jungle
Game.Overview: Littlest Pet Shop: Jungle stars the characters from the Hasbro line of toys of the same name. Players can play with each of the pets in a jungle environment. New pets can be unlocked by progressing through the game. Kibble Coins can be collected in mini-games to unlock accessories and dress up the pets in different outfits. The game includes 16 mini-games for a single player or with up to three other friends via a wireless connection. Mini-games include ball balancing, card match, coin toss, digging, swinging, and even flying in the clouds.

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Spring
Game.Overview: Collect 20 pets - including brand new Fanciest, Cuddliest, Sportiest, Chilliest and more! Dress up your pets with over 100 accessories to make them even cuter. Explore an all-new Spring world! Play 20 fun games and earn Kibble Coins to unlock accessories, playsets, and new pets too!

Game.Name: Littlest Pet Shop: Winter
Game.Overview: Collect and name 20 pets - including brand new Fanciest, Cuddliest, Sportiest, Chilliest and more! Dress up your pets with over 100 accessories to make them even cuter. Explore 4 unique pet-sized worlds! Compete in mini-games with your little pets to earn Kibble Coins! Play 16 fun and challenging games with your pets to unlock accessories, playsets, and new pets too!

Game.Name: Little Wingels
Game.Overview: Little Wingels is a miscellaneous game, developed by KRITZELKRATZ 3000 GmbH and published by dtp Young Entertainment AG, which was released in Europe in 2009

Game.Name: Live Battle Card: Live-On DS
Game.Overview: Live Battle Card: Live-On DS is a Strategy game, developed and published by Acquire, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Livly Garden
Game.Overview: Livly Garden is a Strategy game, developed by Brownie Brown and published by Marvelous Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Lock's Quest
Game.Overview: Build and battle in the ultimate construction combat game! Create and customize your own fortress with weapons and traps to help Lock defend his kingdom from evil Lord Agony and his clockwork invaders!

Game.Name: Lode Runner
Game.Overview:
This NDS release includes two full games from NES (Family Computer) platform:
Lode Runner Championship Lode Runner
Lode Runner release for Nintendo DS platform contains certain upgrades and differences to fit the gameplay on Nintendo DS handheld. Additionally, this release features some new gameplay modes not present in the original versions of included games.
The game idea is to control your character to collect lodestones on multi-story platform levels and dig holes to trap your enemies. Having collected all lodestones you can move up to the next level.

Game.Name: Logic Cubes
Game.Overview: Players start with a solid block of cubes marked with numbers on the end of each row. If the number five is marked on the end of a row of six blocks, for example, one of those blocks must be eliminated. But which one? Players must deduce the answer based on the numbers marked on other rows. Players tap a chisel to eliminate blocks they think donâ€™t belong or use a paintbrush to mark ones they think should stay. Once all the appropriate blocks have been chipped away, a fun object will be revealed. There are more than 350 objects to discover in the game.

Game.Name: Logic Island
Game.Overview: Logic Island is a compilation of mini-games that is in line with brain coaching software. The software takes us to Easter Island, where we will be chaperoned by one of the famous statues. It is indeed necessary to engage in a selection of activities requiring a good degree of logic and concentration. Logic Island offers a Story mode, a Versus mode and a training system.

Game.Name: Logic Machines
Game.Overview: Use your keen sense of logic and the Laws of Physics to solve brain teasing puzzles. Set forth on a quest to become a puzzle master! *screenshot captions) * 91 challenging levels of varying difficulty. * 15 different parts to utilize from. * Two modes of gameplay: Adventure and stimulating Challenge.

Game.Name: Lola's Alphabet Train
Game.Overview:
All aboard the learning train for a fun time! Specifically designed for 3-7 year olds, Lolaâ€™s Alphabet Train is a guaranteed way to keep your children coming back for more fun as they master their reading skills!
The Alphabet Train is actually five exciting games in one. As your childrenâ€™s skills improve, the games get more challenging, but still manage to be fun and engaging!

Game.Name: Lola's Fruit Shop Sudoku
Game.Overview: Lola Panda does it again - making the development of logical thinking skills into a fun activity! Now kids can enjoy the fun challenge of Sudoku in a form especially designed for them. Lolaâ€™s Fruit Shop Sudoku is suitable for kids up to the age of eight or nine!

Game.Name: Lola & Virginia
Game.Overview: Move in an environment without much constraints. Interact and discuss with many students and teachers. Contact individuals through a handy cellphone. Search, find, and open lockers to uncover items and collectibles. Rummage through piles of debris with the stylus to discover items and collectibles. Write, sew and trace with the stylus in many fashions. Use stealth within the school to avoid and confuse opponents. Jump rope using the stylus to have fun during recess. Try to give the best kiss possible when the opportunity arises.

Game.Name: LOL: Never Party Alone!
Game.Overview: LOL is the ultimate party game that allows playersâ€™ imaginations to run free. Since LOL has no rules, thereâ€™s nothing to limit a playerâ€™s creativity. The gameâ€™s concept is simple; the host thinks up a challenge for the other players and then everyone battles it out by drawing, picking, or writing the best answer. When everyone has finished and submitted their answers, voting begins. The one with the most votes wins! Remember, if the game is boring, then you are boring! Warning: No single player mode, Wireless DS Single-Card Download Play only. Up to 4 people can play with one LOL Game Card.

Game.Name: Londonian Gothics: Meikyuu no Lolita
Game.Overview: Londonian Gothics: Meikyuu no Lolita is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Megacyber, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Lone Wolf DS I: Flight From The Dark
Game.Overview:
LoneWolf DS is a gamebook for the NDS, a kind of interactive fiction/choose your own adventure RPG. They were novels which had a nice success during the 80's, and which were allowing the readers to choose their own path by jumping from one numbered section to another, with other nice ideas which were the precursors of what we find today in role playing video games. F. Calendini used the work from the Aon Project to adapt a Lone Wolf gamebook to the DS.
The philosophy behind the port of the Lone Wolf books to the DS is to let the console handle all the rules related to combats, stats and so on, so the player can be really immersed in the story and doesn't need to bother with the gameplay elements.
This adventure game is a conversion of the famous Lone Wolf gamebooks written by Joe Dever in the 80's (Book I from the Kai Series).

Game.Name: LonQ! Highland in DS: Puu Puu Seijin Arawaru!! Shukketsu Dai-service! Onara no Saiten SP
Game.Overview: LonQ! Highland in DS: Puu Puu Seijin Arawaru!! Shukketsu Dai-service! Onara no Saiten SP is a quirky Japanese Nintendo DS game, a spin-off from a TV show, known for its unusual title and focus on flatulence-themed comedy, developed by FromSoftware and released in 2008, offering a bizarre yet memorable experience.

Game.Name: Looksley's Line Up
Game.Overview: In Tales in a Box, discover a new slant on hidden-object games! Via clever use of the Nintendo DSi systemâ€™s inner camera, you can peer â€˜intoâ€™ the screen, tilting your head to view a scene from different angles, creating an impression of real depth. Journey through a fairy-tale world populated by characters from famous folk stories, and search each themed diorama by looking around from all angles to find hidden letters and objects. As you collect letters and objects, you will meet new characters and form words that will open new stages with even more hidden items to find. Some stages contain secret pictures, testing your observation skills even further. Players of all ages will be amazed by this unique visual spectacle, where a simple-looking picture can reveal a whole world of stories, if you just know where to look!

Game.Name: Looney Tunes: Cartoon Conductor
Game.Overview:
Looney Tunes: Cartoon Conductor (known as Looney Tunes: Cartoon Concerto in Europe and Australia) is a Nintendo DS game developed by Amaze Entertainment and published by Eidos Interactive.
The Tasmanian Devil has gone berserk in the old Looney Tunes cartoon archives, and all the classic shorts have had their music mangled! It's up to the player to recompose the music on these classics before the public notices the damage.
Cartoon Conductor is a rhythm-music game that puts the player in the role of a conductor. The player must use sweeping stylus motions to "conduct" the classic music as the cartoon plays on the top screen and reacts to the player's abilities. The game features classical music, including selections from Beethoven, Rossini, and Wagner, and cameos all the famous Looney Tunes characters such as Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Yosemite Sam, and Porky Pig, and more.
As the game progresses, players can unlock new songs (including techno remixes), expert difficulty modes, and trivia about the songs and the original cartoons.

Game.Name: Looney Tunes: Duck Amuck
Game.Overview:
Duck Amuck
Looney Tunes: Duck Amuck lets players wield the Nintendo DS stylus to irritate, aggravate and infuriate their own Daffy Duck in humorous ways. In the game inspired by the classic Duck Amuck cartoon, players will compete against Daffy through a series of mini-games that range from retro inspired favorites to modern, innovative gameplay interactions, with the goal of driving Daffy's temperature, and his temper, through the roof. Looney Tunes: Duck Amuck will also feature wireless game play allowing players to not only gang up on Daffy as a team but also battle each other in head-to-head competition.
Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer-drive Daffy nuts anytime, anywhere in the only game where you actually interact with the one-and-only Daffy Duck.
Daffy's goal is to outdo you. It's your job to outdo the Duck-use your stylus to trick, taunt and tease Daffy until you send his temperature meter through the roof.
Engage your friends in outrageous Duck wars through Nintendo Wii and DS connectivity.
Be despicable! Progress through a huge variety of mini games ranging from retro favorites to all-new experiences. As you do better, he gets madder until he can't take it anymore!
A completely original gaming experience custom made for the DS and the Daffy Duck character! Where previous handheld character interaction games have focused on care-giving, Duck Amuck plays like an interactive cartoon.

Game.Name: Loopop Cube: Loop Salad DS
Game.Overview:
As a genre, it will be a side-view type puzzle game. Press the colorful blocks that disappear when you stick three of the same color together, and clear the stage by erasing all the blocks on the screen. It's an easy-to-attach work that anyone can quickly learn the rules, as if adding the characteristics of Sokoban and Puyo Puyo.
The most distinctive feature is the world view and direction. This game consists of one story with several stages of game parts, the first episode is a cake maker, the second episode is the South Pole where penguins live, and the theme scenes change, but each The background, the clothes of the main character, and the music will change in line with the story.

Game.Name: Los Lunnis: En Busca del Libro Magico
Game.Overview: The magic book of the witch Libina has disappeared. Follow Lucho in this fantastic adventure and play with all the famous characters from the TV series. Explore the wonderful world of Luna Lunera and enjoy with each and every one of your favorite characters, to the rhythm of the music of Los Lunnis.

Game.Name: Lost Identities
Game.Overview: Teenagers are disappearing without a trace, only to reappear with new personailities. FBI agents Derek and Alice begin with their investigation and are soon caught up between the government, FBI, and pharmaceuticals giant BioPharmaka. Time is running out... * Investigate atmospheric locations * Question witnesses, suspects, and victims * Features numerous puzzles and minigames: Hack into computers, break open doors, decrypt files...

Game.Name: Lost in Blue
Game.Overview: Lost in Blue lets you follow a girl and a boy who are stranded on a seemingly uninhabited island. While planning their escape, the two learn survival skills, such as hunting, gathering food, and building tools. You can play the game first as the boy, and then play as the girl for a completely different experience. To survive in this adventure, you'll need to learn how to share responsibilities with your partner.

Game.Name: Lost in Blue 2
Game.Overview: Washed ashore after their cruise ship goes down at sea, young Jack and Amy must struggle to survive as they search for a way off a deserted island. The teens must confront their worst fears as they discover the secrets and dangers that lurk behind every corner of the mysterious island.

Game.Name: Lost in Blue 3
Game.Overview: Lost in Blue 3 marks the return of the original survival adventure game for Nintendo DS. Guide on of four playable characters, each with their own hidden past and unique strengths, through exotic locales on a mysterious island while surviving the elements to stay alive. Work alone or cooperatively with other characters to gather food, explore the island, and hunt dangerous wildlife.

Game.Name: Lost Magic
Game.Overview: LostMagic is an action RPG set in a mysterious realm where monsters wield unimaginable power and the fate of the universe is held together by seven magical wands. As a wizard in this realm, the player will use the stylus to unleash magic spells and command numerous monster squads in magical battles.

Game.Name: Love Is... ...in Bloom: The Flower Shop Garden
Game.Overview: Full of the same endearing charm as the original cartoons you get to work on a blossoming relationship as well as a growing business. Twelve varied and unique arcade-style games provide fun, long-term challenges. Build your own floral empire. Starting from the very first seed and building up, upgrading the garden and stocking the shop to supply made-to-order bouquets to the public.

Game.Name: Lovely Lisa
Game.Overview: Lovely Lisa helps younger girls learn the importance of having fun and working hard while finding their own fashion style! Earn Lisa-points by perfecting beauty skills & techniques and helping out around the house. Prove you've got what it takes in the Heart Hills pageant. Only the girl with the best skills in all categories can win - after all, beauty is only skin deep!

Game.Name: Lovely Lisa and Friends
Game.Overview:
Lovely Lisa helps younger girls learn the importance of having fun and working hard while earning your way to your own fashion style! Earn Lisa-points by perfecting your beauty skills and techniques, helping out around the house and even learning what it takes to become a successful career girl! Providing a well-rounded approach to beauty and fashion, Lovely Lisa rewards girls with gorgeous accessories, original clothes and fabulous hairstyles and make-up! Prove youâ€™ve got what it takes in the Heart Hills pageant-with-a-difference! Only the girl with the best skills in all categories can win â€“ because after all, beauty is only skin deep!
Features
â€¢ Fashion Sense: Polish nails and add your own touch with sparkly accessories, apply make-up and coordinate with the perfect hair style! â€¢ Design and customize! Use the Nintendo DSi Camera to snap shots and customize Lisaâ€™s outfits! â€¢ Mini-games: Dance your socks off in the idol game or learn to play the piano â€¢ Family values: Help mom with shopping and cooking or even help dad to put furniture together! â€¢ Learn valuable career skills: From babysitting and cake decorating to nursing or even practicing to be a flight attendant!

Game.Name: Love Plus+
Game.Overview: While Love Plus spans the autumn and winter term, Love Plus+ will pick up at the summer term. Go on vacations, mountain climbing and all sorts of summer activities with the three girls. This game is around 2 times as big as the last game, so there would be more events and dates.One of the greatest draw of this second installment is that the girls will learn to call your name even when you change your name from the default. Those who have beat the last game, import your data into this game and enjoy the bonus events.

Game.Name: LovePlus
Game.Overview: LovePlus (ãƒ©ãƒ–ãƒ—ãƒ©ã‚¹ Rabu Purasu) is a dating sim developed and published by Konami for the Nintendo DS handheld video game console. It was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends
Game.Overview:
Hello Kitty returns to help out her friends any way she can in Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends. She can now help her friends out in the shopping mall and even help with their homework. Take Hello Kitty shopping, decorate her room, and choose her clothes. Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends features all of Hello Kittyâ€™s best friends.
Play with Hello Kitty and her friends over five distinctive areas, including Hello Kittyâ€™s room, the shops, the food court, and playing with Hello Kittyâ€™s friends. In Hello Kittyâ€™s room you can customize furniture, clothing, and accessories. At the shops you can put on unique uniforms, play fun mini-games, and help out Hello Kittyâ€™s friends. In the food court you can work to earn Puro (the in-game currency), and play more mini-games based on the shop you choose to work in. You can then use the Puro youâ€™ve earned to purchase goods and visit Hello Kittyâ€™s friends.

Game.Name: L: The Prologue to Death Note: Rasen no Wana
Game.Overview: L: The Prologue to Death Note - Rasen no Wana is an Adventure game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Lucky Luke: The Daltons
Game.Overview:
Lucky Luke: The Daltons is a collection of mini-games based on the famous comic franchise Lucky Luke and sequel to Go West: A Lucky Luke Adventure.
The Dalton brothers have managed to escape their prison. Using Ma Dalton's map (which was actually upside down), they get to the wrong direction and get lost in the desert. In their hallucination, they see Ma Dalton as she tells them what to do to get out of their hallucination...
There are 6 language players can choose: English, French, Spain, German, Italian and Dutch; three game modes: The Great Escape, Party time and Arcade Mode. Players use the stylus or the control pad for each part of the game, depending on what the game demands. The game supports multi-player with up to four people.
Mini-games include racing, platforming, puzzle, shooting and cards segments among others.

Game.Name: Lucky * Star: Moe Drill
Game.Overview: Lucky * Star: Moe Drill is a Quiz game, developed by Opera House and published by Kadokawa, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Lufia: Curse of the Sinistrals
Game.Overview: The Sinistrals, the four legendary harbingers of doom, are out to resurrect the ultimate evil and bring the world to its knees. It's up to the fiery monster hunter Maxim and his eclectic band of adventurers to put a stop to them once and for all. Their adventures will take them across an expansive world packed with dangerous enemies, powerful items, and diabolical puzzles!

Game.Name: Luminous Arc
Game.Overview: Protect the Light, Condemn the Dark! A Millennium of peace is about to be torn asunder by the spread of darkness. A war with the Witches 1,000 years ago nearly destroyed the planet, and now they have returned. Character Designs by Kaito Shibano, music from Yasunori Mitsuda, and solid storylines combine to give Tactical RPG Fans the kind of portable gaming experience they've been craving! Take the battle online! Fight your friends over the Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection! Luminous Arc's versatile controls allow you to choose between +Control Pad and left/right-handed stylus controls!

Game.Name: Luminous Arc 2
Game.Overview: More Strategy, More Witches, More Fun! As the threat of a rogue Witch looms over Carnava, the Queen calls upon the Magic Association to save the land. Beautiful hand drawn graphics and a stunning score from Yasunori Mitsuda's Procyon Studio combine with multiplayer support to create the must-have strategy RPG of the year! "Engagement" System - Gain potent Witch powers with this intriguing new tactical feature. Refined Mechanics - Upgraded interface, polished touch controls, and rebalanced gameplay.

Game.Name: Luminous Arc 3
Game.Overview: The Royal Kingdom of Saint Bardia had been in peace for a thousand years. People thank the Holy Knight Anogia and the legendary Holy Witch Sylvia, which saved the world once. A war between humans and the Felicias (a species of fairy) has started. They fight for the power of Eyes that provides magical powers.

Game.Name: Lunar: Dragon Song
Game.Overview: Through the Darkness find the Light! When The Legends of Dragons were first born, an age of darkness descended on the world of Lunar. Join the untried hero Jian and his friends on their journey to save Lunar from the powerful forces of evil.

Game.Name: Lunar Knights
Game.Overview: Descend into the gothic Sci-Fi world of Lunar Knights and take control of two warriors on a quest to reclaim the world from the vampiric legion. Spin together tornados, guide down flaming meteors, and blow together snowstorms in Kojima Productions first ever title on Nintendo DS!

Game.Name: Lupin Sansei: Shijou Saidai no Zunousen
Game.Overview: Lupin Sansei: Shijou Saidai no Zunousen (ãƒ«ãƒ‘ãƒ³ä¸‰ä¸–ã€œå²ä¸Šæœ€å¤§ã®é ­è„³æˆ¦ã€œ?) is a Japan-exclusive 2D stealth/action video game based on the popular Monkey Punch characters. It was developed by Nex Entertainment and published by Namco Bandai Games, which was released in 2010.

Game.Name: Luxor: Pharaoh's Challenge
Game.Overview:
Embark on a thrilling adventure through the lands of ancient Egypt in the latest installment of the hit LUXOR series. Enjoy 88 gorgeously-rendered levels of brilliantly crisp and stunning graphics portraying pyramids, temples and many more of Egyptâ€™s amazing marvels. Guide your mystical winged-shooter, swooping back and forth, as you destroy an onslaught of magical spheres before they reach the pyramid lying at the end of their path. To help eliminate enemy spheres, LUXOR: Pharaohâ€™s Challenge features more explosive power-ups than ever before!
Prove your expertise by earning 25 spectacular skill badges Ranking system progressively increases power-up effectiveness 13 powerful blessings can be activated to make any level manageable

Game.Name: Lux-Pain
Game.Overview: Lux-Pain is set in the historical Kisaragi City, a town plagued by mysteries from small mishaps to murders - with no logical explanation as to why these events occur. It seems "Silent", a worm born through hate and sadness, has infected humans and forced them to commit atrocious crimes. Atsuki's parents are the victim of such crimes. To avenge his parents, Atsuki goes through a dangerous operation to acquire Lux-Pain in his left arm, a power so strong that it turns his right eye golden when using it to seek and destroy Silent for good.

Game.Name: Mabeop Cheonjamun DS
Game.Overview: Nintendo DS Chinese character education software game released in Korea in 2009. This is a game that allows you to study Chinese characters by writing them directly using the touch screen, which is one of the features of Nintendo DS. Two years later, the sequel, Magic Cheonjamun DS 2, The Last Chinese Character Magic, was released.

Game.Name: Mabeop Cheonjamun DS 2 - Choehuui Hanja Mabeop
Game.Overview:
A Hanja educational training game (a writing system that incorporates Chinese characters into the Korean language) that released only in Korea for the Nintendo DS. A sequel released two years after the first game ('Magic Hanja 1000 DS'), it received a lot of reviews compared to its predecessor.
The story is based on the contents of the comic book 'Magic Thousand Characters, an educational series based on the original Chinese novel 'Journey to the West'. It covers the events of volumes 10 through 20, but since the game was released before the 19th and 20th volumes came out, the content is completely different from the original comics.

Game.Name: Machi no Pet-Ya-San DS 2: Wannyan 333-Hiki Daishuugou!
Game.Overview: Machi no Pet-Ya-San DS 2: Wannyan 333-Hiki Daishuugou! is a Simulation game, developed by Infinity and published by E-Frontier, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Machiteba Tengoku! Makereba Jigoku! Ryoutsuryuu Ikkakusenkin Daisakusen!
Game.Overview: Machiteba Tengoku! Makereba Jigoku! Ryoutsuryuu Ikkakusenkin Daisakusen! is an Action game, developed and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Madagascar
Game.Overview: Based on the highly anticipated, star-studded animated feature film from DreamWorks Animation, Madagascar is the only console game that lets players enter the world of four hilarious Central Park Zoo animals--a personality-packed crew made up of a lion, zebra, giraffe, and hippo--and their crafty penguin sidekicks. Players must master each animalâ€™s natural skills while adventuring through the exciting city of New York and the dangerous island of Madagascar, interacting with other animals and tackling obstacles and enemies in scenarios from the movie and beyond.

Game.Name: Madagascar 3: The Video Game
Game.Overview: In Madagascar 3: The Video Game, adventure with the entire cast of Madagascar including Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Gloria the Hippo and Melman the Giraffe while you find a way home under the perfect cover: a traveling circus. Travel across Europe to promote the circus by completing missions, performing amazing publicity stunts, and dazzling the crowd with a mini-game based circus extravaganza!

Game.Name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
Game.Overview:
Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa DS is a third-person action-platformer based on the movie of the same name.
All of the Madagascar characters are available for play, including Alex, Gloria, Melman, and the giant Moto-Moto, each with their own unique moves. Players explore the African savanna, climbing, jumping, swimming, confusing tourists, finding monkeys, and collecting items along the way.
The game also includes various minigames, into Mort's Pinball and a humorous sidescrolling, teamwork game featuring the four plotting penguins from the film.

Game.Name: Madagascar Kartz
Game.Overview:
Madagascar Kartz is a racing game based on DreamWorks Animation's Madagascar. It was released on October 27, 2009 and the second game on Madagascar's spin-off series.
Gameplay:
The game is a basic kart racing game, and the player can perform jumps, flips, rolls. There are many different stages from scenes of the franchise. Playable characters include Alex, Marty, Gloria, Melman, King Julien, Mason and Phil, or all four of the penguins. The Madagascar Kartz Wheel is bundled with the Wii version of the game. This wheel is optional. This wheel's look is different from that of the Wii Wheel from Mario Kart Wii.
Playable characters include Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe, Gloria the Hippotamus, The Penguins, The Chimps, and King Julien from the Madagascar. Two characters from other movies are included alongside the Madagascar, Shrek from Shrek, and B.O.B. from Monsters vs. Aliens, all DreamWorks Animation franchises. Race types include Quick Race, Championship, Time Trial and Checkpoint race. A Championship race is one where the player collects mangoes and tries to finish first place in order to unlock higher speed classes (50cc, 100cc, 150cc, 200cc, the last one is raced in reverse direction/mirror mode), more karts and tracks. In Time Trial, players beat their own times and earn medals (gold, silver and bronze). In Checkpoint Race, players collect as many hourglasses as they can before the time runs out. There are several tracks in the game. Also, in a track, most tracks have 2 shortcuts. "I Like to Move It", sung by Reel 2 Real, is the menu theme. The game's gameplay is similar to those of Mario Kart Wii, by Nintendo. The sequel is Super Star Kartz.

Game.Name: Madden NFL 06
Game.Overview: The Madden NFL Football franchise has revolutionized its passing game--Madden NFL 06 has the most groundbreaking offensive arsenal ever created. The new QB Vision Control lets you scan the field, look off defenders, and make perfect throws. Take a collegiate All-Star to All-Pro status in the new NFL Superstar mode. Be a legend with Madden NFL 06, the only licensed NFL experience.

Game.Name: Madden NFL 07
Game.Overview: Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2007! Use all-new Touch Screen controls to perform special moves, draw Hot Routes, and take command of your command. Read opposing formations, then use voice recognition to call audibles on both sides of the ball. Drag-and-drop defensive assignments before the snap with the all-new Offensive Playmaker feature. The NFL comes to life with improved graphics and highly-detailed stadiums for every team.

Game.Name: Madden NFL 08
Game.Overview:
Shrewdly judging talent is a key to success.
Feel what it's like to be a field general making key personnel decisions on both sides of the ball during the gameâ€™s biggest moments in Madden NFL 08. Quickly identify your strongest players on the field before every snap, then move them into position to make game-changing momentum-altering plays. Play to your teamâ€™s strengths by immediately reading your opponentâ€™s schemes and reacting to the action as soon as the ball is snapped. Create mismatches and exploit weaknesses as you read and react with Madden NFL 08.

Game.Name: Madden NFL 09
Game.Overview:
Prove You Can Win on the Road
Celebrating 20 Years of Innovation, Madden NFL 09 delivers its most fun and exciting football package ever for the DS, combining Wi-Fi multiplayer games and Rec Room mini-games with all-new EA SPORTS Family Play, featuring an easy-to-use game control system.

Game.Name: Madden NFL 2005
Game.Overview: The Madden series is coming to a brand-new platform, complete with wireless gameplay, dual screens, and multiple gameplay modes. In the DS version of Madden NFL 2005, you can use the touch screen to select plays, call audibles, and manipulate the kicking meter. The DS's lower screen shows you where all 22 players are on the field. In addition to a wireless multiplayer mode, the game features a season mode, a situation mode, and a two-minute drill mode.

Game.Name: MAER Heaven: Boukyaku no Klavier
Game.Overview: Mar Heaven: Boukyaku no Clavier is a Role-Playing game, developed by Alpha Unit and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: MAER Heaven: Kaldea no Akuma
Game.Overview: Mar Heaven: Karudea no Akuma is a Role-Playing game, developed by Alpha-Unit and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Maestro! Green Groove
Game.Overview:
You like music? You like platforms? You like the jungle? Then you'll love "Maestro! Green Groove"!
So jump in and enjoy this wonderful feeling of being a virtuoso using your heart, stylus and voice! Everything you do is music, EVERYTHING! Hit the spiders to play some drums, shoot the fruit to bring out the melody, pinch the strings to play the tune...
Challenge the mischievous Staccato the Spider in a battle in which the most talented one will win!

Game.Name: Maestro! Jump in Music
Game.Overview: Discover Presto, the music-loving bird, and make him evolve in a colorful, decibel-filled journey. Use the stylus to scrape, rub, tap and whirl to the rhythm of the level's music and like a good Maestro, stick to the original. Presto will jump or get off a platform in the order in which you strum the string, flying with his small wings to reach the music score.

Game.Name: Mage Knight: Destiny's Soldier
Game.Overview: The year is 435 Tz, and every faction in the Land is at war, and if it continues there won't be much Land left to fight over. The strain on the world's magical energy is literally tearing the Land apart. The Land's fate lies in your hands. You must fight hard and earn the respect of all the races of the Land, and together you must fight to keep the Land alive. Travel the Land earning respect points by battling small armies that you'll find along your journey, and eventually work your way up to all out war. The more respect points you gain, the more inclined warriors will be to join your army.

Game.Name: Magical Diary: Secrets Sharing
Game.Overview:
Write your Diary with this amazing software for Nintendo DSi and Nintendo 3DS!
Use the amazing Magical spells to add life to your pages!
Once you selected a word or a sentence, you can apply a funny, sad or other animation that will show up when the text is touched. Easy way to express your feelings!
And there is more!
Many stickers to decorate the pages, various paper designs for the layout, different font colors, customizable covers, emoji, etc
A mysterious Capsule Machine is also present!
After writing in your Diary, you receive tickets and can use them with the Capsule Machine in order to unlock new items to decorate your pages.
Exchange Diaries with friends with the Wireless Communications!

Game.Name: Magical Michael Pang
Game.Overview: Pang: Magical Michael is a dual-screen update to classic Pang games. It retains the classic gameplay, but with new power-ups and level elements thanks to the two screens. There are also new powers and all new levels and locations. The traditional Pang safari kids have been replaced with a faceless magician.

Game.Name: Magical Starsign
Game.Overview: The students of Will O'Wisp magical academy have a little problem: Their teacher has mysteriously disappeared. After commandeering a handful of rockets to rescue her, they've wound up on a strange (and sometimes scary) adventure through outer space. Now players must rescue both their classmates AND their teacher - and just maybe the whole solar system while they're at it. Explore strange planets. Players see the sights of this strange, sci-fi fantasy setting as they uncover the secret behind their teacher's disappearance in this epic role-playing game. The stylus controls everything, from combat to conversations to outfitting allies. Simple controls make it easy to play but a challenge to master. Players can link up wirelessly with five friends and explore the amigo dungeon together - they'll find unending challenges and incredible rewards as they delve into the depths of this unique multiplayer experience.

Game.Name: Magical Whip: Wizards of the Phantasmal Forest
Game.Overview:
The two apprentice wizards have become lost amid a tangled sea of trees: the Phantasmal Forest, a dark, dangerous place ruled by monsters that bewitches people with its strange power. The wizards can only use a single spell â€“ one that turns their wands into a magical whip!
Defeat enemies and collect valuable items as you battle your way through the forest in this exciting action game. You can select either the male or female wizard, then use their magical whips to capture enemies and defeat them.
Your magical whip doesnâ€™t do much damage on its own, but with combos, it becomes a powerful weapon capable of defeating a mighty dragon with a single strike. Combos are performed by capturing a falling enemy with your magical whip and using it to attack other monsters.
Can the wizards escape the evil forest before they become lost forever within its darkness?

Game.Name: Magical ZhuZhu Princess: Carriages & Castles
Game.Overview: All new Zhu Zhu Princess characters 40+ levels of exploration All new Zhu Zhu locations Collect treats to keep your Zhu Zhu happy All new accessories, including awesome carriages, castles, and brand new outfits

Game.Name: Magical Zunou Power!! DS
Game.Overview: Magical Zunou Power!! is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Magic Cheongkeuwa
Game.Overview: Maejig Cheongkeuwa Mabeobui Seong is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by BarunsonCreative, which was released in Korea in 2011.

Game.Name: Magic Encyclopedia 3: Illusions
Game.Overview:
The Magic Academy has been attacked by a powerful illusion spell, making reality much more than it really seems! Help Catherine save the school in this exciting hidden object adventure game full of visual trickery. Show your courage, remove the spell from the Magic Academy, and return everything to normal once again in Magic Encyclopedia 3: Illusions!
GAME FEATURES: â—‡ Exciting new worlds to discover â—‡ Unbelievable graphics â—‡ Interesting mini-games â—‡ Great in-game music player â—‡ Beautiful wallpapers

Game.Name: Magic Encyclopedia II: Moonlight
Game.Overview: After Professor Fobros goes missing from the Magic School, it's up to Katrina, and her brother Roger, to find him. Discover Professor Fobros' terrifying secret, as you travel around the world in this exciting Adventure game. Unravel an ancient mystery as you piece together a powerful amulet in Magic Encyclopedia 2: Moonlight. Can you solve the tricky puzzles and master the minigames in order to find the professor?

Game.Name: Magician's Quest: Mysterious Times
Game.Overview: As players attend Magic Academy, they'll be immersed in a living, breathing world where time flows as it does in the real world, and each week, player's wizardry skills are put to the test in a new magical adventure. Custom avatars can be made with 1,500 varieties of clothing, furniture and characters to choose from. Additionally, players can learn new magic spells and abilities by forming different bonds with the 150 unique characters populating the world. Different stories and adventures will be revealed depending on what bonds are formed with the game's characters and how the player chooses to solve each of the 52 adventures. Use more than 100 magic spells to become the greatest magician of all time!

Game.Name: MagicQ DS
Game.Overview: MagicQ DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Studio9, which was released in Korea in 2007.

Game.Name: Magnetica
Game.Overview: Marbles are exclusively controlled by the stylus in this title that satisfies even the strongest puzzle addiction. Marbles are rolling relentlessly down a twisted track toward you. Stop them by launching launch new marbles with your stylus. When three or more like-colored marbles match up, they vanish. Tons of power-ups, multiple tracks and a great multiplayer mode make Magnetica a must for puzzle/action fans. Innovative use of stylus to flick marbles.Ultrarealistic magnetic physics: Launched marbles will curve toward like-colored balls. Three single-player modes: Challenge, Quest and Puzzle. Multiple paths and scads of power-ups and hazards will keep you on your toes. Consult the all-in-one dashboard on your top screen. Show off your Magnetica personalty by battling a friend head-to-head. Single-player items boost your score, slow down or stop time, or reverse the course of the marbles. Versus weaponry includes Ion Clouds (smoke screens you'll have to blow away via the DS mic), Recoils (which block marbles), Black Holes (which suck up launched marbles), Viruses (which deflect marbles) and Gravitons (which alter the path of launched marbles). A seemingly endless array of fresh twists will keep drawing you back to single-player Magnetica. Switches, tracks that pass over or below each other, and moving barriers that deflect marbles will keep you flicking marbles for hours.

Game.Name: Magnetic Joe
Game.Overview:
Magnetic Joe is a puzzle game in which the player must guide a magnetic ball by the name of Joe.
The player cannot directly control Joe, but can activate various magnetic fields in the levels. The fields pull Joe in a certain direction. The aim for each level is to reach the exit.
Levels features various hazards such as deadly spikes. When Joe touches a hazard it's game over and the player must restart the level.
For each level the game records the high score.

Game.Name: Mahjong
Game.Overview: This adaptation of the classic Chinese board game offers 100 level for single-player sessions, with three difficulty levels. The levels can also be played in a campaign mode, with twelve illustrated stations. The main aim of the game is to make pairs of blocks disappear on a board where they are stapled on different layers. Removing matching blocks reveals the ones below, until the entire board is cleared or the player is stuck. The game includes a help function and blocks can be immediately selected using the stylus. There are different themes of blocks to choose from, including classic Chinese characters but also more general symbol. The game keeps track of the remaining blocks, the score, and there is an undo function.

Game.Name: Mah-Jong 300
Game.Overview: 300 classic Mahjong layouts 5 different modes for gameplay variety Useful hint system to help with tricky tiles Features exclusive Bonus tiles 3 difficulty levels

Game.Name: Mahjong: Eine Reise um die Welt
Game.Overview:
Mahjong: Eine Reise um die Welt is a sequel to the Nintendo DS game Mahjong by the same development studio. This time players participate in a tournament where the worlds' best players from twelve different countries need to be defeated. In certain games both players' boards are shown and he who clears it first is the winner.
New to this edition is a multiplayer mode to play against a friend and level editor to create custom levels. There are 127 game levels with a progressive difficulty, as a well as a zoom mode to get a better view.

Game.Name: Mahjong Fight Club DS: Wi-Fi Taiou
Game.Overview: Mahjong Kakutou Club DS: Wi-Fi Taiou is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Mahjongg DS
Game.Overview: Experience the world famous Chinese board game! Play your way through numerous tricky levels at different difficulty levels in a setting of beautifully drawn backdrops. Enjoy endless playing pleasure either in Single-Player or 2-Player Mode on a Nintendo DSi system. Use powerful extras such as Dynamite, Whirlwind, and Hourglass and become the uncontested Mahjong champion!

Game.Name: MÃ¤h Jongg DS
Game.Overview: Without you everything is stupid! Apart from MÃ¤h Jongg DS, of course! For the first time, the well-known and unspeakably cute sheep will enchant you on your Nintendo DST! he goal of MÃ¤hJongg DS sounds very simple at first: Clear the playing field by finding two matching game pieces! - Now it has to be admitted that this ancient Chinese game packs quite a punch! Some stones are hidden under others and can therefore only be seen when the upper stones have been cleared away. However, a healthy mixture of brains and luck always helps to find a solution! All MÃ¤h Jongg stones are of course decorated with cute sheep, flowers, crawling beetles and other cute motifs from sheepworld.

Game.Name: Mahjongg Mysteries: Ancient Egypt
Game.Overview:
No place on Earth holds as many mysteries as Egypt! Help adventurers. Michelle Mosley and David Deanfield in their search for the lost temple. Follow clues from the blistering desert sands to the fertile banks of the Nile, finally reaching the mighty pyramids! Only by correctly combining the hieroglyphics will you complete all 300 mahjongg levels. Go for a journey in Adventure Mode, take on your favorite board in Classic Mode, or try one of 11 interesting variations! Welcome to Ancient Egypt!
Gameplay:
â€¢ Solve the Mystery!: Clear puzzles as your travel from location to exotic location, staying one step ahead of your rivals trying to beat you to the lost temple! See the Sphinx, Great Pyramids, and more! â€¢ Classic Play: With over 300 puzzles in classic mode, the fun doesnâ€™t end once youâ€™ve found the treasure! Choose a tile layout and jump into a classic mahjong game. â€¢ Exciting New Modes: Play 11 new and exciting version of mahjongg, including Countdown, Point Race, and FreeCell.

Game.Name: Mahjong Haoh DS: Dankyuu Battle
Game.Overview: Mahjong Haoh DS: Dankyuu Battle is a Miscellaneous game, developed by NCS and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Mahjong Haou DS Special
