Game.Overview: Mahjong Haou DS Special is a Japanese Nintendo DS (NDS) game, a mahjong title published by Mainichi Communications (Mycom) around 2006-2007, offering classic mahjong gameplay for the handheld console, featuring various modes and distinct tile sets for players to enjoy on their Nintendo DS (NDS) device.

Game.Name: Mahjong Journey: Quest for Tikal
Game.Overview: In Mahjong: Journey Quest for Tikal players on the DS embark on a puzzle-playing journey to the ancient Mayan empire. When the Sacred Disc of Tikal opens up, it's up to you to solve the age-old mystery surrounding the 30 "Tiles of Insight." Travel to the exotic Central American site to uncover the treasures of this rich culture while you match tiles and clear more than 300 puzzle layouts. Along the way play in nine different game modes--including Classic and Adventure Modes--and three different difficulty levels in this epic puzzle adventure.

Game.Name: Mahjong Mysteries: Ancient Athena
Game.Overview:
Follow the trail of ancient heroes, past the Oracle of Delphi and the Theatre of Dionysus to experience the mystery of the Gods of Olympus! Discover the treasures of this once magnificent culture. Don't let your guard down though: you're not alone!
Only by correctly combining the symbols will you complete all 300 Mahjong levels. Play in Adventure Mode, choose your favourite board in classic Mahjong and try one of 10 variations. Enjoy the mystic atmosphere.
Features
â€¢ Play in Adventure or Classic Modeâ€¢ 10 game variations and 300 new levels in Classic Mode - all in 3D!â€¢ Exciting adventure-packed story

Game.Name: Mahjong Navi DS
Game.Overview: Mahjong Navi DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by NCS, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions
Game.Overview: Nature has struck back. The world has fallen into a state of imbalance, splitting our teenage hero Kwazi into the male Kwazi White and the female Kwazi Black. You must help the Kwazis advance through the elemental Moon Gates by solving Mah Jong puzzles. Make your way through mystical lands, matching pairs and triplets like never before. Only you can restore harmony to the world.

Game.Name: Mahjong Taikai
Game.Overview: Mahjong Taikai is a Miscellaneous game, published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Game.Name: Mainichi ga Tanoshii! Ayanokouji Kimimaro no Happy Techou
Mainichi Kokorobics: Kaiun Kenkyuuka Utsukita Mahiro Kanshuu: DS Uranai Happiness 2008
Game.Overview: "Mainichi Kokorobics: Kaiun Kenkyuuka Utsukita Mahiro Kanshuu: DS Uranai Happiness 2008 DS" is a miscellaneous application and fortune-telling game for the Nintendo DS. The game, released only in Japan, focuses on daily "Kokorobics" (heart/mind exercises) and fortune-telling aspects supervised by Mahiro Utsukita, a "Kaiun Kenkyuuka" (literally "good fortune researcher").

Game.Name: Mainichi Shinbunsha Kyouryoku: Saikyou no Kanji Drill 5-man Mon
Game.Overview: Mainichi Shinbunsha Kyouryoku: Saikyou no Kanji Drill 5-man Mon DS is a language-learning video game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan on 15 January 2009. Developed and published by MyCom (Mainichi Communications), the software is designed to help users master Japanese Kanji through a massive collection of 50,000 questions.

Game.Name: Mainichi Shinbun Soukan 135 Shuunen Project: Mainichi Shinbun 1000 Dai News
Game.Overview: The Mainichi Shinbun Soukan 135 Shuunen Project: Mainichi Shinbun 1000 Dai News DS (Mainichi Shinbun 1000 Big News) is an educational quiz game released for the Nintendo DS. It was developed as part of a commemorative project for the 135th anniversary of the founding of the Mainichi Shimbun, one of Japan's major daily newspapers.

Game.Name: Mais oÃ¹ se cache Carmen Sandiego? MystÃ¨re au bout du monde
Game.Overview: But where is Carmen Sandiego? Mystery at the End of the World on DS is a fun educational game in which you will have to overcome the pitfalls of this devilishly agile robber. In the shoes of Julia or Adam, find three great treasures of humanity stolen by Carmen. Go to the four corners of the world and combine action and reflection to solve the puzzles. Also adopt the right tone to interview witnesses and complete investigations.

Game.Name: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Gyouseishoshi
Game.Overview: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Gyouseishoshi (translated as "I Really Learn: Pass with LEC: DS Administrative Scrivener") is an educational software title for the Nintendo DS developed by Matrix Software and published by Square Enix. Released in Japan on September 2, 2010, it is designed to help students prepare for the national exam for Administrative Scriveners (Gyouseishoshi) in Japan.

Game.Name: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Hisho Kentei 2-kyuu: 3-kyuu
Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Kikenbutsu Toriatsukaisha Otsushu 4 Rui
Game.Overview: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Kikenbutsu Toriatsukaisha Otsushu 4-rui is an educational software developed by Square Enix and released for the Nintendo DS in 2010. It is designed to help users study for the Hazardous Materials Handler Class B Group 4 (Otsushu 4-rui) certification in Japan.

Game.Name: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Koumuin Shiken: Suuteki Shori
Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Nisshou Boki 3-kyuu
Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Takuchi Tatemono Torihiki Shuninsha: 2011 Nen & 2012 Nendo Ban
Game.Overview: Maji de Manabu: LEC de Ukaru: DS Takuchi Tatemono Torihiki Shuninsha: 2011 Nen & 2012 Nendo Ban is an educational software title released for the Nintendo DS in Japan. Published by Square Enix as part of their DS:Style series, it is designed to help users study for the Real Estate Transaction Agent (Takken) licensing exam.

Game.Name: Majime ni Fumajime: Kaiketsu Zorori: Kyoufu no Takarabako
Game.Overview: Majime ni Fumajime: Kaiketsu Zorori: Kyoufu no Takarabako is a Japanese action-adventure and role-playing game developed by Japan Art Media (JAM) and published by Marvelous Entertainment for the Nintendo DS. Released on 31 August 2006, it is based on the Majime ni Fumajime Kaiketsu Zorori anime series.

Game.Name: Majin Tantei Nougami Neuro: Neuro to Yako no Bishoku Zanmai: Suiri Tsuki: Gourmet & Mystery
Game.Overview:
Majin Tantei NÅgami Neuro: Neuro to Yako no Bishoku Zanmai â€” Tsuiritsuki Gurume & Misuteri- (é­”äººæŽ¢åµè„³å™›ãƒã‚¦ãƒ­ ãƒã‚¦ãƒ­ã¨å¼¥å­ã®ç¾Žé£Ÿä¸‰æ˜§ æŽ¨ç†ã¤ã ã‚°ãƒ«ãƒ¡&ãƒŸã‚¹ãƒ†ãƒªãƒ¼ or "Demon Detective NÅgami Neuro: Neuro and Yako's Delicious Delights - A Gourmet Deduction & Mystery") is a Nintendo DS game was released by Audio, Inc.
Gameplay Included several mini-games such as keeping Yako's temperature down while she eats hot food.

Game.Name: Major DS: Dream Baseball
Game.Overview: MAJOR DS: Dream Baseball (ãƒ¡ã‚¸ãƒ£ãƒ¼DS ãƒ‰ãƒªãƒ¼ãƒ ãƒ™ãƒ¼ã‚¹ãƒœãƒ¼ãƒ«) is a Nintendo 3DS game developed by Amedio and released by Takara Tomy on July 31, 2008. The game is based on the anime's 3rd and 4th seasons, where the protagonist (name of player's choice) enrolls into Seishu High School until he lands in America to win the League and defeating Joe Gibson Jr.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K10
Game.Overview: The eighth game in the MLB 2K series, MLB 2K10 celebrates the immortal battle on the baseball diamond between pitcher and batter. Featuring a combination of an extensive updating of features from earlier games in the series, alongside a range of new play options designed to heighten the experience of both the player on the mound and at the plate, MLB 2K10 is a baseball gaming experience not to be missed. Additional features include, new pitch selection and batter's swing functionality, multiple game modes - including franchise and career modes - and a variety of multiplayer options.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K11
Game.Overview:
Take your game on the road with MLB 2K11. Featuring Total Control hitting and pitching, MLB 2K11 puts complete control in your hands. Achieve perfection and youâ€™ll dominate the competition.
Features
â€¢ Total Control Pitching & Hitting - Paint the corners and fight off nasty pitchesâ€¢ Season and Postseason Modes: Play a 162-game season, or the Postseasonâ€¢ Unlockable Player Cards - Over 250 cards

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K12
Game.Overview:
The longest running Major League Baseball franchise returns to the virtual diamond with MLB 2K12 from 2K Sports.
Featuring simple & intuitive controls and immersive game modes for any level of fan, MLB 2K12 is the only game you'll need this season. Total Control Pitching & Hitting â€“ Control the action on the field with simple, intuitive controls. Perfect for gaming on the go.
Season and Postseason Modes â€“ Run through the gauntlet of a 162-game season, or skip ahead to the excitement of October baseball.
Baseball Cards â€“ Collect over 250 unlockable player cards.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K6
Game.Overview: Major League Baseball 2K6 prototype for the DS.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K7
Game.Overview: It's a whole new ballgame! Major League Baseball 2K7 redefines the pure baseball video game experience with true, Next-Gen details, all-new throwing mechanics and a revolutionary presentation system. Featuring stunning, lifelike player models, Signature Style animations, Inside Edge data and more, Major League Baseball 2K7 delivers the most authentic baseball action to date.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K8: Fantasy All-Stars
Game.Overview:
A different take on the long-running 2K baseball series, this version doesn't feature a season mode, but has a Pennant race tournament mode, exhibition mode with the ability to choose top players from all 30 major league teams, along with mini-games in an All-Star Training mode.
The player also has the option to build their own teams using real baseball players, creating their own all-star team. The gameplay is different from others, utilizing the stylus pen at the bottom of the screen, players have to tap the screen or draw with their pen at certain points on a meter for power and position of pitches as well as batting, fielding and baserunning.
It does not feature actual MLB stadiums, instead it has fantasy stadiums such as the North Pole and the Everglades. It supports DS wireless and Wi-Fi, letting players compete with others head-to-head.

Game.Name: Major League Baseball 2K9: Fantasy All-Stars
Game.Overview:
Dual screen baseball action for fans of all ages!
Available exclusively for Nintendo DS, MLB 2K9 Fantasy All-Stars offers fans of all ages a wildly fun and unique interactive experience featuring all 30 Major League Baseball teams, a variety of exhibition and tournament modes, world-themed baseball stadiums, and new mini-games including Home Run Derby, Cannonball Dodge and more.

Game.Name: Make 10: A Journey of Numbers
Game.Overview:
The player is taken to Make 10 Kingdom, a land ruled by Numbers, where they are requested by King Decimus to journey to meet with the 9 Make 10 Masters.
Make 10 contains over 30 minigames, for which the rule is always to make multiples of 10: 10, 20, 30, and so on. That can be achieved in various ways by using the console's stylus: by covering up some numbers, switching numbers around, writing a number, etc.
The minigames can be accessed through different modes: - Make 10 Kingdom, the story mode where the player journeys through Make 10 Kingdom, meeting the 9 Masters and unlocking minigames as they go. - Trial Mountains, where the player can test their skills at the minigames that have been unlocked - Make 10 Test, where the player can get their Make 10 skills evaluated.
If stuck, the player can use Assist Points that are scattered all around the Kingdom.

Game.Name: Make-up and Style
Game.Overview:
Become a makeup artist!
Allow your creativity to run wild as a famous makeup artist with realistic makeup tools. You can even create a 3D face â€“ simply take picture of your face, place it onto a 3D face and apply makeup. Complete various missions and become a professional makeup artist.
Features:
- Create thousands of different faces
- Use the stylus to precisely apply makeup to the 3D face
- 16 types of makeup tools including brushes, mascara, lipsticks and eye pencils
- 23 missions with a humorous storyline in Career mode

Game.Name: Mama's Combo Pack: Volume 1
Game.Overview: Mama's Combo Pack Volume 1 for Nintendo DS mixes up a recipe for fun by combining the original best-selling classic Cooking Mama with Camping Mama: Outdoor Adventures. In Cooking Mama, players use their stylus as the ultimate cooking utensil to create more than 75 real dishes under Mama's watchful eye. If you make a mistake, don't worry because Mama will fix it! When you've mastered the kitchen, join Mama and her family on an exciting wilderness getaway. Play as Mama's son or daughter as you set up camp, interact with wildlife, endure forces of nature, and even hunt for treasure across 38 levels and 100 different games.

Game.Name: Mama's Combo Pack: Volume 2
Game.Overview: The succulent sequel! Everyone's favorite Mama returns for a second helping, but this time her finicky friends will judge your culinary skills. Get ready to whip up a home-cooked meal on your DS and find out if your dishes are truly delicious! Make 80 new recipes including chili dogs, escargot, bananas foster, macaroons and shark fin soup. Customize your kitchen and dress up Mama with fun outfits. Cook off against up to 3 friends in Wireless Download Play. Crafting Mama: Turn your world into a work of art! Help Mama sew, glue, fold, cut, and paint 40 different craft projects. Use your creations to accessorize, decorate, and play. You can even get crafty with a friend!

Game.Name: Mamegoma 2: Uchi no Ko ga Ichiban!
Game.Overview: Mame Goma 2: Uchi no Ko ga Ichiban! is a Simulation game, developed by Infinity and published by Creative Core, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Mamegoma 3: Kawaii ga Ippai
Game.Overview: Mame Goma 3: Kawaii ga Ippai is a Simulation game, developed by Infinity and published by Columbia Music Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Mamegoma: Honobono Nikki
Game.Overview: Mame Goma: Honobono Nikki is a Simulation game, developed and published by TDK Core, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Manepa 1000 Mannin no FX Training
Game.Overview: Manepa 1000-Mannin no FX Training is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Genki, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Manepa 1000-Mannin no FX Training: Leverage Kisei Taiouban
Game.Overview: Manepa 1000-Bannin no FX Training: Leverage Kisei Taiouban is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Genki, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Manga Ka Debut Monogatari DS: Akogare! Manga Ka Ikusei Game
Game.Overview: Manga Ka Debut Monogatari DS: Akogare! Manga Ka Ikusei Game is a Simulation game, developed by Hyde and published by TDK Core, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Manic Miner in the Lost Levels
Game.Overview: Manic Miner: The Lost Levels is a DS port of classic platformer Matthew Smith's Manic Miner series. It features a total of 50 stages, arranged in three sections. The Lost Levels portion includes 20 levels that were added (or modified) for the Manic Miner versions released on Oric, BBC Micro, Dragon 32, Amstrad CPC and GBA.

Game.Name: Maple Story DS
Game.Overview: MapleStory DS (Korean: ë©”ì´í”ŒìŠ¤í† ë¦¬ DS) is a role-playing video game for the Nintendo DS. It is an adaptation of the original MMORPG game for Windows titled MapleStory. The game was released on April 15, 2010 in Korea, and was developed by Nexon and published by Nexon and NintenThe player starts out as a Warrior or Thief. Upon completion of the game, the remaining job classes (Magician and Bowman) are unlocked. Skills are obtained via skill books collected throughout the game. AI partners who fight alongside the player are gained as the game progresses. Characters also learn skills which can be used to deal immense amounts of damage.do of Korea.

Game.Name: March of the Penguins
Game.Overview:
Based on the documentary March of the Penguins, this game follows the story of the emperor penguins as they embark on a long journey to breed their young. The game has been divided into twelve chapters, with different gameplay. The penguins need to be navigated through the environment, find a suitable mate, find food, take care of the egg, guard the young ones and finally make it all the way back.
A large part of the game is based on the concept of Lemmings. As the penguins march on, players need to help them land softly, melt obstacles, attract them in a certain direction using fish and place trampolines, ramps, slides, bridges and steps to make them access new areas. The levels can be explored using binoculars and the penguins need to collect a certain amount of snowflakes to pass. The penguins cannot die. When they fall off a cliff, they simply restart at the beginning of the level, but the players needs to bring them to the end as a group to succeed.
Other levels have the penguins slide down hills with faster gameplay, feature mazes, or take place underwater where predators need to be avoided while collecting food. In the later parts of the game, guarding the eggs adds an new layer of difficulty. As soon as a penguin hits an obstacle it is dropped. There is little time to pick it up again or it freezes. It also need to be taken to a warm spot before the thermometer time runs out.
Some educational content has also been included. Next to the habits, more information about the penguin migration in provided in between levels.

Game.Name: Margot's Bepuzzled!
Game.Overview:
Join the lovable Margot as she returns in an all-new puzzling game to challenge you on the Nintendo DS. Play over 1,000 puzzling games including crossword, word search, sudoku, and more!
Features
â€¢ Crossword - Complete the grid by solving all the clues. â€¢ Wordsearch - find all the listed words hidden in the letter grid. â€¢ Mini Wordsearch - Smaller grids with fewer words to find. â€¢ Kriss Kross - Fit the words from the list into the empty grid. â€¢ Mini Kriss Kross - Smaller grids with fewer words to place. â€¢ Numberjigs - Fit the numbers from the list into the grid. â€¢ Kakuro - Find the numbers that add up to the totals listed for each row and column â€¢ Mini Kakuro - Smaller grids. â€¢ Sudoku - Correctly fill the 9x9 number grid with numbers 1-9. â€¢ Hard Sudoku - More difficult 9x9 grids. â€¢ Mini Sudoku - 6x6 grids with numbers 1-6. â€¢ Junior Sudoku - 4x4 grids with numbers 1-4.

Game.Name: Margot's Word Brain
Game.Overview: Meet Margot, the new videogame queen of word play! Margot has devised a set of six fiendish and compelling word-based puzzles to test your vocabulary, spelling and general language skills. No two games will ever be the same as you wrack your brain against the clock to create words from randomly-generated letters in order to score maximum points.

Game.Name: Marie-Antoinette and the American War of Independence: Episode 1: The Brotherhood of the Wolf
Game.Overview: Game in 5 languages ! (English, Spanish, German, Italian, French) From Yorktown to Versailles, live through an incredible adventure with more than 10 hours of gameplay accompanied by Washington, La Fayette, Benjamin Franklin, Rochambeau, Fersenâ€¦ An encyclopedia about the 18th century, the American War of Independence, Versaillesâ€¦ Numerous mini-games (Pharaoh, battle frigates, Trou Madameâ€¦) and a great many riddles will put your skills and your wisdom to the testâ€¦â€

Game.Name: Marie-Antoinette and the Disciples of Loki
Game.Overview: Marie Antoinette and the Disciples of Loki is an adventure game about DS. The story takes place in 1787, when a mysterious murder has just been committed at Versailles. The player must conduct the investigation by meeting historical figures and solving different puzzles (puzzles, puzzles, carriage races).

Game.Name: Marie & Gully no Let's Science
Game.Overview: Marie & Gully no Let's Science is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Mario Calculator
Game.Overview: Mario and Luigi take a break from their normal adventures to dedicate their heroic talents to working with numbers. Mario Calculator features the full functionality of a traditional calculator, including a Memory key and the ability to display up to 13 digits, and adds a layer of atmosphere reminiscent of the original Super Mario Bros. Use the Unit Converter to turn one unit of measure into another (such as length, weight, volume, age and others), or track the history of calculations you've performed with ease. Listen to the Mario-related sounds and watch the coins fly as calculations are performed. Now, back to adding up those high scores...

Game.Name: Mario Clock
Game.Overview: Turn back time and enjoy a bit of classic game play based on the original Super Mario Bros. with Mario Clock. Help Mario and Luigi collect more coins than ever (POW block anyone?) while they run through a variety of stages. Gather enough coins and you'll be treated to another scene bound to bring back fond memories for many. Mario Clock includes both analog and digital clocks that use the system's internal clock or allow you to offset the time however you like. Program up to three alarms (with snooze functionality for those that need it) and assign them a Mario-related sound or use one created in the Nintendo DSi Sound application. You'll find yourself thinking "Just a few more coins..." in no time!

Game.Name: Mario Hoops 3 on 3
Game.Overview: Get that magic touch. There are plenty of basketball games out there, but none with the hands-on control of Mario Hoops 3-on-3. Players use the touch screen to get their game on as they execute tricky dribbles, special passes and sweet shots - all with strokes and taps of the stylus. Players choose their teams of three characters from the Mario universe and hit the parquet. Power-ups like Red Shells and Bob-ombs can turn the tide as they chase down coins - they will affect the score, so players collect as many as they can as they drive to the hoop. Whether playing against friends on a local wireless connection, jamming through a tournament or just playing mini-games, there's a mode for everyone.

Game.Name: Mario Kart DS
Game.Overview: Rev up your engines and buckle up for Mario Kart DS! An all-star cast of karting veterans and newcomers compete for glory across 32 fiendishly-designed courses, including Grand Prix, Time Trial, VS., Battle and Mission modes. The first game in the series to feature classic courses from previous Mario Kart titles, it also introduced the new items Blooper and Bullet Bill and an emblem editor for customising your karts. Mario Kart DS is packed with more content than you can shake a Spiny Shell at!

Game.Name: Mario Kart DS CTGP Nitro
Game.Overview: CTGP-Nitro is the biggest, most ambitious Mario Kart DS Rom Hack to date. Instead of replacing the existing tracks, it preserves the whole vanilla experience and adds new tracks, speedrunning quality of life improvements, online mode adjustments, new skins for characters and much more!

Game.Name: Mario Kart DS Deluxe
Game.Overview: Mario Kart DS Deluxe is a rom hack for Mario Kart DS, created by Rafa4K and released in 2019. It replaces all 32 tracks from said game with tracks from newer Mario Kart games, including Mario Kart Wii, Mario Kart 7 and Mario Kart 8

Game.Name: Mario Kart DS Double Dash!!
Game.Overview: Mario Kart Double Dash DS is a ROM Hack made by Gericom. Gericom began developing this hack in 2011 when MKDS CTs first became possible, so it contains some of the very first MKDS CTs, which are direct ports of the BMDs from Mario Kart Double Dash. As such, the game doesn't work well on real hardware, or more accurate emulators like MelonDS, all of the courses have problems with vanishing faces since the models were not simplified. It mostly only works in Time Trails, and tend to crash in Grand Prix, and VS due to the large file sizes of the assets.

Game.Name: Mario Kart DS N64 Circuit
Game.Overview:
This is a hack of Mario Kart DS. It changes many courses and changes the old ones for other retro courses. There is also some custom music.
The project was initiated back in May or June of 2014, and it is meant to be a sequel of sorts to Mario Kart Advance/Mario Kart Super Circuit.

Game.Name: Mario Kart Mini Grandprix
Game.Overview: A ROM hack for Mario Kart DS, featuring 8 new levels, new characters, new item models, and more!

Game.Name: Mario Kart Zero
Game.Overview: Mario Kart Zero is a hack of Mario Kart DS that changes the tracks to different ones. It also has custom music. The hack is originally based on Mario Kart CW OSE (Open-Source Edition) 6.2, which is again based on Mario Kart CW Tri originally by DSHack.

Game.Name: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
Game.Overview: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story is the third game in the Mario & Luigi series of games. Players control Mario and Luigi simultaneously in the side-scrolling platform environment of Bowser's body, while also controlling the Koopa King himself in the top-down world of the Mushroom Kingdom. Similar to games like Earthbound, enemy encounters are seen as actual enemies that players can avoid or attempt to strike early. The actual battles are a combination of turn-based menu attacks, and timed reactions to enemies during battle. By watching the way an enemy reacts, you can anticipate their attack and avoid it or counterattack.

Game.Name: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time
Game.Overview: The famous Mario Brothers return in this sequel to the humorous Superstar Saga. In this adventure, Princess Peach takes a trip in a time machine, but when it returns, there's only a monster inside! The heroic brothers travel back in time only to discover that evil alien life forms known as the Shroobs have taken over the Mushroom Kingdom, and no-one is safe! They soon meet up with their younger selves, and set out to stop the alien menace, not to mention rescue the Princess!

Game.Name: Mario Party DS
Game.Overview: He's captured Mario and his friends in his pursuit of a crystal that the group collected when it fell from the sky, and he doesn't hesitate to shrink them to miniature size to get rid of them and get his hands on the other four crystals. The mini-heroes have to find the crystals before he does, making their way through giant environments filled with enormous creatures. The single-player campaign takes place in five different settings, each of them ending with a boss. As usual, players have to collect coins and stars, at the same time escaping dangers such as Piranha Plants and other classic creatures from the Mario universe.

Game.Name: Mario's Holiday
Game.Overview:
There is a hub world named the Sky Land Resort V.I.P. Area, two main courses named Frosty Fair and Bob-omb Cruiser, and a side course named Starry Grasslands. Bob-omb Cruiser will become the shipwreck in Bob-omb Islands, Frosty Fair will reappear as a side coruse in Super Mario: Star World, and SKELUX created the Sky Land Resort V.I.P. Area and Starry Grasslands exclusively for this game.
All four playable characters are accessible from the beginning of the game, and the player can choose between them all on the Mission Select Screen.
When the player collects a Power Star, they won't return to the Sky Land Resort V.I.P. Area. They can collect all the Power Stars in a course in one go.

Game.Name: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games
Game.Overview: Two of the biggest icons in the entertainment industry, Mario and Sonic, are joining forces to star in Mario and Sonic at the Olympic Games. Developed exclusively for the Wii video game system and the Nintendo DS system, this momentous agreement marks the first time these two renowned stars have appeared together in a game. Featuring an all-star cast of characters from the amazing worlds of both Mario and Sonic, players will be able to compete as or against a range of familiar characters including Mario, Sonic, Luigi, Knuckles, Yoshi, Tails and more.

Game.Name: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games
Game.Overview:
Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games is an official game based on the Winter Olympics in Vancouver 2010. As in the predecessor there are 20 characters from the two franchises which compete in 15 Olympic disciplines. In addition to that there are also some dream events which add a fantastic element to a known sport, e.g.ski-jumping with rockets. Every of those disciplines are played with an mini game which require different actions from the player, e.g. pressing buttons in the right rhythm for ice skating or steering during the snowboard event. Some use the touch screen while others rely on traditional controls.
The DS-exclusive adventure mode features a story in which Dr. Eggman and Bowser melt away all the ice needed for the Olympic Games. To set things right Mario & Sonic need to travel to different locations, talk to the inhabitants and solve challenges. Those consist of the sports mini games with certain winning requirements. Playing this mode also unlocks the dream events. Besides this players can decide to enter the party game mode or to play the games separately respectively in a custom tournament. All modes except the adventure mode are also available for up to four players.

Game.Name: Mario's Red Curtain
Game.Overview: Mario's Red Curtain is a popular custom ROM hack of Super Mario 64 DS. It was created by developers Confidan and SawyerR13, initially released in July 2023 for the 2023 SM64DS Summer Mini-Hack Competition.

Game.Name: Mario's Star Quest
Game.Overview: Mario's Star Quest is a small ROM hack of Super Mario 64 DS made by Oreo in 2020. It features a new hub and 4 main levels, all of which are accessible from the start.

Game.Name: Mario's Trip
Game.Overview: A ROM hack.

Game.Name: Mario vs. Donkey Kong 2: March of the Minis
Game.Overview: Mario vs. Donkey Kong 2: March of the Minis is an action/puzzle game where the object is to bring as many Mini-Marios to the exit door as possible by solving the puzzle. All the puzzles are fairly small and take up anywhere from one screen to four screens (2x2) in size. All the Mini-Marios that are collected in each room are then used in the Donkey Kong boss battle at the end of the world. All of the control is done with the stylus; no buttons are used at all.

Game.Name: Mario vs. Donkey Kong: Mini-Land Mayhem!
Game.Overview: At the grand opening of Mario's third theme park, the first 100 guests receive a new Mini Pauline toy. Donkey Kong arrives as the 101st guest and finds himself out of luck. He grabs Pauline and heads into the park with Mario and his Mini Marios in hot pursuit. The fourth game in the series adds new challenges and new opportunities for users to share what they have created.

Game.Name: Mario vs. Donkey Kong: Minis March Again!
Game.Overview:
Help Mario and his army of Mini Marios rescue Pauline again! Or create your own levels and share them with others.
Thanks to the runaway success of Super Mini Mario World, Mario and Pauline have expanded their toy-filled theme park and invited everyone to the opening celebration. Everyone, that is, except Donkey Kong, who was too late to get in! Donkey Kong decides to crash the party and kidnaps Pauline along the way! Can Mario and his Mini Marios rescue Pauline from Donkey Kongâ€™s clutches yet again?
In addition, make sure to explore the Construction Zone, where youâ€™ll find all the tools needed to make your own original levels. You can then share your masterpieces or download levels created by others via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection and broadband Internet access, or via local wireless.

Game.Name: Marker Man Adventures
Game.Overview: It was just an ordinary day in the life of Marker Man, the loveable stick figure, and his pal Doodle Dog. That all ended abruptly, however, when Doodle went missing without a trace. Guide Marker Man through hundreds of physics based puzzles using your stylus as a creative tool to safely bring Doodle Dog home!

Game.Name: Martin Mystery: Monster Invasion
Game.Overview: Martin Mystery: Monster Invasion is an European, adventure, exploration and action platform video game based on the 2003-2006 animated series, Martin Mystery and also developed and published by Ubisoft, OUAT Entertainment and Marathon Media (currently as Zodiak Kids Studios) for the Nintendo DS system. An Exploration/Action game with an exceptional life span (8 hours) 15 missions with 6 different types of environment (Torrington Academy, Cavern, Temple, Old Manor House, New Building and Extra-terrestrial) 8 types of monsters and 15 bosses (Zombies, Wizard, Specter, Mutantâ€¦) 10 types of mini-games (Battle against monsters, Lock-picking, Assemblingâ€¦) Stylus driven: Navigation via the touch screen. Character Recognition

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! 2011-Nendohan Financial Planning Ginou Kentei Shiken 2-Kyuu, 3-Kyuu
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! 2011-Nendohan Financial Planning Ginou Kentei Shiken 2-Kyuu, 3-Kyuu is an edutainment title for the Nintendo DS designed to help users study for the Japanese Financial Planning Proficiency Test (FP) at the 2nd and 3rd grade levels.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! 2011-Nendohan Gyousei Shoshi Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! 2011: Nendohan Jouhou Security Specialist Shiken: Network Specialist Shiken
Game.Overview: Overcome security weakness and prepare for you Network Specialist Examination with the 2011 Edition of the Information Security Specialist Examination. 10 years worth of each test, large collection of past questions. Learn countermeasures and overcome network weaknesses.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! 2011-Nendohan Takken Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Care Manager Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Chuushoukigyou Shindanshi Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Financial Planning Ginou Kentei Shiken 2-kyuu, 3-kyuu
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Gyouseishoshi Shiken
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Gyouseishoshi Shiken is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Media5, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Hanbaishi Kentei Shiken 2-kyuu, 3-kyuu
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! IT Passport Shiken, Kihon Jouhou Gijutsusha Shiken, Ouyou Jouhou Gijutsusha Shiken
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shiraku Sashhu! IT Passport Shiken is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Media5, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Kaigo Fukushishi Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Shakai Fukushishi Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Sharoushi Shiken

Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special IT Passport Shiken, Kihon Jouhou Gijutsusha Shiken, Ouyou Jouhou Gijutsusha Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Kaigo Fukushishi Shiken
Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Shakai Fukushishi Shiken
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Shakai Fukushishi Shiken is an edutainment video game for the Nintendo DS designed to help users study for the Japanese Social Worker (Shakai Fukushishi) national examination.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Sharoushi Shiken
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Sharoushi Shiken is an educational video game developed and published by Media5 for the Nintendo DS. It is part of the "Maru Goukaku" series, designed to help users study for the Japanese Labor and Social Security Attorney (Sharoushi) examination.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Takken Shiken
Game.Overview: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! Special Takken Shiken DS is an educational simulation game released for the Nintendo DS in Japan. Developed and published by Media5, it is part of the "Maru Goukaku" series designed to help users study for professional licensing exams.

Game.Name: Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! TAC Koumuin Shiken: Kokka II Shu
Game.Overview: "Maru Goukaku: Shikaku Dasshu! TAC Koumuin Shiken: Kokka II Shu DS" is a Japanese study aid video game for the Nintendo DS console designed to help users prepare for the National Public Service Examination Level II in Japan.

Game.Name: Maruhan Pachinko & Pachi-Slot Hisshou Guide Kyouryoku: The Pachinko Hall
Game.Overview: Maruhan Pachinko & Pachi-Slot Hisshou Guide Kanshuu: The Pachinko Hall is a Strategy game, developed and published by Nippon Ichi Software, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Maru Kaite Don Don Oboeru: Kyoui no Tsugawa Shiki Kanji Kiokujutsu
Game.Overview: Maru Kaite DonDon Oboeru: Kyoui no Tsugawa Shiki Kanji Kioku Jutsu is a educational game, developed and published by Ertain, which was released in Japan in 2007

Game.Name: Maru Kaite DonDon Oboeru: Kyoui no Tsugawa Shiki Kanji Kioku Jutsu : Kiso Gakushuu Hen
Game.Overview: Maru Kaite DonDon Oboeru: Kyoui no Tsugawa Shiki Kanji Kioku Jutsu - Kiso Gakushuu Hen is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Ertain, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Marvel Nemesis: Rise of the Imperfects
Game.Overview: When New York City is attacked by aliens, the greatest heroes (and villains) in the Marvel Universe confront them. Marvel Nemesis has two playing modes, a single-player story mode, where players brawl their way through a Mark Millar scripted tale, and a single- or two-player versus mode pitting heroes and villains against each other in a sandbox arena. Famous Marvel characters have been reimagined by artist Jae Lee and new characters have been created for this game series. The PS2 and Xbox versions support online play and all versions have unlockable arenas, characters, and extras.

Game.Name: Marvel Super Hero Squad
Game.Overview:
Pick your battle - fight for good, fight for evil or just fight for fun!
Welcome to Super Hero City! Hero up! Assemble your squad, and fight your way to victory to save the citizens of Super Hero City from the evil schemes of Dr. Doom and the Lethal Legion in this multi-player adventure game inspired by the action-packed animated Marvel animated series, Super Hero Squad!

Game.Name: Marvel Super Hero Squad: The Infinity Gauntlet
Game.Overview:
GAME DETAILS Hero up in 3D! Join Iron Man, Hulk, Wolverine and the Squaddies to collect six Infinity Stones from the villains who would use them to dominate or destroy the universe! Itâ€™s up to you to prevent the Infinity Stones from falling into the wrong hands. Use unique powers and super smarts to overcome dastardly villains. Match up heroes against enemy combatants and unleash high-octane battles as you fight your way to victory in this adventure game inspired by the action-packed animated Marvel TV series.
Features
â€¢ Smash, dash and crash with fully powered heroes in 3D! â€¢ 12 Super Hero Squad characters and six villains â€“ including Dr. Doom and Magneto! â€¢ Seven full levels including a new level that lets you play as the Super Villains! Plus take to the air in two extra flying mini-levels. â€¢ Unlock Challenge Levels and new hero costumes throughout the game

Game.Name: Marvel Trading Card Game
Game.Overview:
Marvel Trading Card Game is a virtual card game in which the player chooses to be either a superhero or supervillain in single-player mode. Multiplayer modes are also available. The game follows the rules laid out in Upper Deck's VS System, used in card games across several franchises including Marvel, DC Comics, and Hellboy.
The game received mixed reviews from critics. It was considered faithful to the physical version, but reviewers commented that it was not accessible to players who weren't already fans of collectible card games. The handheld versions were criticized for presenting a visual format inappropriate for small screens.

Game.Name: Marvel: Ultimate Alliance 2
Game.Overview: The Marvel Universe is being torn apart. The Superhuman Registration Act becomes law and Super Heroes must register as weapons of mass destruction, becoming licensed government agents. As Civil War is stirred, Iron Man leads the Pro-Registration side while Captain America spearheads the stand on Anti-Registration. The enemies you battle and the missions you accomplish depend on which side you choose.

Game.Name: Master Jin Jin's IQ Challenge
Game.Overview: (Currently available in the UK/EU only) This game is designed to be truly enjoyable, while at the same time aiming to stimulate and develop the brain. Stretch your mind with 10 different challenge types in five categories, each with multiple levels of difficulty. Over 300 Fun Intelligence Teasers Categories include: Reasoning, Observation, Intuition, Analysis, and Tenacity

Game.Name: Master of Illusion
Game.Overview:
Master of Illusion is different from other exercise games. This one is a take on magic, teaching the player but also performing magic tricks against the player itself. There are three different modes including Solo Magic, Magic Show and Magic Training.
In Solo Magic, a magician performs parlor tricks such as guessing what card the player has just picked out or guessing by the hand gestures the player makes over the DS screen.
In Magic Tricks, there are fourteen different tricks to try where the game is more of an assistant, helping the player out performing your tricks including having a friend pick out a card and drawing a face at the bottom of the screen that will guess the card picked out. It can also guess a person's birthday or where they are going on their vacation. Some of the tricks have the player recite different things through the microphone, for instance the vacation trick, or the player needs to blow into the microphone.
The third mode is called Magic Training, which is more of a series of mini-games to help test reaction speed. There are step by step instructions of how to perform tricks and there is also a special deck of cards that comes with the game.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Deep Psyche
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express games offer mind-bending magic tricks pulled from the popular Nintendo DS game. Learn the illusions, practice, and amaze your friends. Master of Illusion Express: Deep Psyche asks a series of pointed questions and reveals a startling truth.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Funny Face
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express titles are mind-boggling magic tricks pulled from the popular Nintendo DS game. Learn the illusions, practice up and amaze your friends. Master of Illusion Express: Funny Face uses your Nintendo DSi system as a prop in a card trick. Draw a face on the touch-sensitive screen and astound your audience as the face tells them which playing card they picked. Also included is the bonus Vanishing Card trick, which the Nintendo DSi system performs for your enjoyment.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Matchmaker
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express titles feature mind-boggling magic tricks that you can perform with your Nintendo DSi system. Learn the illusions, practice up and amaze your friends. Master of Illusion Express: Matchmaker includes two tricks that use your Nintendo DSi system to reveal information about others. Use the Photo Diagnosis trick and stun others by taking two simple photos to pinpoint their exact age. Or have the Matchmaker trick show that another person has favorite dates or favorite foods that are similar to yours. Who knows? You could even land a date or make a new friend.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Mind Probe
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express titles are mind-boggling magic tricks that you perform with your Nintendo DSi system. Learn the illusions, practice up and then amaze your friends. Master of Illusion Express: Mind Probe uses your Nintendo DSi system as a means of detecting information. Ask a spectator to write down a favorite (or least-favorite) item - person, food or color, for example - and then be astonished when the Nintendo DSi system sounds an alarm to indicate when that item is spoken. Use any variation of likes or dislikes to stun the crowd.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Psychic Camera
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express titles include mind-boggling magic tricks that you perform with your Nintendo DSi system. Learn the illusions, practice them and amaze your friends. Your audience will never look at your Nintendo DSi system the same way again after Master of Illusion Express: Psychic Camera proves that it has psychic powers. Astound others by taking their picture and revealing an item (such as a card, picture, letter or number) that they're thinking about.

Game.Name: Master of Illusion Express: Shuffle Games
Game.Overview: Master of Illusion Express games are mind-boggling magic tricks pulled from the popular Nintendo DS game. Learn the illusions, practice up, and amaze your friends. Master of Illusion Express: Shuffle Games will boggle your audience members' minds as they try to figure out how you know exactly what they're thinking. Also included is the bonus Vanishing Card trick, which the Nintendo DSi system performs for your enjoyment.

Game.Name: Master of the Monster Lair
Game.Overview:
Master of the Monster Lair is a dungeon crawling RPG with a different twist, whereas in previous dungeon crawlers the objective is to find the dungeons and monsters to clear them, the player creates the dungeon (or a monster lair in this case) in order to attract the monster and trap it to destroy it. There are 23 different rooms to customize for the player's Monster Lair.
The story takes place in a small town called South Arc where the nearby forests are harboring monsters who regularly invade the town and scare of the citizens. This is where the player takes control of an orphan called Owen who is searching for his first job where he encounters a magical talking shovel. After realizing his destiny, he decides to start digging a lair and destroy the monster infestation.
The view of the game uses the DS dual-screen technology, showing the world in the top screen while the bottom screen will show maps and item menus. The gameplay is the standard turn-based RPG battle, selecting options from a menu such as attack and casting spells as well as the option to turn and run from the battle.

Game.Name: Match 3 Madness
Game.Overview: Easy Interactive has announced today's launch of Match 3 Madness on Nintendo DS. Match 3 Madness is the definitive collection of Match-3 games, combining addictive puzzle gameplay with extraordinary power-ups and an enjoyable construction twist.

Game.Name: Matching Maker DS
Game.Overview: Machi-Ing Maker DS is a Strategy game, developed by Indi Software Co., Ltd. and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2008. you talk directly with the townspeople and by fixing the worries that they share with you, you increase your intimacy with them so they'll invite their friends to grow the population of your town.

Game.Name: Matchstick
Game.Overview:
Matchstick features more than 150 puzzles with three difficulty settings, making it easy to pick up but challenging to master!
Using the stylus to move and rotate the matches on screen, puzzles range from mathematical and wordbased problems to Roman numeral and shapes challenges! 3 different difficulty levels 2 modes â€“ Time Attack and Normal Use the stylus to move and rotate the matches on screen Puzzles ranging from mathematical and word based problems to Roman numeral and shapes Simple to use, but fiendish to complete

Game.Name: Math Blaster in the Prime Adventure
Game.Overview: The award-winning PC edutainment series, Math Blaster in the Prime Adventure, is blasting its way on to the Nintendo DS with an all-new adventure. Put your math skills to the ultimate test in this action-packed adventure that adds up to total fun!

Game.Name: Mathe Buddy: 5. Klasse
Game.Overview:
With Mathe Buddy, even the most obsessed with numbers becomes a math high-flyer!
It doesn't matter whether it's number systems, fractions and percentages, equations, angles or geometric figures: all topics are clearly explained and the glossary contains the most important mathematical terms with easy-to-understand explanations. The tests show whether you are already fit enough for the next math test.

Game.Name: Mathe Buddy: 6. Klasse
Game.Overview:
With Mathe Buddy, even the most obsessed with numbers becomes a math high-flyer!
It doesn't matter whether it's number systems, fractions and percentages, equations, angles or geometric figures: all topics are clearly explained and the glossary contains the most important mathematical terms with easy-to-understand explanations. The tests show whether you are already fit enough for the next math test.

Game.Name: Mathematik 1.-4. Klasse 2012
Game.Overview:
Playfully to better grades with the Nintendo DS Mathematics 1.-4. class (version 2012)
Over 750 different tasks, suitable for the school material of the 1st to 4th class: addition - subtraction - multiplication - division - text and geometry tasks.
Features: - Child-friendly tasks and exercises developed by educators - More users - two children can learn at the same time - Automatic adjustment of the level of difficulty according to learning success - Included: mental arithmetic trainer: basic arithmetic operations in the number ranges 0-20, 0-100, 0-1000
Nintendo DS - Mathematics 1st-4th Class 2012 is the best preparation for the requirements of secondary schools. â€‹

Game.Name: Mathematik 1.-4. Klasse: Fit fuers Gymnasium
Game.Overview:
Fit for high school! Mathematics - German - Expertise - English
Elementary school 1st-4th Class is the digital and further developed version of the classic flashcard box. Just like a card box, this game can be used to learn the learning content with extreme effectiveness. The game makes use of the well-known and proven principle of learning through repetition. The learning successes that you achieved with elementary school 1.-4. class can not be achieved with any other conventional learning method.
The program contains a total of over 2,000 practice questions from the areas of German, mathematics, English and general knowledge as well as a helpful mental arithmetic trainer that can create an endless number of tasks with different levels of difficulty.
Your child will be assigned to a level depending on the age group selected. Level 1 and 2 correspond to the first class, level 3 and 4 to the second class, etc. In order to reach the next higher level, at least 80% of the questions must be answered correctly in one round. In this way, ambition is awakened and the joy of learning is maintained through a sense of achievement.
Over 2000 tasks for mathematics, German, general knowledge and English: * Mathematics: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, text and geometry problems * German: spelling, grammar, punctuation, word fields, root words * Expertise: geography of Germany and Europe, nature, animals, plants, nutrition, time * English: the most important words from the areas: my home, my family & me

Game.Name: Mathematik und Deutsch 1.-4. Klasse 2013
Game.Overview:
For Mathematics & German 1.-4. Class 2013 is an educational game that can be used to work on and practice math and German learning content for elementary school classes 1 to 4 inclusive. The player initially enters the level of the current school class himself when registering as a user.
Depending on the number of correctly answered questions per round of questions, the level of difficulty is then automatically adjusted to the skills of the player. The next level of difficulty is reached when at least 80% of the questions have been answered correctly at the current level.
Playfully to better grades - Child-friendly tasks and exercises developed by educators - More users - two children can learn at the same time - Automatic adjustment of the level of difficulty according to learning success - Included: mental arithmetic trainer: basic arithmetic operations in the number ranges 0-20, 0-100, 0-1000

Game.Name: Mathematik und Deutsch: 1.-4. Klasse: 2014
Game.Overview:
Nintendo DS - Mathematics & German 1.-4. Class of 2014 Over 2,750 different tasks, suitable for the school material of the 1st to 4th grade.
Math made easy The little ones get to know the world of mathematics step by step. In addition to simple addition and subtraction tasks, the kids also learn multiplication and division. But the children can also try their hand at interesting and school-related text and geometry tasks.
Learn grammar without despair Acquiring the correct form of the German language is a fundamental skill that the kids will need for the future. With the well thought-out questions about the German language regarding spelling, grammar, punctuation, word fields and word roots, learning is literally child's play.
Playfully to better grades - Over 1000 new tasks! Child-friendly tasks and exercises developed by educators More users - two children can learn at the same time Automatic adjustment of the level of difficulty according to learning success Including mental arithmetic trainer: basic arithmetic operations in the number ranges 0-20, 0-100, 0-1000

Game.Name: Math Play
Game.Overview:
Put your math skills to the test as you arrange colorful numbered cards and create equations in four challenging game play modes. With a variety of difficulty levels, competitive multiplayer action and addictive puzzle play, Math Play is a wonderful game for the whole family, young and old alike. No matter how you play, it adds up to great fun!
Special Features
â€¢ 4 Brain Boosting Game Modes! â€¢ Up to 5 Players

Game.Name: Maths Made Simple
Game.Overview: Learn simple and fun ways to perform complex calculations Lesson mode with 17 different calculation methods Choice of gameplay modes including Lesson, Quiz, Drill and Skill Exam Ambling Arithmetic's minigame, an endurance mode to check your true maths skill Nine different costumes for the main character including a professor, magician and explorer

Game.Name: Matsuda Tadanori Onsen Kyouju Kanshuu: Zenkoku Dokodemo Onsen Techou
Game.Overview: Osumitsuki Series: Matsuda Tadanori Onsen Kyouju Kanshuu - Zenkoku DokoDemo Onsen Techou is a Japanese-exclusive Nintendo DS title released in 2007 that serves as a digital guidebook to Japan's hot springs.

Game.Name: Mawashite Tsunageru Touch Panic
Game.Overview: Mawashite Tsunageru Touch Panic (roughly translated as Slide and Turn: Touch Panic) is a Nintendo DS video game released in 2006 by AKI Corporation (developer) and Nintendo (publisher) exclusively in Japan. The game is a variation of Pipe Dream, which much more depth. In Touch Panic, you'll alter the positions of panels in order to get your Touch Balls or Panic Balls (referred to as both in English language references) around the stage and to the end. The game is completely touch screen driven.

Game.Name: Max & the Magic Marker
Game.Overview:
Max & the Magic Marker is a platformer video game released for WiiWare, PlayStation 3, Nintendo DS, Macintosh, Microsoft Windows, iOS, Windows Phone 7, and Windows Phone 8. It is developed by Press Play.
The protagonist is a boy named Max, who draws a monster with a special magic marker that he happened to come across. The monster comes to life, invades Max's drawings and begins wreaking havoc in them. Max must chase and get rid of the monster, with the help of the magic marker. Max & the Magic Marker is a platform game with gameplay elements similar to Crayon Physics where the magic marker is controlled by the mouse and is used to create physics objects such as platforms and boxes to assist Max in his adventure. The Magic Marker is used by the player to create bridges, platforms and heavy objects to help Max cross caverns, rise up on moving objects, or be propelled in the air via a see-saw.

Game.Name: May's Mystery: Forbidden Memories
Game.Overview:
Over 270 Brain Teasers, Hidden Objects & Rhythmic Games in a Puzzle Adventure
Experience The Adventure-Follow May as she searches for her missing brother, discovering the mysteries and secrets of the puzzling City of Dragonville.

Game.Name: Mazes of Fate
Game.Overview:
The ancient gods have passed judgment, and as a result all of mankind has been sentenced to be replaced with a new, less sinful race. The only chance for redemption lies withing a magical item that will allow mankind to atone for its sins. But the item in question has been stolen by the enemies of humanity, and the verdict of the gods will soon come to pass.
Mazes of Fate is a fantasy medieval first person "dungeon-crawler" RPG in which you create a character based on gender, class and attributes (or take your pick from one of the three pre-made characters) and set out in a quest to save the human race from oblivion. The game alternates between world and town map sequences in which you control your party from an overhead perspective and visit shops and get quests from NPCs and the many dungeons that compose the bulk of the game itself. While dungeon crawling the game switches to a first-person perspective from which you control your party as it fights all the monsters that cross your path and loot the treasures uncovered. Combat is real-time although the game pauses while you navigate action menus.
Features loads of items, weapons and quests, as well as tons of monsters and up to 5 recruit-able party members.

Game.Name: Me And My Dogs: Friends Forever
Game.Overview:
Dream of having your own cute dog? Thanks to Me and My Dogs: Friends Forever, you can have up to three of the cutest pups imaginable and take them with you everywhere you go!
Choose from Labradors, ChowChows and Beagles. Like real dogs, youâ€™ll have to feed, wash, and give them lots of love. Play in the park, teach them tricks or have them compete at the stadium. You can even call them like in real life thanks to the microphone! Plus, personalize your in-game profile with the camera feature.

Game.Name: Meccha! Taiko no Tatsujin DS: 7-tsu no Shima no Daibouken
Game.Overview:
Metcha! Taiko no Tatsujin DS: 7-tsu no Shima no Daibouken is a rhythm game where players use the DS's touch screen to play the taiko drum along to various songs. The game features a story mode where players embark on an adventure across seven islands. Each island has its own set of challenges and songs to play, gradually revealing more of the game's narrative as players progress.
Gameplay involves tapping, swiping, and holding the stylus on the touch screen in time with the music. Players must match the rhythm and follow on-screen prompts to successfully complete songs and challenges. The game includes a variety of musical genres and difficulty levels, providing both casual and more experienced players with an enjoyable drumming experience.

Game.Name: Mechanic Master
Game.Overview: Mechanic Master for the Nintendo DS includes gameplay akin to The Incredible Machine, where players need to drag objects onto the screen to create Rube Goldberg devices (inventions intended to carry out a single purpose in chain reactions) in order to defeat aliens, as well as rescuing humans trapped in cages. The main storyline involves players constructing various objects to save Earth from an alien invasion. The game includes 3 gameplay modes to choose from.

Game.Name: Mechanic Master 2
Game.Overview: Mechanic Master 2 offers an exciting new gameplay feature for this crazy puzzler: disassemble objects to create hybrid gadgets. Players are challenged by 110 new levels, and must use dozens of new objects (60+ in total) to make things work out. New drawable shapes in Drawing Mode include the magnet, ball and black hole. There's also a built-in level editor, and you can share your levels with friends via a local wireless connection.

Game.Name: MechAssault: Phantom War
Game.Overview: MechAssault: Phantom War is one of the games in the popular MechWarrior series and is part of the BattleTech universe created by FASA. Players assume the role of a BattleMech pilot in a 3D environment with a third person view of the combat via the top screen of the DS, while the touch screen displays the inside of the cockpit and acts as the game's controls.

Game.Name: Medarot DS: Kabuto Ver.
Game.Overview: After a 7-year hiatus, the Medabots series returns in its sixth mainline entry.

Game.Name: Medarot DS: Kuwagata Ver.
Game.Overview: After a 7-year hiatus, the Medabots series returns in its sixth mainline entry.

Game.Name: Me de Unou o Kitaeru: DS Sokudoku Junior
Game.Overview: Me de Unou o Kitaeru: DS Sokudoku Junior is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by MileStone Inc., which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Me de Unou o Kitaeru: DS Sokudoku Jutsu
Game.Overview: Me de Unou o Kitaeru: DS Sokudoku Jutsu is an educational game, developed and published by MileStone, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Meet the Robinsons
Game.Overview: Meet the Robinsons refers to three different video games based on a film by the same name. The Xbox 360 version of this game became backwards compatible with the Xbox One in March 2017.

Game.Name: Mega Bloks: Diego's Build and Rescue
Game.Overview: Join Diego and enter the imaginative world of Mega Bloks in his first building block video game adventure! Use Mega Bloks to construct bridges, build air, land and sea rescue vehicles, explore exciting habitats from the Artic to the Rainforest, and rescue stranded animals! Let's Build! Â¡Vamos a Construir!

Game.Name: Mega Brain Boost
Game.Overview: Now you can boost your brain power with 3 full games on 1 cartridge! The brain produces five wavelengths: alpha, beta, delta, gamma and theta waves. Brain Boost Gamma Wave and Brain Boost Beta Wave are individual games designed to develop the right brain by increasing your recognition of images/shapes/spatial patterns, illustrations and intuition. In Mega Brain Boost, youâ€™ll get both of these previously released titles, plus a third entirely new game! All three games utilize Makoto Shichidaâ€™s â€œright brain development theoryâ€ to train your brain.

Game.Name: Mega Man Battle Network 5: Double Team DS
Game.Overview: Mega Man Battle Network 5: Double Team is a dual screen version of the Game Boy Advance title. The DS will combine both Team Protoman and Team Colonel in one game, but add specific content unique to the Nintendo DS version. The second screen comes into play by giving players direct access to their Cyber Map and PET. The microphone can be "yelled" into to power up Mega Man during battle. And using the Nintendo DS's GBA slot, players can carry over battle chips earned in past Mega Man Battle Network games for use in the Nintendo DS edition.

Game.Name: Mega Man Battle Network: Operate Star Force
Game.Overview:
The game is set in the Battle Network setting (specifically the first Battle Network title), but both MegaMan.EXE and Geo Stelar (as Mega Man) appear together and are playable. The game is largely identical to the original title with the exception of an extra chapter involving Geo's appearance and a battle against a new NetNavi named ClockMan. However this chapter is completely disconnected from the storyline of the game and is not mentioned again afterward.
In the prologue, Harp Note is kidnapped by ClockMan.EXE (a NetNavi able to travel through time by creating warp holes), who escapes to the Mega Man Battle Network era 200 years in the past. Dr. Goodall prepares a warp hole to allow the Star Force Mega Man to follow them, and warns him that he can only return to his time if he finds ClockMan.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force 2: Zerker x Ninja
Game.Overview: Mega Man Star Force returns, delivering another iconic, action-driven Mega Man portable RPG adventure, featuring a totally upgraded, cutting-edge interface utilizing the latest online communication and device customization techniques. Developed by the team behind the popular Mega Man Battle Network series, Geo Stelar and crew return to battle a whole host of new enemies including the mysterious Rogue who threatens the peace of the virtual Wave World by unleashing hordes of rampaging viruses. It's up to Geo and his virus-busting buddy, Omega-Xis, to thwart this latest threat. Mega Man Star Force 2 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World, to unravel the mystery around this new troublemaker. Players will encounter enemies in the virtual Wave World and battle them on three-by-five battle grids with their Battle Card deck. Mega Man Star Force 2 also adds an upgraded Transer system.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force 2: Zerker x Saurian
Game.Overview: Mega Man Star Force 2 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World, to unravel the mystery around this new troublemaker.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force 3: Black Ace
Game.Overview: Mega Man Star Force returns in the most thrilling series adventure yet, delivering totally upgraded and cutting-edge online communication and device customization technologies through a portable RPG adventure that is brought to life in the iconic, action-driven Mega Man way! New to the series are "Noise Changes," random enhancements that change Mega Man's form and unlock new abilities. There are more than 100 transformations possible. Mega Man Star Force 3 will be available in two versions, Red Joker and Black Ace, each with their own unique Noise Types. Mega Man Star Force 3 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World. Players will encounter enemies in the virtual Wave World and battle them on three-by-five battle grids with their Battle Card deck. Mega Man Star Force 3 also adds a new feature called "Rezon," which allow players to fill in profiles about battles and their team name/symbol.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force 3: Red Joker
Game.Overview: Mega Man Star Force returns in the most thrilling series adventure yet, delivering totally upgraded and cutting-edge online communication and device customization technologies through a portable RPG adventure that is brought to life in the iconic, action-driven Mega Man way! New to the series are "Noise Changes," random enhancements that change Mega Man's form and unlock new abilities. There are more than 100 transformations possible. Mega Man Star Force 3 will be available in two versions, Red Joker and Black Ace, each with their own unique Noise Types. Mega Man Star Force 3 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World. Players will encounter enemies in the virtual Wave World and battle them on three-by-five battle grids with their Battle Card deck. Mega Man Star Force 3 also adds a new feature called "Rezon," which allow players to fill in profiles about battles and their team name/symbol.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force: Dragon
Game.Overview:
When aliens from planet FM plot to invade Earth, alien Omega-Xis escapes to warn a courageous boy, Geo Stelar. Together, they must face the aliens on the electromagnetic system known as the Wave Road, and combine to become the ultimate champion for Earth: Mega Man!
Dynamic Brother Band system - Play up to 6 friends for power-ups in combat: Favorite Cards, Link Ability, Best Combo, Connect and Transform. Call upon the Power of the Elements - Use the Wood Shot to send razor sharp leaves at the enemies. New Battle System - Enter the Wave Road to battle in the new third person perspective!

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force DX
Game.Overview:
Mega Man Star Force DX is a mod for Mega Man Star Force 1 that completely modernizes the game. It includes many new features, changes and tweaks throughout the entire game that bring the game up to speed with MMSF2 and MMSF3. This mod aims to create more gameplay depth and replayability, unify all three versions of the game, reduce the reliance on multiplayer, and much more.
Please note that Mega Man Star Force DX requires an original copy of Mega Man Star Force: Pegasus (US version) to play. It will not work on any other version!
Features: The font has been changed to that of MMSF2/MMSF3, with all text in the game updated to make use of it. Star Cards have been added - these replicate the effects of the Japan-exclusive Wave Scanner peripheral. All touch screen inputs and minigames can now be done with just the buttons. A new difficulty setting, Legend Mode, has been added. There are now two save slots, and saving speed has been increased. The Lunar Knights crossover scenario, Brother Band and Battle Cards have been restored from the Japanese versions. Lunar Knights Brother Bands can be obtained in single player. You can now obtain Power Up data, which was originally obtained from the Japan-exclusive Wave Scanner peripheral. All three Star Force transformations can be obtained in a single game, and have received unique new abilities to set them apart from each other. All version-exclusive Satellite admin bosses can be fought. All version-exclusive Giga Class cards can be obtained. New side quests have been added, and you can now take on multiple at once. A new EM Database feature allows you to track the battle data and location of all viruses and bosses. The event-exclusive Andromeda card and Legendary Master Shin Brother Band can now be obtained in the game.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force: Leo
Game.Overview: Mega Man Star Force introduces a new lead character, a boy named Subaru Hoshikawa, who puts on special "visualizer" goggles left to him by his father, triggering a specific wave and summoning the presence of a mysterious alien life form named Warlock. Dangerous creatures from Warlock's planet have come to attack Earth, so they must join together to transform into Mega Man in order to defeat these menacing forces. Specific to the Leo version - turning up the heat, Fire Leo uses a special Flame Burner attack that can incinerate enemies in its path.

Game.Name: Mega Man Star Force: Pegasus
Game.Overview:
Many years in the future, humankind has finally discovered extraterrestrial life. In an effort to make contact with aliens, they have created a Space Station called 'Peace'. However, the space station mysteriously vanished, and all attempts to find it were in vain. Now, three years later, the son of one of those on-board the satellite has an encounter with an alien life-form from the Planet FM. The alien, Omega-Xis (or Mega for short) meets Geo Stelar. Together, they are able to explore Earth's hidden Wave World and become Mega Man.
Mega Man Star Force is an Action RPG in the vein of Mega Man Battle Network. Players assume the role of Geo Stelar, who can explore the real world of Earth. All devices in Earth use a wireless network called the Wave World to send data and communicate. By merging with Mega, Geo becomes Mega Man and can explore the Wave World to destroy viruses, fix machines, and read secret info in people's Transer devices (which allow communication between others). After a key point in the game, Mega Man can also use the power of one of the three different satellites - in this version, Pegasus, which has powerful ice attacks.
As Mega is a fugitive, he is being hunted by others from Planet FM. This means that other nasty FM-ians will turn up and cause trouble on Earth, and Mega Man will need to fight them. Battles take place on the top screen in third person, behind Mega Man. At the start of each turn, you can select your cards which can be used as powerful attacks or defenses for Mega Man. You can move Mega Man left or right to avoid attacks and shoot, or you can put up a shield to block most attacks. At the end of a battle, you are rewarded with money, health, or even new cards, depending on how well you did.
Unique to the game is the "Brother Band" system, which lets other people lend you their powers and cards. The more Brothers you link up with, the more powerful your Mega Man becomes. You can either link up with virtual Brothers in the game, or real friends online through Nintendo WFC or local wireless. You can also connect up with friends who have the other satellite versions of the game to gain their powers too.

Game.Name: Mega Man Zero Collection
Game.Overview:
The Mega Man Zero series is comprised of all four Mega Man Zero titles previously released on the GameBoy Advance onto one cartridge for the Nintendo DS. In the tradition of most Mega Man games, the Mega Man Zero Collection is a fast-paced, 2D action side-scrolling platform game. For the first time, it will be available for Nintendo DS complete with all new modes.
First launched on the GameBoy Advance in 2002, the Mega Man Zero series follows Zero, originally introduced in Mega Man X. Players will be able to use Zeroâ€™s arsenal of weapons which include his Z-Saber and Buster Shot. Also adding new flavor to the series are the additions of devices such as the Chain Rod and Zero Knuckle, giving Zero the advantage.
The series begins with our hero waking up 100 years after the events of Mega Man X. Zero finds himself in a world where innocent reploids (robots) are being hunted down by the government of â€œNeo Arcadia.â€ A resistance group finds our hero and asks Zero to fight alongside them against the evil regime. The series follows Zero on his adventures as he battles the government of Neo Arcadia and his fight for peace!

Game.Name: Mega Man ZX
Game.Overview: Mega Man ZX continues the incredible Mega Man X saga! It's been years since the wars between humans and Reploids. They now coexist peacefully, with humans using new Biometal technology to give them Reploid-like powers and Reploids giving up their immortality. When a mysterious group attacks three couriers delivering Model X and Model Z Biometals, they respond by fusing themselves with the Biometals, creating Model ZX! With powerful abilities at their disposal, they must discover who their enemies are and what they are after.

Game.Name: Mega Man ZX: Advent
Game.Overview:
Choose between two mega metal heroes, Grey or Ashe! Each Mega Man follows a unique and exciting adventure that is linked with the other heroâ€™s. This Mega Man series deliver twice the action! High-intensity action and bold, new gameplay elements make Mega Man ZX Advent the definitive Mega Man experience!
Featuring Co-Op and Head-To-Head two player wireless play, dynamic "Biometal" system allowing players to transform into 14 different battle forms, two playable characters, Grey and Ashe, each with unique abilities and individual, but linked storylines, and Area Expansion - explore and open up new areas with access to additional quests

Game.Name: Megamind: The Blue Defender
Game.Overview:
Megamind: The Blue Defender, is a 3D character action game with additional elements of exploration, puzzle solving and ability collecting/swapping. The game is based on the film Megamind. The player assumes the role of Megamind â€“ the super villain determined on exacting revenge on Metroman.
Just as Megamind has become our new Mega Hero, a sudden crime wave hits the city. The Doom Syndicate & their Doom Goons have emerged and are looking to take over! They have broken into Megamind's Lair and Hal has transformed himself into "Blue" Titan. Unfortunately, due to a mishap Hal has taken both Megamind's & Metroman's essence. It is up to Megamind to once again clear the city of crime finding clues to make his way to Titan.
With help from an arsenal of weapons, they player gets to destroy, shoot and punch his or her way through a city populated by goons and members of the Doom Syndicate. The player can use various abilities against enemies. Aside from shooting Megamind must also collect abilities, explore and solve puzzles to reach the end of each level. Action is a large part of the game: the player spends the majority of his or her time fighting ex-creation robots and other enemies. At regular intervals in the game, the player also encounters bosses which require a different approach. Each boss has its own theme, and requires more than running and gunning to defeat them.
Megamind's abilities are gained through finding and unlocking new weapons scattered throughout the levels. Each weapon is also able to trigger special objects found in the levels to open up new paths and collectibles. Finding all collectibles and unlocks in the game requires the player to go through each level multiple times.

Game.Name: Mega Mindy
Game.Overview: The first product of the cooperation between Engine and ThePharmacy, MegaMindy is a 3D platforming game based on the highly succesful TV Series with the same name. Discover what mysteries lie in the range of crimes that have been happening, use the inventions of your uncle, and defeat the evil Volta before it is too late.

Game.Name: Mehr KreuzwortrÃ¤tsel
Game.Overview:
Mehr KreuzwortrÃ¤tsel Ensure fresh head nuts: Over 1100 new crossword puzzles are waiting to be solved by them.
Special puzzles from different areas of knowledge will help you to train your knowledge.The different levels of difficulty ensure smoking gray cells in beginners and advanced.
More crossword - new puzzle fun for young and old now on your Nintendo DS!
Features: * Handwriting recognition, intuitive operation for Nintendo DS newbies * 5 Different areas of knowledge with knowledge progress check * Over 1110 crossword puzzles in German * High quality puzzles created by SZ experts * Simple operation also for Nintendo DS newbies.

Game.Name: Mein Franzoesisch Coach: Verbessere Dein Franzoesisch
Mein Traumjob: Kinderaerztin
Game.Overview: Slip into the role of a young medical graduate. Your dean of studies congratulates you on the excellent completion of your studies and you are already being offered your first job: Dr. Carmen MÃ¶ller is a pediatrician but would like to retire soon. She is therefore looking for a successor who can take over her practice. She knows that you are not only extremely competent, but also very kind when dealing with babies and children. She therefore suggests that you start with her. Is not that great? You must be looking forward to helping your little patients! And don't worry: until you have settled in, Dr. MÃ¶ller will of course support you and explain everything you need to know. It won't be long before you're an excellent pediatrician. Find out what's wrong with your little patients... Right from day one there are loads of little patients who need your help. You come into the practice and take a seat more or less patiently in the waiting room. You probably know this routine from your own visits to the doctor... But now it's your turn: Call the patients into the consulting room - preferably the most urgent cases first! Ask the children the appropriate questions to find out exactly what is missing. Babies can't speak yet, of course, but that's what their mum is there for... Then you can carefully and lovingly examine the little ones: listen to their lungs, take X-rays, do blood tests... You'll learn about the necessary medical equipment in the course of the Gradually develop the game... and then make sure that your patients are better off. If you have made the correct diagnosis based on the examinations, you can continue with the treatment. You can treat many patients right away in your practice: remove ticks, apply plasters, apply cooling gels and even immobilize broken bones with a plaster cast... Others need a prescription sheet instead so that they know how to treat themselves: calf compresses for fever or but rather ointments against itching?
