Game.Name: Nintendoji
Game.Overview: Nintendoji is a downloadable DSiWare game that was only released to gold and platinum Club Nintendo members in Japan. It was released on April 4, 2013 on the Nintendo eShop. It plays as a dungeon-crawling role-playing game in which a young man named Kageshina Kurabe tries to save a country on the brink of destruction.

Game.Name: Nintendo Zone Wireless Distribution Box DS Card
Game.Overview:
The Nintendo Zone Box is a special DS developed in collaboration with Nintendo and Mitsumi Electronics. This specialized Nintendo DS can connect to Nintendo's official Nintendo Zone server with the use of a cartridge, and is the main device for creating a Nintendo Zone setup at a local wifi network. Though at the end of the day, this is just a regular Nintendo DS with a screen missing, and all of its functions can be replicated on a retail DS.
Since the Nintendo Zone Box has no special software built into its system, all of the required Nintendo Zone Box software is on DS carts that can be used on retail hardware as well. The beacon (in case of Nintendo Zone) is the starting point for a Nintendo Zone setup. The cartridge contains a payload and a SSID. The beacon checks if the SSID matches with the SSID the DSi is currently connected to (eg. if the SSID on the cart is â€œBestBuyâ€, the SSID on the network must be the same).
Currently, one beacon cartridge is known to be dumped. This cartridge was used at Best Buy.

Game.Name: Nippon Futsal League Kounin: Minna no DS Futsal
Game.Overview: Nippon Futsal League Kounin: Minna no DS Futsal is a Sports game, developed and published by Jorudan, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Nippon Shuzan Renmei Kanshuu: Itsudemo Soroban DS
Game.Overview: Nippon Shuzan Renmei Kanshuu: Itsudemo Soroban DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Suzak and published by Four Winds, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Nippon Suugaku Kentei Kyoukai Kounin: Suken DS: Otona ga Tokenai! Kodomo no Sansuu
Game.Overview: Nippon Suugaku Kentei Kyoukai Kounin: Suuken DS - Otona ga Tokenai!? Kodomo no Sansuu is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Nobunaga no Yabou DS
Game.Overview: Nobunaga no Yabou is a Strategy game, developed and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 1983.

Game.Name: Nobunaga no Yabou DS 2
Game.Overview: Nobunaga no Yabou DS 2 is a Strategy game, developed and published by Koei, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Nodame Cantabile
Game.Overview:
Based on the manga and anime of the same name, Nodame Cantabile follows the odd couple of Shinichi Chiaki and Megumi Noda. Both are students at the prestigious Momogaoka College of Music; Shinichi is a studious and strict conductor while Megumi is a pianist known for her loose and inventive playing style. While the original manga focuses on the development of their relationship, this game adaptation is more of a slice-of-life story taking place partway through the original story.
The main game mode is a rhythm game in which players control Shinichi and conduct classical music performances. Large notes flow towards the left from the right side of the touchscreen, and lines of notes fly down from the top of the screen; players need to tap the large notes as lines of notes reach them. In addition to large notes, there are also streams of notes; with these, players need to hold the stylus down while following the shape of the stream as it moves over the screen. In addition to the main game mode, there are also a variety of short minigames featuring various characters from the manga.

Game.Name: Nodame Cantabile: Tanoshii Ongaku no Jikan Desu
Game.Overview: Nodame Cantabile: Tanoshii Ongaku no Jikan Desu is a classical music-based rhythm game. Players tap notes flowing across the screen using the DS's stylus, aiming to match the rhythm accurately. The game features a Concert Hall mode with 30 tracks and a Music Salon mode with 180 tracks. Additionally, there is a trivia quiz mode with several hundred questions related to the series.

Game.Name: Noddy in Toyland
Game.Overview: Includes fun musical, picture, number, puzzle and memory games 3 levels - easy, medium and hard to suit all ages Medal reward system to keep kids motivated Encourages the development of memory, logic, problem-solving and creative skills

Game.Name: Nora to Toki no Koubou: Kiri no Mori no Majo
Game.Overview: Nora to Toki no Koubou: Kiri no Mori no Majo is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Atlus, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Game.Name: Norimono Oukoku DS: You! Unten Shichainayo!
Game.Overview: Norimono Oukoku DS: You! Unten Shichainayo!* (which translates roughly to "Vehicle Kingdom DS: Hey! You! Drive It Now!") is a Japanese-exclusive simulation driving game for the Nintendo DS, developed by D3 Publisher and Tamsoft. It is designed primarily for children and features various "working vehicles" that players can operate using the touch pen.

Game.Name: Norinori Relakkuma: Hit Song Ongakusai
Game.Overview: Norinori Relakkuma: Hit Song Ongakusai is an Action game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Nostalgia
Game.Overview: Set in an alternate-reality version of 19th-century Earth, Nostalgia casts you as Eddie, a headstrong Londoner who amasses a group of memorable companions to traverse the world in his steampunk-inspired zeppelin. As you navigate the open skies, you'll explore mysterious foreign locales, slay all manner of fantastical enemies, complete a variety of thrilling quests, and ultimately, save the world from unfathomable evil.

Game.Name: Nounai Aesthe IQ Suppli DS
Game.Overview: Nounai Aesthe: IQ Suppli DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Art and published by Spike, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Nounai Aesthe IQ Suppli DS 2: Sukkiri King Ketteisen
Game.Overview: Nounai Aesthe IQ Suppli DS 2: Sukkiri King Ketteisen is a Japanese puzzle/brain-training game for the Nintendo DS, a sequel to the original IQ Suppli, focusing on various number and word puzzles to test and improve your brainpower, released by Spike in 2007. Known as a brain game/IQ tester, it's a Japan-exclusive release, featuring various logic and mental exercises for one to four players.

Game.Name: Nova Usagi no Game de Ryuugaku! DS
Game.Overview: Nova Usagi no Game de Ryuugaku!? DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: NRL Mascot Mania
Game.Overview:
The National Rugby League (NRL) mascots have a strange preseason tradition: they take each other on in grudge matches with their team's pride and honour at stake. The player takes control of one of sixteen NRL mascots. The gameplay is standard 3D platforming; players start in a world themed after their own team, and then move on through worlds themed after each other mascot with the goal of conquering them all. All sixteen of the mascots play essentially identically; each is a heavy character who can run, jump, and punch. Players are also able to collect digital versions of Select NRL trading cards scattered throughout the levels.
NRL Mascot Mania was released alongside the nearly-identical AFL Mascot Manor, which features very similar gameplay and an Australian Football League mascot theme.

Game.Name: Number Battle
Game.Overview:
From Japan comes a new kind of board game that combines puzzle and strategy in a battle of wits. Take turns against human or computer opponents to reach a target score, by placing numbered tiles on the board.
Score points by linking the arms of each tile in various ways: tiles with the same number or sequence of numbers, and tiles in a loop. Also look out for special squares that affect play in new ways, and useful items that aid you in your pursuit of points.
Go it alone in the main Story or Puzzle modes, or battle against up to three opponents across the world via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. You can even learn from your past with History mode, showing the moves recorded during previous Nintendo WFC contests.

Game.Name: Nursery Mania
Game.Overview: Step Into the Worldful and Challenging World of Childcare! Operate a nursery and take care of your very own darling baby! Experience the endless rewards of caring for a child in this babysitting-inspired game for Nintendo DS! - Engage in childcare activities such as cleaning, feeding and playing - Keep your baby happy with a range of fun games - "Accessorize" your baby with diapers, pacifiers, blankets and more

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-jun Chiri DS
Game.Overview: Obunsha Deru-jun Chiri DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-jun: Kokugo DS
Game.Overview: Obunsha Deru-jun Kokugo DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-jun: Koumin DS
Game.Overview: Oubunsha Deru-Jun: Koumin DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Mechanic Arms and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2007

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-jun: Rekishi DS
Game.Overview: Oubunsha Deru-Jun: Rekishi DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Mechanic Arms and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-Jun: Rika DS
Game.Overview: Oubunsha Deru-Jun: Rika DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Obunsha Deru-jun: Sansuu DS
Game.Overview: Oubunsha Deru-Jun: Sansuu DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Mechanic Arms and published by IE Institute, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Ochaken no Daibouken 2: Yume Ippai no Omocha Bako
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Daibouken 2: Yume Ippai no Omocha Hako is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Ochaken no Daibouken: Honwaka Yumemiru Sekai Ryokou
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Daibouken: Honwaka Yumemiru Sekai Ryokou is a 2007 Japanese action platformer for the Nintendo DS, developed by MTO and based on the Ocha-ken (Tea Dog) franchise. In the game, players control one of the tea dogs and explore a world to complete objectives.

Game.Name: Ochaken no Heya DS
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Heya DS is a Life Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2006

Game.Name: Ochaken no Heya DS 2
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Heya DS 2 is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Ochaken no Heya DS 3
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Heya DS 3 is a Simulation game, developed and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Ochaken no Heya DS 4: Ochaken Land de Hotto Shiyo?
Game.Overview: Ochaken no Heya DS 4: Ochaken Land de Hotto Shiyo? is a Simulation game, developed by HuneX and published by MTO, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Odekake! Earth Seeker
Game.Overview: Odekake! Earth Seeker is a companion game on DSiWare featuring connectivity with the Wii RPG Earth Seeker. It is a collection of six mini games in which players can procure items and transfer them to the Wii game.

Game.Name: Oden-kun: Tanoshii Oden Mura
Game.Overview: Odenkun: Tanoshii Oden Mura is an Action game, developed and published by Hudson, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Odoru Daisousasen the Game: Sensuikan ni Sennyuu Seyo!
Game.Overview:
This adventure game is based on the movies with the same title and the story takes place during the time between the first and the second movie. It is March 19th, 2003. In the bay area police jurisdiction, at a fort in Minato, a harbor ward in Tokyo, a male corpse was discovered. The victim seemed to have head bashed in. A special division stepped on the scene immediately and police headquarters dispatched a police detective, Shinji Muroi, to investigate the scene of the crime. Upon arrival, the local police informs Shinji of their preliminary findings and the victim's identity. Now he needs to find out what really happens, the motive behind the murder, and the perpetrator.
While the conversation dialogues do feel like a visual novel, the player character is established and appears on the screen during conversation with other characters, seeing on-screen characters from a profile instead of them looking at the screen. By visiting locations on the map, talking to other characters, questioning suspects, make logical deductions and play occasional mini-games, the player gets closer and closer to solving the crime.

Game.Name: Oekaki Puzzle Battle! Yuusha Ou GaoGaiGar Hen
Game.Overview: Oekaki Puzzle Battle Vol. 1: Yuusha-Oh GaoGaiGar Version is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Sunrise Interactive, which was released in Japan in 2005.

Game.Name: Ogwangui Darin DS
Game.Overview: Ogwangui Darin DS is a board game, developed and published by Daewon Media Co., Ltd., which was released in Korea in 2009.

Game.Name: Oha Star 645: Musshees no Fushigi na Nouen: Yoshimoto Geinin to Tomodachi Net
Game.Overview: Oha Star 645: Musshees no Fushigi na Nouen - Yoshimoto Geinin to Tomodachi Net is an Action game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Game.Name: Oheya o Kazarou: Koinu no Heya
Game.Overview: A wonderful space, a happy room for me and my puppy!! Let's go together! Play with dogs like the toy poodle, miniature dachshund, beagle, Yorkshire terrier, Labrador, dalmatian, Shih Tzu, German shepherd, boxer and golden retriever. A game or 1~4 people. 11 puppies with touch and voice, let's play! Item actions are cute. Let's go crazy! Brush and pet them.

Game.Name: Oishiku Kiwameru Shokutsuu DS: Otona no Shuumatsu Henshuubu Gensen no Osusume Omise Jouhou Iri
Game.Overview: *Oishiku Kiwameru Shokutsuu DS â€“ Otona no Shuumatsu Henshuubu Gensen no Osusume Omise Jouhou Iri* is an NDS game developed by Spike Chunsoft. This game is primarily a food recommendation game where players explore various restaurants and dishes to improve their culinary skills. It combines food recommendations with casual entertainment, allowing players to enjoy diverse culinary experiences while collecting information and recommendations for various restaurants. The game also includes rich culinary culture and historical knowledge, enabling players to learn more about different cuisines while enjoying their food. If you are a food lover, this game will definitely bring you a brand new culinary experience.

Game.Name: Oishinbo: DS Recipe Shuu
Game.Overview:
"Oishinbo: DS Recipe Shuu" is a cooking-themed game based on the popular Japanese manga and anime series "Oishinbo." Players take on the role of characters from the series, engaging in various culinary activities and challenges. The game is centered around creating and perfecting recipes, with a focus on Japanese cuisine.
The gameplay involves following recipes step-by-step to prepare different dishes. Players can gather ingredients, use various cooking techniques, and aim to achieve high scores based on their cooking performance. The game features multiple mini-games and tasks that mimic real-life cooking processes, such as chopping vegetables, grilling fish, and plating dishes. Players can also unlock new recipes and ingredients as they progress through the game.

Game.Name: Ojaru-Maru DS: Ojaru to Okeiko Aiueo
Game.Overview: Ojaru-Maru DS: Ojaru to Okeiko Aiueo is an Action game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Okada Toshio no Itsumademo DEBU to Omounayo: DS Recording Diet
Game.Overview: Okada Toshio no Itsumademo DEBU to Omounayo: DS Recording Diet is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Rocket Company, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Okaeri! Chibi-Robo! Happy Richie Oosouji
Game.Overview:
Okaeri! Chibi-Robo! Happy Richie ÅŒsÅji! is the third game in the Chibi-Robo series and only released in Japan.
You wake up as Chibi-Robo in a ruined building with only a minimal energy level left. Trying to escape from the room he's in you finally collapse from power outage, only to hear feint voices talking to you. When back on-line, you wake up in a small house and introduced to a person called "Telly". The "goal" of the game is to clean the house you're in by vacuuming dust. The power required to perform your task is given by plugging into an outlet. The only thing blocking your chore is the length and size of your cord and available energy for the house. This energy can be only be filled by collecting and compacting garbage.
The movements of Chibi-Robo are done by using the touchpad instead of the D-pad, like in Chibi-Robo!: Park Patrol. Whilst scavenging for trash, used to energize the house, enemies can attack Chibi-Robo depleting him of his energy, unless the player acts upon it, by fighting back with your plug cord or sucking them in with your vacuum

Game.Name: ÅŒkamiden
Game.Overview: Taking place many months after the events of Okami, Okamiden follows the adventures of Chibiterasu - a young sun god who is summoned to protect and restore the land. Armed with a majestic celestial brush and a vibrant cast of partners with unique powers and abilities, this little god is ready to make its mark on the world.

Game.Name: OK! Puzzle Stars
Game.Overview: OK! Puzzle Stars brings you a wealth of celebrity-themed puzzles and exclusive showbiz games from the world's biggest celebrity magazine. Step into the shoes of the OK! Magazine Editor in Chief and successfully get 12 celebrity packed issues off to the printers by completing all of the puzzles and bonus games.

Game.Name: Oktoberfest: The Official Game
Game.Overview: "Oktoberfest - The Official Game" has everything you need for a future party: show off your skills as a waiter, on the haunted house ride, finger fighting and thigh slapping, conducting and testing your strength! And as a bonus, the great Bavaria quiz is waiting for you.

Game.Name: Oli Octopus
Game.Overview: Oli Octopus Prototype

Game.Name: OMG 26: Our Mini Games
Game.Overview:
O.M.G! Solve the mysteries of the spooky mansion and discover the treasures within! With a variety of mini-games that will test all of your senses and skills, you and your brave band of friends will overcome many obstacles and try to escape unscathed!
This spook-tackular title is filled with fun and challenging mini-games that revolve around a haunted mansion theme. For a bit of fun and fright, this title is definitely the ticket for excitement! With over 25 mini-games that will have you fend off flying dishes, search for keys, escape from ginormous boulders and more, this title is perfect for on the go fun!

Game.Name: Onegai My Melody: Yume no Kuni no Daibouken
Game.Overview:
Onegai My Melody: Yume no Kuni no Daibouken (Japanese: ãŠã­ãŒã„ãƒžã‚¤ãƒ¡ãƒ­ãƒ‡ã‚£å¤¢ã®å›½ã®å¤§å†’é™º) or simply Onegai My Melody (Japanese: ãŠã­ãŒã„ãƒžã‚¤ãƒ¡ãƒ­ãƒ‡ã‚£) is a Nintendo DS game published by TDK Core, which was only released in Japan. It is based on the original Onegai My Melody anime series. The title screen of this game features the main theme of the original Onegai My Melody anime series.
As My Melody, players go through seven mainly sidescrolling levels with some boss battles. Before the level, a conversation may occur between My Melody and other characters such as Kuromi, Baku. My Melody and Kuromi even have their own voice samples.
If the player taps the Touch Screen, they can make her throw pink balls into the air using her Melody Tact to defeat enemies with her Melody Tact. While in the air, the player can tap the Touch Screen to make My Melody use a pink umbrella. While My Melody is using the umbrella, blowing into the Touch Screen will cause My Melody to rise up higher into the sky.

Game.Name: One Piece: Gear Spirit
Game.Overview: Gear Spirit is a 2D fighter, much like Super Smash Bros. or Jump Super Stars. Characters are controlled using the d-pad to move, the face buttons are used to attack and jump, and special attacks are performed by using cards on the touch screen. Fights consist of four player characters each gaining points from killing another characters via depleting their health or pushing them out of the ring, however, each player loses points for dying. The winner from each round is the player with the most points at the end of the time.

Game.Name: One Piece: Gigant Battle!
Game.Overview:
One Piece: Gigant Battle is a fighting game by Jump Ultimate Stars developer Ganbarion, and as such has similar gameplay to JUS. The game features 17 playable characters with over 45 Support characters. The story takes place on the Sabaody Archipelago.
One Piece: Gigant Battle features 4 modes of play. The Great Pirate Grand Prix serves as the sort campaign mode and you progress by selecting various points on the map it's laid out on. Each stage has a level indicator to let the player know how strong the opponent they're about to face is beforehand. Here you'll earn money, level characters, progress the story, etc.. The Thousand Arena is the basic arena mode where you simply fight opponents. Network Play for both wireless and download multiplayer. And Training is where you'll go to practice you fighting skills.
In Pirate Team Edit, you can set up a team composed of your various favorite characters to pit against other players.

Game.Name: One Piece: Gigant Battle! 2: Shinsekai
Game.Overview: One Piece: Gigant Battle! 2 New World is a Nintendo DS game published by Bandai and developed by Ganbarion. It is the sequel to One Piece: Gigant Battle. It focuses on the Post-War Arc and Fishman Island Arc, but contains content from previous arcs as well. The game was released on November 17, 2011. It has 45 playable characters and 97 support characters.

Game.Name: Oni Zero: Sengoku Ranse Hyakka Ryouran
Game.Overview: Oni Zero: Sengoku Ransei Hyakkaryouran is a Role-Playing game, developed by Shannon and published by Compile Heart, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Onsei Kanjou Sokuteiki: Kokoro Scan
Game.Overview: Onsei Kanjou Sokuteiki: Kokoro Scan (éŸ³å£°æ„Ÿæƒ…æ¸¬å®šå™¨ ã‚³ã‚³ãƒ­ã‚¹ã‚­ãƒ£ãƒ³) is a Nintendo DS game. While all games from Sega's Naruhodo edutainment series did not garner much mention, this game did. This is due to it's bizzare premise and unique use of the Nintendo DS microphone picking up nuances in emotions of the voice. This technology was developed by SGI Japan.[3]

Game.Name: Ontamarama
Game.Overview:
Ontamarama is an action rhythm game that makes full use of the DS' capabilities. Ontama appear on the screen, and can be tapped, tossed, and circled. Clearing an Ontama makes fills a note on the bar along the top of the screen, and when the note reaches the end of the bar, the correct button must be pressed to play the note. There are four different colored Ontama, and you also need to watch out for the white and black ones which can help or hinder you in other ways!
The game includes a story mode, a tutorial mode, a free play mode where you can play songs cleared in the story mode, and a challenge mode. There is also a shop where you can buy songs and items with points acquired during the game.

Game.Name: Ookami to Koushinryou: Boku to Holo no Ichinen
Game.Overview: Ookami to Koushinryou: Boku to Horo no Ichinen (or Spice and Wolf: Holo's and My One Year) is a business simulation based on the light novel series Spice and Wolf. In this game, you take the role of a merchant, traveling between areas and striking deals alongside series mainstay Holo.

Game.Name: Ookami to Koushinryou: Umi wo Wataru Kaze
Game.Overview:
Spice and Wolf: The Wind that Spans the Sea (ç‹¼ã¨é¦™è¾›æ–™ æµ·ã‚’æ¸¡ã‚‹é¢¨, ÅŒkami to KÅshinryÅ: Umi o Wataru Kaze) is a dating and business simulation game released in Japan on September 17, 2009. The game takes on and improves many elements from its predecessor, My Year With Holo, without being a direct sequel.
Players step into the shoes of seriesâ€™ protagonist Kraft Lawrence on his adventures with Holo. While travelling north to find information about Holoâ€™s hometown, the two are confronted by a massive channel of water which they cannot cross without passing through strict identity checks, impossible for the wolf-eared Holo to complete. Searching for alternative passage, they meet game-original character Luka (ãƒ«ã‚«, Ruka), daughter of a ferryman who is currently missing.
Like the first game, gameplay consists of traveling through various locations, trading goods, and making the right choices in romantic events. There are also various new and improved mechanics, such as the inclusion of contracts with strict deadlines for deliveries and a grid-based inventory system. Also new is the inclusion of a third character to travel with, allowing players the opportunity to decide between deepening their relationship with Holo or another heroine of their choice. Possible companions include Norah, a shepherd; Eve, a merchant whose skills are said to outclass Lawrenceâ€™s; or new character Luka. Completing all four character routes on the same save slot unlocks the â€˜Endless Modeâ€™ which provides a new postgame quest with no time limit.

Game.Name: Ookiku Furikabutte: Honto no Ace ni Nareru kamo
Game.Overview: Honto no Ace ni Nareru Kamo (ãƒ›ãƒ³ãƒˆã®ã‚¨ãƒ¼ã‚¹ã«ãªã‚Œã‚‹ã‹ã‚‚ I Really Can Become A Real Ace) is the Big Windup! Nintendo DS game which was released in December 13, 2007.

Game.Name: Open Season
Game.Overview: Open Season is a video game, based on the movie of the same name. It was released for Wii, PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable, Microsoft Windows, Game Boy Advance, Xbox 360, Xbox, Nintendo DS, and Nintendo GameCube. The Nintendo DS version supports the Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.

Game.Name: Operation: Vietnam
Game.Overview:
Operation Vietnam is a squad based real time strategy game where you control up to four elite soldiers whose helicopter has been shot down right in the middle of the warfare filled jungles of Vietnam. Your mission is the guide them safely out.
The game re-introduces gameplay similar to the old Cannon Fodder games where you roam the levels clearing out enemy camps and finding hidden items and power-ups as you uncover the world map to unlock bonus mission.
You control the characters with the D-Pad. You can give your squad commands such as stop, follow and engage by using the stylus on the touch screen. You can also change the soldier that is in command either from the touch screen menu or cycle through the soldiers with the shoulder buttons. Steer clear from enemy traps and rescue prisoners of war by taking advantage of each soldier's specialty.

Game.Name: Orcs & Elves
Game.Overview: Orcs & Elves' is a turn-based role-playing game, played from a first person perspective. Each individual action by the player counts as a "turn", whether that be movement, using an item or weapon or casting a spell in which other foes will also move and attack in turns following each. Each forward move by the player is done on an invisible grid that makes up each level in order to retain the turn-based element while appearing more like a first person adventure due to its fast paced nature.

Game.Name: Ore ga Omae o Mamoru
Game.Overview: Ore ga Omae o Mamoru is an Action game, developed by Vingt-et-un Systems and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Ore-Sama Kingdom: Koi mo Manga mo Debut o Mezase! Doki Doki Love Lesson
Game.Overview:
"Ore-Sama Kingdom: Koi mo Manga mo Debut o Mezase! Doki Doki Love Lesson is a simulation game where players step into the role of a high school student aspiring to become a manga artist. The game combines elements of romance and creative pursuit, tasking players with balancing their school life, social interactions, and manga creation.
In terms of gameplay, players must manage their time effectively to improve their drawing skills, complete manga projects, and build relationships with various characters. The game features decision-making moments that influence the storyline and character interactions. Players can also participate in mini-games and events that add variety to the gameplay experience.

Game.Name: Orient Quest
Game.Overview: Experience a thrilling puzzle adventure from 1001 Nights and go in search of the legendary treasure cave of the legendary 40 robbers. To unlock their mystery and open the magical gate, you must, with great skill and skill, build rows of three or more stone symbols and thus dissolve the rows. Use the different bonus stones to increase your wealth. Then build impressive structures with your treasures and much more. Orient Quest is a very magical puzzle adventure that will keep you excited again and again.

Game.Name: Original Frisbee Disc Sports: Ultimate & Golf
Game.Overview: You're born. You crawl. You walk. You learn to throw a Frisbee Disc. One of the most genuine and recognizable slices of Americana is this wondrous disc introduced by Wham-O nearly five decades ago. From children's toy to competitive sports gear, Frisbee Disc IS the ultimate American pastime. Now, Frisbee Disc spins onto your Nintendo DS system in this exciting new dual-pack that brings the spirit of Frisbee Disc to your DS.

Game.Name: Original Story from Fairy Tail: Gekitotsu! Kardia Daiseidou
Game.Overview: Fairy Tail Gekitotsu! Kardia Daiseidou is a video game of Fairy Tail for Nintendo DS. It is the second game created on the Nintendo DS, developed by Hudson and it follows the story of the Battle of Fairy Tail arc to the OraciÃ³n Seis arc.

Game.Name: Orion's Odyssey
Game.Overview:
Puzzles using shapesFor all agesFor hours of fun
Orionâ€™s Odyssey is a geometric shape puzzle game. Help Orion the Robot solve Earths problems by using his unique ability to create anything he can imagine with the power of pattern blocks. Save the world one puzzle at a time
This game is the successor to Hands On! Tangrams. Dissection puzzles claim to date back over 4000 years invented by a Chinese god named Tan and brought to Philadelphia, America in 1815 by Captain M Donaldson! Orionâ€™s Odyssey is a Pattern Blocks adventure for all the family.

Game.Name: Orla FrÃ¸snapper
Game.Overview:
The first digital adaption of the popular Danish childrenâ€™s book by Ole Lund Kirkegaard.
The book of Freddy Frogface embodies the strong Nordic tradition of storytelling and the game is based on the animated movie adaptation of the book.
Circus is in town and the players have to collect tickets for it. They move around the map (the town) and visit places such as the cake factory, the windmill and the back garden of the smith.
The game has a multitude of mini games, including:
Shoot Orla out of the cannon and have him make tricks in the air Race with Sausage the dog through the city Make flower in the windmill Race your snail Frog jump competition Solve jigsaw Pick apples without being caught by Orla Dig up earth worms Find 5 flaws Memory game Hidden object game Interactive board game that can be played by 1-4 players where AI players take up any remaining positions.

Game.Name: Oscar der Ballonfahrer: Tierische Abenteuer
Game.Overview: "Oscar of the Ballooners - Animal Adventures" lets the players slip into the role of second animal researchers who have to make an emergency landing on a small island during their journey to a hurricane. Of course, the hot air balloon landed rudely and is damaged. Now it is time to solve tasks and to collect spare parts to leave the island again.

Game.Name: Oscar in Movieland
Game.Overview:
The legendary Oscar in Movieland is now on Nintendo DSiWare!
Following his mega-successful Oscar in Toyland escapades, Oscar now plays the leading actor in sensational worlds of hit movies and TV shows. Enjoy platforming gameplay in worlds that include themes from Sci-fi to Cartoons, Westerns to War, Horror to Jurassic, not to mention the appearance of a zany Game Show host - this is a game not to be missed.
Oscar in Movieland pushes Nintendo DSiWare to new limits with eye-popping graphics, parallax scrolling backgrounds and fabulous gameplay. This platformer is packed with hours of fun and non-stop action.

Game.Name: Oscar in Toyland
Game.Overview: This fabulous jump and run game is easy to play, packed with hours of fun & non-stop action, 100's of collectibles & surprises! In psychedelic Worlds of Candy, Soda Pop, Amusement Park Rides, Board Games, Fantasy Land & more, meeting lots of cool Toys and Animals in hidden rooms and Bonus and Bogus mini games. Use Wings to Fly, Springy Shoes to Jump, and Oscar's secret weapon - his magical Yo-Yo to swing on and zap enemies in some of the craziest platform levels you'll ever play!

Game.Name: Oscar in Toyland 2
Game.Overview: Oscar is back, with more great fun and zany non-stop action set over 7 exciting new Worlds: All Star Sports World, World of Toys, Blox World, Water World, Old Time Toys, Travel Town, and Mech World.Your mission is to swim, fly and run through these Worlds collecting baby Oscars scattered throughout the levels, armed with your secret weapon - a Yo-Yo that you can use to swing from platform to platform and zap those nasty enemies - in some of the craziest platform levels youâ€™ll ever play.

Game.Name: Oscar's World Tour
Game.Overview: Oscar is back, with more great fun and zany non-stop action, set over seven new exciting Worlds: America, The Oceans, Africa, The Islands, Europe, Arctic & Antarctic and The Far East. Your mission is to swim, fly and run through these Worlds collecting baby Oscars that have become scattered throughout the levels, armed with your secret weapon, a yo-yo that you can use to swing from platform to platform and also zap those nasty enemies in some of the craziest platform levels youâ€™ll ever play.

Game.Name: Oshare Majo Love and Berry: DS Collection
Game.Overview:
Oshare Majo Love and Berry ~DS Collection~, also known as Love and Berry: Dress Up and Dance! ~DS Collection~, is the Nintendo DS port of Oshare Majo Love and Berry. It was released on November 22, 2006.
The game was packaged with a white card reader, stickers, and 10 cards. Sega also released a limited version of the game packaged with a pink Love and Berry DS Lite, Oshare Majo Love and Berry ~DS Song Collection~ CD, a pink card reader, stickers, and 60 cards. Some features exclusive to this release are the story mode and the ability to create your own card.

Game.Name: Oshare ni Koi Shite 2 Plus
Game.Overview: Oshare ni Koishite 2 Plus is a Simulation game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2012.

Game.Name: Oshare Princess: Oshare ni Koishite
Game.Overview: Oshare Princess DS: Oshare ni Koishite! is a Simulation game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Oshare Princess: Oshare ni Koishite 2
Game.Overview: Oshare Princess DS: Oshare ni Koi Shite 2 is a Simulation game, developed and published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Oshiri Kajiri Mushi no Rhythm Lesson DS: Kawai Ongaku Kyoushitsu Kanshuu
Game.Overview:
The world has become a cold and distant place, but the Oshiri Kajiri bugs (butt biting bugs) are here to remedy that. They are fairies interested only in making people happy, and once bitten by them, you are invited to sing and dance until you are prepared to live happily ever after.
Follow the cues on screen and tap your stylus accordingly. There are numerous of instruments to choose from, from the tambourine to the piano. Aside from rhythm lessons, take vocal lessons by talking into the microphone of the DS, and learn how to conduct. For those who are fond of classical music, this software contains a hundred full length piano pieces for your enjoyment. It is a game for the whole family, while the children learn to tap their stylus according to the rhythm, the parents lose themselves in the classical music.

Game.Name: Othello de Othello DS
Game.Overview: Othello de Othello DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by MegaHouse, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Otogi Juushi Akazukin
Game.Overview: Otogi Juushi Akazukin is a Puzzle game, developed by Tenky and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Otometeki Koi Kakumei * Love Revo!! DS
Game.Overview:
The main character, Hitomi Sakuragawa, was once a cute, beautiful girl, winning beauty contests in childhood. However, after losing to the temptation of junk food received from fans, she has steadily gained weightâ€¦ until she reached 100 kg in her second year of high school.
At the beginning of the school year, the main character and her brother move into her fatherâ€™s mansion-like dorm. Surprise awaits as she discovers that the schoolâ€™s most popular guys are also moving in. Their impressions on her, shock her into starting a diet.

Game.Name: Otona no DS Mystery: Izumi Jiken File
Game.Overview: Otona no DS Mystery: Idumi Jiken File is an Adventure game, developed by ScriptArts and published by Interchannel, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Otona no Joushikiryoku Training DS
Game.Overview: Otona no Joushikiryoku Training DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by HAL Labs and published by Nintendo, which was released in Japan in 2006.

Game.Name: Otona no Onna Ryoku Kentei
Game.Overview: Otona no Onnaryoku Kentei (Women's Power Test for Adults) is a Nintendo DS game by Konami that aims to teach the knowledge, skills and manners to be an "upstanding woman."

Game.Name: Otona no Renai Shousetsu: Harlequin Selection
Game.Overview: Otona no Renai Shousetsu: Harlequin Selection is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Genius Sonority Inc. and published by Nintendo, which was released in Japan in 2010.

Game.Name: Otona Ryoku Kentei
Game.Overview: Otona Ryoku Kentei is an Action game, developed and published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2007.

Game.Name: Otoshi Deka: Keiji-san, Watashi ga Yarimashita
Game.Overview: Otoshi Keiji (meant to be read as Otoshi Deka) is a detective adventure game spanning four cases. You are Jun Kawashima, a rookie detective nicknamed Aloha. Solving the cases is a tri-step process. First part is the investigation of the case origin. What kind of crime was committed, where it happened, and who was the victim. Second part is processing the crime scene where you have to collect evidence, re-create the crime, and look for suspects with motives. The last step is interrogation. Once you have the suspect and necessary clues, you need to get a confession. During interrogation you have five different character modes you can use to get your confession. Mean, angry, positive, indifferent or sympathetic.

Game.Name: Oui-Oui et le Grand Carnaval des Jouets
Game.Overview: Noddy and the Great Toy Carnival on Nintendo DS is an educational game. A big carnival is going to take place and you will have to help Noddy make it happen. On the menu, several activities: calculation games, memory games, musical games or even puzzles ...

Game.Name: Oui-Oui: Grande FÃªte au Pays des Jouets
Game.Overview: Oui-Oui: Grande FÃªte au Pays des Jouets is a collection of 15 different mini-games starring the character known in English as Noddy. The games audience is primarily aimed at young children from ages of 3 to 7. Games include things such as solving simple math equations, word search puzzles, Hangman, and Snake. The game offers 3 levels of difficulty to choose from.

Game.Name: Ouran Koukou Host-Bu DS
Game.Overview:
Fujioka Haruhi earns a scholarship to attend Ouran Academy; a school reserved for the most rich and prestigious. Despite what other students may think of her, she cares little for physical appearances or the fact that she is a commoner.
Haruhi's regular high school days take a sudden turn when she stumbles upon the Host Club; an elite club filled with super rich and beautiful boys who use their specific traits and charms to entertain young ladies. Even worse, Haruhi accidentally breaks an 8-million yen vase in the club. Since she is unable to repay her debt with money, Haruhi finds herself with no choice but to work for the Host Club, becoming a male host herself.

Game.Name: Our House
Game.Overview:
A companion title to Majescoâ€™s Our House: Party! for Wii, Our House for Nintendo DS is the only home building simulation available that lets players build and furnish the home of their dreams by completing home improvement contracts. Plan, design, build, remodel and decorate client residences, then use your earnings to construct and furnish your own home sweet home!
Features
â€¢ Use the stylus as your ultimate home improvement tool! From replacing flooring to hanging cabinets to removing wallpaper and redecorating, the intuitive Touch Screen lets you design and remodel your personalized trophy home.â€¢ Remodel and earn money using skills learned in more than 100 building mini-games.â€¢ Choose work for hire contracts from the Job Board and Newspaper. Renovate kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms and more for 10 eccentric homeowners with unique tastes in dÃ©cor.â€¢ Swing by Our Showroom to buy appliances, furniture, lighting, and other knickknacks to increase the appeal and value of your home. More than 400 items available for purchase!â€¢ Play against time or quality metrics to earn potential bonuses for completing projects.â€¢ Build the value of your own home by using job earnings to fund personal renovations and then upgrade your residence to five different homes over the course of the gameâ€¢ Keep track of your possessions in Storage

Game.Name: Overlord Minions
Game.Overview: Meet Giblet, Blaze, Stench, and Zap - an elite Minion crew who, assisted by minion master Gnarl, get star billing in Overlord Minions, an irresistible and accessible puzzle action game, designed exclusively for Nintendo DS. In Overlord Minions, the Overlord commands the Minion team remotely. The Nintendo DS stylus becomes an extension of his evil will and every precise Touch Screen command is the player-as-Overlord directing, commanding and combining minions in battle, pointing and sweeping them to attack enemies and solving puzzles to execute his dastardly plans. Controlling the Special Farces team of four, players negotiate fiendish levels and take on a huge range of warped enemies to hunt down the Kindred, a cult dedicated to resurrecting the mighty Dragon Kin, a race of humanoid dragon hybrids, determined to replace the Overlord's despotism with their own. Extending the Overlord series' trademark humour, gameplay focuses on the mischievous physical comedy of the minion's antics and is delivered in a stylised cartoon visual style.

Game.Name: Over the Hedge
Game.Overview:
When a housing development intrudes on their woodland habitat and an opossum is kidnapped by an evil exterminator, three wise-cracking rodents and one very neurotic reptile invade the 'burbs in a quest to rescue their friend. Battle the exterminator and his army of mind-controlled mammals, and save the forest (and your own hide) from the worldâ€™s peskiest critter-man.
Over the Hedge is a 3rd-person perspective stealth-adventure hybrid in which you must navigate through several houses looking to retrieve your current objective while avoiding the many traps set by the homeowners (as well as the homeowners themselves). To get by you can make use of several unique items that allow you to set up diversions, or create them yourself by blowing into the microphone.

Game.Name: Over the Hedge: Hammy Goes Nuts!
Game.Overview: Hammy the squirrel leads RJ the raccoon, Verne the turtle and all-new forest friends on another daring trip into the â€˜burbs. When Hammyâ€™s beloved cable TV goes out, his buddies have to scramble through the neighborhood to restore the signalâ€”and Hammyâ€™s happiness.

Game.Name: Oyako de Asoberu DS Ehon: Ukkari Penelope
Game.Overview: Oyaku de Asoberu DS Ehon: Ukkari Penelope is a Simulation game, developed and published by Tecmo, which was released in Japan in 2008.

Game.Name: Pachi & Slot Hisshoubon DS
Game.Overview: Pachi & Slot Hisshoubon DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2009.

Game.Name: Pac-Man World 3
Game.Overview: The classic gaming character Pac-Man is back for the third iteration of the Pac-Man World series. The game features the classic Pac-Man powers and adds a few new abilities--such as superstomp and electric shock--to assist the yellow-ball-like hero against his ghost foes. You will also be able to take control of two different ghost characters. The game takes place in both 2D and 3D and includes the original Pac-Man arcade game.

Game.Name: Pac 'n Roll
Game.Overview:
Pac-Land has been attacked by the legendary ghost Golvis. With the help of a fairy, Pac-Man must save the world and free his friends. Using the touchscreen, players roll Pac-Man similarly to using a trackball. Guide him through 3D levels collecting pac-dots, avoiding ghosts or eating them with power pellets. There are 2 new power-ups - a feather hat which makes Pac-Man float and heavy armour which allows Pac-Man to go underwater.
As well as the story mode, each level can be played as in time attack and challenge modes. Challenges require the player to finish a level in a different way, such as avoiding all pac-dots.

Game.Name: Pac-Pix
Game.Overview: A mischievous magician, known for playing pranks on poor unsuspecting folks, created something known as "Ghost Ink," a fluid that pretty much turns any drawing into evil and vicious ghost monsters. Any ghost created with the ink ends up just as mischievous as the magician. Ink ghosts have invaded books and paintings, causing trouble within those realms, and now it's up to Pac-Man to wipe out the ghost problem by using the "Ghost Pen," a device that allows him to enter the infested books and paintings to clear out the bad guys. Pac-Pix is a game tailored specifically for the Nintendo DS' system capabilities. By drawing Pac-Man characters in a specific fashion (the mouth first, then the circle, all in one swoop), the drawing will come to life and munch anything in his path. Players can maneuver Pac-Man drawings in different directions by plotting pathways on the screen for the scribble to follow.

Game.Name: Paint By DS
Game.Overview: Paint By DS is a painting simulator developed by New for the Nintendo DS. The game challenges players to recreate classic artworks with the DS stylus. It allows players to recreate pieces from artists such as Van Gogh. Players can mix oil-based and water-based paints. There are 15 different paintings players can manipulate, and one can zoom in to create finer details, and add water to decrease the intensity of colors.

Game.Name: Paint by DS: Classic Masterpieces
Game.Overview: Paint by DS: Classic Masterpieces is a painting game on Nintendo DS. Use your stylus to try to reproduce the greatest masterpieces of the painting. Many tools are available to refine your work: pencil, watercolor, oil painting, eraser, spray ...

Game.Name: Paint by DS: Military Vehicles
Game.Overview: Paint Military Vehicles DS. It was published by Ertain for NDS. You don't control the tanks and planes in this game... you paint them! Using the stylus, add color to a pencil sketch on the bottom screen while viewing a final drawing on the top screen. Then choose from oil paints, colored pencils or water color to put in the final details.

Game.Name: Panda Craze
Game.Overview:
Dig, drill, and blast your way through ice and rock in this epic puzzle adventure!
Guide Tik-Ling the panda through caves, forests, mountains, and deserts on the way to her home, the bamboo forest. The concept is simple: collect all of the magical lanterns in each level to unlock a magic portal to the next level. Actually getting to the lanterns without getting stuck in the process, however, is not so simple! Dig, drill, and blast your way through ice and rock in this epic puzzle adventure!
Features
â€¢ 150 challenging puzzle-platform levels â€¢ New abilities and tools as you progress

Game.Name: Panzer Tactics DS
Game.Overview:
This turn-based WWII strategy game includes three campaigns involving the German Wehrmacht, the Red Army and the Western Allies. Players direct their troops, historically accurate tanks, artillery, naval, and aviation units, to engage enemy units, capture cities, and establish supply lines. Hex-maps cover terrain ranging from the deserts of North Africa to the frozen Russian tundra.
In addition to three single-player campaigns, Panzer Tactics DS also has multiplayer support.

Game.Name: Paper Airplane Chase
Game.Overview:
In Paper Airplane Chase, glide your virtual paper plane through an increasingly tricky slalom course. Take it slow in Endless mode or zip through several Time Attack courses. The two-player Race mode allows friends to race each other using a single Nintendo DSi system.
Fun, pick up & play gameâ€”easy to learn, hard to master Race a friend on a single Nintendo DSi

Game.Name: Party Carnival
Game.Overview: 40 Quick and easy mini games Lots of simple but addictive games for all age groups Multi playable with up to 4 people Choose from various themes and courses including Festival, Japanese and Sports Choose how you play, one game at a time or all 40! Go for the gold medal

Game.Name: Passeport du CE1 au CE2
Game.Overview: Passport: from CE1 to CE2 is an educational title on DS in which the child benefits from 130 exercises divided into 26 sequences and as many days of revision. It is also possible for him to unlock additional content, including some mini-games.

Game.Name: Passeport du CE2 au CM1
Game.Overview: Passport: from CE2 to CM1 is an educational title on DS in which the child benefits from 130 exercises divided into 26 sequences and as many days of revision. It is also possible for him to unlock additional content, including some mini-games.

Game.Name: Passeport du CM1 au CM2
Game.Overview: Passport: from CM1 to CM2 is an educational title on DS in which the child benefits from 130 exercises divided into 26 sequences and as many days of revision. It is also possible for him to unlock additional content, including some mini-games.

Game.Name: Passeport du CM2 a la 6eme
Game.Overview: Passport: from CM2 to 6eme is an educational title on DS in which the child benefits from 130 exercises divided into 26 sequences and as many days of revision. It is also possible for him to unlock additional content, including some mini-games.

Game.Name: Passeport du CP au CE1

Do you best to avoid them, but if you need it, youâ€™re equipped with a powerful hammer that will temporally knock out the inhabitants. Game.Name: Paul's Shooting Adventure

Super Baby Paul, the Ultimate Pacifier, stars in this classic side-scrolling shooter. The player controls Paul, the son of a super hero family who was born with innate super powers. Game.Name: Paws & Claws: Best Friends: Dogs & Cats
Game.Overview: Best Friends â€“ Cats & Dogs: Can this be real? Sure, because this is a pet care game where puppies and kittens can be taken care of and be given a little training as well. If the pet is given optimal food, grooming and heaps of love it will perform well in both agility and beauty competitions. Winning these, the owner will be able to buy even better pet care products for the loved one. Everything â€“ health, looks, mood and performance of the animal â€“ depends on the interaction between player and animal. Detailed and realistic animations of the cute Huskies, Dalmatians, Retrievers, Maine Coons, Siams and European house cats provide extra fun and motivation.

Game.Name: Paws & Claws: Pampered Pets
Game.Overview:
Luxury and extravagance are the way of life at the Paws & Claws Pampered Pets Spa. Let the pampering begin!
Time for TLC! Welcome your clients to your Paws & Claws Pet Spa to style and spoil your pets as you become the star of the industry. Bling! Create custom jeweled collars with the finest of emerald, quartz and topaz stones in your very own Pet Spa Shop. Posh pad! Welcome your VIPets to their very own luxurious themed rooms including the Pretty in Purple, You're a Movie Star, Big Toy, Outer Space, Outdoor Adventure, Ahoy Matey and Ultimate Royalty rooms. Cute as can be! Care for 8 adorable different animals including 6 dogs and 2 cats breeds. Star Treatments! Keep tabs of your client's favorite pampering treatments to be sure they leave with a smile one their face.

Game.Name: Paws & Claws: Pampered Pets 2
Game.Overview: It's the Ultimate Luxury Spa for Pets! Now you can pamper and indulge all of your clients as owner of the Paw2 and Claws Pet Spa - the premier spa for pets who deserve the very best. Spoil your furry friends with world-class treatments. Massage, bathing, grooming, even acupuncture and aromatherapy. Have fun with more of your favorite animals including cats, dogs, bunnies, guinea pigs and hamsters.

Game.Name: Paws & Claws: Pet Resort
Game.Overview: Pamper your four-legged and feathered guests including puppies, kitties, rabbits, budgies and horses at your very own Paws & Claws Pet Resort. Nurture and love the animals to grow your pet care business and become every animalâ€™s best friend!

You Love Animals and They Love You!

â€¢ Nurse all of your injured patients back to health through 20+ casesâ€¢ Choose from 10+ different kinds of animals, from cockatoos and guinea pigs to dogs and horsesâ€¢ Visit the 3D clothing shop and choose from 9 cute outfitsâ€¢ Become the best vet and you'll grow your business into the biggest pet clinic in town!

Game.Overview:
An expanded remake of the first game, Healing Hands once again puts the player into the shoes of a new vet, just starting her practice. Owners will bring their pets in, with various diseases and conditions, and the player needs to diagnose and treat them. You can head into town to replace supplies used in treating your patients, or take care of shopping. Over time, you can buy new buildings for long term care, and take classes to expand the range of animals you can treat.
Healing Hands includes two new animal types, and enhanced touch-screen functionality.

Game.Name: Paws & Claws: Pet Vet: Australian Adventures
Game.Overview:
Get ready for an adventure at your very own Paws & Claws Pet Vet clinic down under! Itâ€™s your job to nurture and love all of the wild animals down under and bring them back to health.
Features

Game.Name: PDC World Championship Darts
Game.Overview: PDC World Championship Darts is a sports video game, published by Oxygen and developed and designed by Rebellion Developments. It was released for the Nintendo DS and Wii on May 29, 2009. The game features eighteen professionals from the Professional Darts Corporation. The game includes a Create-A-Player mode, which for the first time, players can create a female dart player to use in both Career Mode and Exhibition Mode. There is also a practice mode. It is a direct sequel to the previous year's game, PDC World Championship Darts 2008.

Game.Name: Peggle: Dual Shot
Game.Overview:
Peggle: Dual Shot is a Nintendo DS adaptation of the PC action puzzle game Peggle. Players shoot a ball to clear multi-colored pegs and bricks, score points and perform tricks and special moves for extra score. The game features ten Peggle "Masters", each showcasing a unique special power (multi-ball, flippers, guided balls, etc.) that players can activate and use in the various levels. The game draws inspiration from pinball, pachinko and Plinko.
In this DS-specific version, Peggle: Dual Shot features over 120 game boards (including all the levels from the original Peggle and its sequel Peggle Nights), along with 10 new levels designed by Q Entertainment. There is also a dual-screen "Bonus Underground" mode, where players can collect gems and power-ups that unlock the ten new levels. Other game modes are Challenge, with over 90 level-specific challenges to beat, and multiplayer (Duel mode).

Game.Name: Peg Solitaire
Game.Overview:
A classic thinking game, Peg Solitaire is a board game for solo players where you have to move pegs strategically on a cross-shaped board with 33 holes. Some boards use marbles that sit in shallow indentations. In the United Kingdom, this game is known as Solitaire, and the card games are called Patience.
The game has various difficulty levels to allow players learn the gameplay techniques step by step: â€¢ Tutorial levels (9 stages) â€¢ Easy levels (9 stages) â€¢ Normal levels (9 stages) â€¢ Hard levels (9 stages) â€¢ Expert levels (5 stages)

- Connect the stage towns as quickly as possible by participating in frantic minigames that will require you to reflexes and speed.
- At each stage, a new immunity test awaits you, at the end of which a team will be eliminated.

- Live the highlights of the show: as on TV, the events are linked across the world and at each stage, a team is eliminated.

Waddle We Do?! Baby penguins have been stranded on thin ice by the evil (but oddly stylish) Walrus, and it's up to the Penguin Patrol to rescue them!
Encounter several types of penguins, such as the stubborn Bratty Penguin or the sleepy Fatty Penguin, as you trek across over 75 puzzling levels. But watch out! With each step you take, the thin ice behind you breaks. Without careful planning, you could cut off your own escape route!
Featuring a charming pixel art style, delightful music, and thoughtfully designed levels, Penguin Patrol will entice players of all ages.
Features
â€¢ Over 75 puzzling levels â€“ can you earn all the stars? â€¢ Rescue a variety of adorable and unique penguins â€¢ Use the handy Undo feature at any time

Use the sponge and hose to clean away the mud and touch the screen to pop soap bubbles as they appear. Picking Apples - Peppa is helping to collect apples for Mummy Pig's apple pie. George is helping too by collecting the rotten apples for the compost heap. Collect as many as you can and see how high you can throw the apples. Watering Flowers - To grow as many beautiful flowers as possible, water the seeds with the watering can and watch them grow.

Game.Name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
Game.Overview: Based upon the first novel in author Rick Riordan's best-selling book series, Percy Jackson & The Olympians: The Lightning Thief is set in a modern world where the twelve gods of Mount Olympus are alive, Percy Jackson, the teenage son of Poseidon, is suspected by Zeus of stealing his lightning bolt, the universe's most powerful weapon. Percy must prove his innocence, save his mother, and avoid a devastating war among the gods.

Game.Name: Perfect Kanji Keisan Master DS
Game.Overview: Perfect Kanji Keisan Master DS is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Good-Feel and published by Benesse, which was released in Japan in 2011.

Game.Overview: Benefit from a high intensity workout no matter where you're at with Personal Fitness. Choose from pre-defined training schedules or build a unique custom workout as your personal fitness coach leads you through physical training and education. The training schedules tailored towards your fitness goals will help to ensure you reach and maintain your fitness goals. Specialized training schedules such as 'Six-Pack of Steel' is just one example of what awaits you in your journey to good health.

Game.Name: Personal Fitness for Women
Game.Overview: 20 training schedules for players to choose from that appear in both Men and Women version. Womens version contains 30 additional training schedules not found in the Mens version, which focus on female-centric fitness.. Varying calculation of the calorie requirements in the men and women version due to gender related physiology differences. Nutrition plan that includes healthy recipes for all meals of the day..

Game.Name: Personal Trainer: Cooking
Game.Overview: Personal Trainer: Cooking includes more than 200 recipes from around the world and transforms the Nintendo DS into an electronic, interactive cookbook, complete with a glossary of terms and even instructional videos.

Game.Name: Personal Trainer: Math
Game.Overview:
Professor Kageyama's Maths Training: The Hundred Cell Calculation Method (DSé™°å±±ãƒ¡ã‚½ãƒƒãƒ‰ã€Œã¾ã™Ã—ã¾ã™ãƒ—ãƒ¬ç™¾ã¾ã™è¨ˆç®—ã€€ç™¾ã¾ã™ã®å‰ã«ã“ã‚Œã ã‚ˆï¼ã€) (DS Kageyama Method: Masu x Masu Pure Hyaku Masu Keisan - Hyaku Masu no Maeni Kore Dayo!), is a puzzle video game published by Nintendo and developed by Jupiter for the Nintendo DS handheld video game console.It was first released in Japan, and was later released in Europe and Australasia. It was released in North America as Personal Trainer: Math on January 12, 2009. It was also released in South Korea in 2009. The game is part of both the Touch! Generations and Personal Trainer series. The game received mixed reviews, with common criticisms cited for the game's difficulty in recognizing some numbers and for not being very entertaining to play. At GameRankings, it holds an average review score of 65%.
Maths Training, designed to be played daily, uses a method called "The Hundred Cell Calculation Method" that focuses on repetition of basic arithmetic. This method was developed by Professor Kageyama who works at the Centre for Research and Educational Development at Ritsumeikan University, Kyoto. Utilizing a 10 x 10 grid of blank squares lined with rows of numbers along the top and side of the grid, the player has to match up each top number with each side number and add or subtract or multiply them. They then fill in the appropriate square with the appropriate answer.
The game is played by holding the Nintendo DS vertically like a book, and it supports both right- and left-handed users, allowing them to view the exercises on the message screen while they note down their answers with the stylus on the Touch Screen. The user can play against up to 15 other Nintendo DS users by using the DS Download Play option or with multiple game cards.

Game.Name: Personal Trainer: Walking
Game.Overview:
Personal Trainer: Walking, known in PAL regions as Walk with me! Do you know your walking routine? and in Japan as Aruite Wakaru Seikatsu Rhythm DS is an exergaming application developed by Nintendo Network Service Development (Nintendo NSD) and Creatures Inc. for the Nintendo DS. The pedometer accessory was developed in-house at Nintendo NSD, while the software portion was developed in conjunction with Nintendo NSD, Creatures Inc., and Engines.
Personal Trainer: Walking allows up to four users to track their walking, jogging or running activities through a series of graphs, charts and statistics, as well as set goals for themselves. The game is packaged with two infrared pedometers that communicate to the game the user's walking data. Additional pedometers will be sold separately.
The game uses Miis to track each user's progress, and allows users to either create a Mii in-game (A first for the Nintendo DS), or wirelessly transfer an existing Mii from a Wii console's Mii Channel to their Nintendo DS. The game also features a number of minigames to unlock.

Game.Name: PES 2008: Pro Evolution Soccer
Game.Overview:
PES 2008 features a brand new intelligence system, called Teamvision, that adapts and reacts to players own gameplay styles to ensure that the computer controlled opponents are always challenging and forcing the player to think and chance their style of play to avoid being out-thought by the game.
The system learns counter attacks that target your weaknesses and look to exploit any repetitive tactics players use. Defenders react better to danger, closing down the ball and charging at shots and the goalkeepers hold shots that are closer to them as well. Teammates make more intelligent runs into space and the close control has been sharpened to ensure quick and fluid passing and speedy attacks can be built. The next gen versions also feature extensive edit modes so players can completely customise their PES 2008 experience.

Game.Name: Pet Adoption Center
Game.Overview:
Care for and help find new homes for all the animals at Sunflower Pet Adoption Center. Nestled in a large, one-of-a-kind outdoor facility, it's the perfect mix of outdoor and indoor pet accommodations. As the manager of the center, you will take care of a variety of loveable pets, including cats, dogs, bunnies, hamsters, guinea pigs, and even baby horses and deer.
While the game was sold as a Toysâ€œRâ€Us -exclusive, it was sold in other countries as My Pet Shelter & Emily: My Animal Shelter.

Game.Name: Pet Alien: An Intergalactic Puzzlepalooza
Game.Overview: Tommy and his Pet Alien friends have been captured by the Robotix. Fight and puzzle your way around the giant spaceship in 80 levels as you help the alien friends work together to rescue Tommy and return to Earth.

Game.Name: Peter Jackson's King Kong: The Official Game of the Movie
Game.Overview:
Peter Jackson's King Kong: The Official Game of the Movie is an action-adventure video game based on the 2005 film King Kong and created in collaboration between the film's director Peter Jackson and video game designer Michel Ancel.
The game allows players to play as both Jack Driscoll and King Kong. The King Kong segment are played from a third-person perspective, while Driscoll's levels are played from a first-person perspective. De-emphasizes the role of a heads-up display as the developer thought that this can help players to further immerse into the game.
It was released on PC and sixth generation platforms and a Nintendo DS version on November 21, 2005, while it was released on November 22, 2005 on the Xbox 360 as a launch title, as well as a Game Boy Advance version titled Kong: The 8th Wonder of the World, also a PlayStation Portable version was released December 20, 2005. All film cast members reprise their roles. Upon release, the game received a generally positive reception, with critics praising the game's immersive environments. However, the DS version was panned due to the bugs featured in these versions.

Game.Name: Peter Pan's Playground
Game.Overview: Peter Pan's Playground includes a handful of activities for the kids, including a puzzle to unjumble a scene from the story, coloring line drawings with paints from a palette, and identifying differences between two drawings.

Game.Name: Petit Computer
Game.Overview:
A fun and easy-to-use tool for creating your own BASIC programs.
Petit Computer is an easy-to-use programming tool that lets you create everything from music, to images, to your very own original games using an adapted version of the classic BASIC programming language.
Whether you have experience of BASIC, or are a complete novice, you will find that Petit Computer will give you the skills you need to create your own programs. You can select commands and run programs using the Nintendo DS Touch Screen, and you can even share your creations via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection, allowing you to collaborate with other users. You can also create special QR codes containing your programs that other users can scan using their Nintendo DS system camera. Petit Computer is a perfect companion for anyone who has ever wanted to delve deeper into the world of computer programming.

In Pet Pals: Animal Doctor, players will learn the techniques required to diagnose and treat 23 different pets, including a Yorkshire terrier, python, turtle, parakeet, rabbit, Siamese cat and hamster. To do so, players must successfully administer more than 40 Touch Screen tests while interacting with stressed patients and concerned pet owners. Medical cases range from hairballs to infections and broken bones. After the treatment is complete, players can tend to their recovering patients by cleaning their environment, and feeding and playing with them until they're all better.
Use the touch screen to administer 40 tests on animals

Perform perfect treatments to earn trophies

Features

â€¢ Perfect gameplay optimal utilisation of the Nintendo DS features
â€¢ Extensive illustrated sector of knowledge about Australia and its wildlife

The living room is your bunnyz new home. Show them their new toys, teach them how to get around, and even ask them to hop up to join you on the sofa. On Petz World, your petz will be able to travel the world, set out on extraordinary adventures and meet tons of other petz.

Game.Name: Petz Cat: Superstar
Game.Overview: Petz Catz Family (DSiWare Game) first released 1st Oct 2010, published by Ubisoft.

Most of the gameplay of the previous game, which is usual in the series, is kept. Choosing from 10 different cat breeds (plus three exotic ones locked at the beginning), the game tasks consists of care-taking and playing with the cats. The player has to feed, keep clean and cure his/her pet, but also play with it using different toys, make it wear costumes and take photos of the kitten.
But Catz 2 adds a new goal system based on "Ribbonz". Every time a first-time task or a proposed challenge is fulfilled a new ribbon is awarded. This will traduce either on real life cat caring tips and facts or on unlocking of new tasks and items. Other new features of the second Catz game are the Playroom and the thought bubbles, that will tell you what your cat is thinking. The Playroom, on the other hand, is like a training room for cats, that can make your pet improve its strength, agility and intelligence.

Unlock many items. -Unlock more than 75 items of clothing and accessories to dress up your pet.-Unlock new toys that your pets can use when playing with you or with each other.-Unlock new environments such as the beach or a snow field.-Pass the obstacle course at the park and unlock more items.â€¢ Improved, more realistic graphics. -Pets look more realistic than ever.-Watch your pets interact in realistic-looking environments.â€¢ Exchange pets with friends using the Play Date mode. -In Play Date mode, send your pets to your friendâ€™s Nintendo DS and vice versa using DS Wireless Communications.

The dogs in this game don't have names, in fact your dog will just be called a shortening of its breed name (e.g. "Lab"). You live in a large house, but to start with you can only play in the Lounge and Garden. Other puppies will come to play too and you can have a great time with lots of puppy pals!
You can teach your dogs 14 different voice commands so they can let you know what they want.

Game.Overview: Petz, the No. 1 handheld pet-simulation brand in 2009, is introducing a new nurturing experience with an all-new type of pet: fantasy petz! Each fantasy creature has its own personality, surprising reactions and magical powers. Help them grow by caring for them, feeding them, and teaching them. Train them in their new magical powers.

Customize your pets: unlock tons of fun accessories and outfits. SKUs differentiated: discover 20 completely new creatures in each game in an entirely different environments. Collect them all!

Game.Name: Petz Fashion Dogz & Catz
Game.Overview:
Care for Catz and Dogz for the first time in a Petz game â€¢ Pick your favorite breeds from a large variety and dress them up in trendy and fashionable outfits.
Enter your stylish petz in fashion shows â€¢ Start with your local town contest and work your way up to posh designer runways.
Customize your petz looks with designs of your choice â€¢ Design your own unique outfits by styling the coolest new patterns and colors with the DS stylus.

â€¢ Unlock new items for your house with the money earned from your fashion success.

Game.Name: Petz: Hamsterz 2
Game.Overview:
Hamsterz 2 is the sequel to the Nintendo DS title Hamsterz Life, an entry in the DS Petz series.
More than a sequel, this game tuns away from all the strange features of the first one and focuses on pet caring simulation. There is no more chatting with your hamster nor costumes to dress them up. Mini-games are also relegated to a secondary level as they are no more mandatory to advance in the game. Aside from sharing the same name and brand, this title and the earlier game do not have much in common and were created by different development teams, as Hamsterz 2 is a US port of the original Japanese DS title Hamster to Kurasou.
After the player customizes his/her identity and the environment for his avatar, a cousin visits and ask the player to care for one of the children of his hamster. From now on, the usual pet caring simulation starts. Cleaning, feeding and playing with your hamster is rewarded with starts, that serve as the currency in Hamsterz 2. With enough stars, the player can visit the pet store and buy bigger cages and all kind of toys and tools for the pets. Having hamsters of different sexes in the same cage can lead to them having children.
Hamsterz 2 features 12 different hamster breeds plus two unlockable exotic ones. There are also 200 different toys and accessories to unlock and other 34 "treasure" items. A multi-player mode also exists, where friends' cages can be visited and mini-games can be played with them.

Game.Name: Petz Hamsterz: Family
Game.Overview:
Care for hamsterz, teach them fun tricks, and unlock new toys and accessories to give them lots of love! Adopt your very own family of hamsters! Care for them, teach them fun tricks, and unlock new toys and accessories to give them lots of love!

â€¢ Care for your hamsters by feeding them, playing with them, and keeping them clean and warm. â€¢ Discover your hamstersâ€™ unique personalitiesâ€”watch them react to you with cute and funny facial expressions! â€¢ Teach your hamsters fun activities like bowling or running on ramps and watch their progress. â€¢ Earn coins you can spend at the store to unlock new toys and accessories for your loveable hamsters.

Game.Overview:
Horsez 2 is the sequel to the Nintendo DS Horsez, a title part of the Nintendo DS Petz series.
Ginger is now a grown horse trainer that owns a ranch side by side with her grandfather's. She has now the mission to rise and train three different horses.
Most of the gameplay remains the same as in the previous game.

Game.Name: Petz: Horsez Family
Game.Overview: Petz Horsez Family is the ultimate horse nurturing game. Care for a variety of horses at the Summer Camp Stables, bond with them, train them and even compete in fun challenges. Be a proud caretaker of your own horses as you learn how to take care of them and help them become strong and successful horses.

Game.Name: Petz Kittens
Game.Overview:
The cutest newborn kittens are here, and they need someone to care for and love them. Adopt your very own kittens, bond with them, and help them grow into strong and healthy cats.
Choose from a variety of popular cat breeds including Siamese, Maine Coon and Munchkin. Cuddle your cute newborn just like a mum would: give them milk, keep them clean, make sure their temperature is warm enough and give them all the love they deserve. Watch your baby pets evolve and surprise you. Provoke unpredictable behaviours and memorable moments. They have unique reactions and they do lots of unexpected, funny and silly things.

Experience fun adventures together

Choose the color, pattern and design of their hair, saddles, and hoofs.
After progressing through several levels, enter your Ponies in beauty pageants to lead the Grand Pony Parade.
Collect stickers and exchange with friends
Go on beautiful walks and meet lots of animals.
Get stickers for each animal, then collect them and exchange with friends via wireless gameplay.

Game.Name: Petz: Puppyz & Kittenz
Game.Overview:
Care for and bond with puppyz and kittenz - Groom, bathe and feed these precious little animals to help them grow and become friends.

Game.Name: Petz Rescue: Endangered Paradise
Game.Overview:
As a member of the Earth Rescue Team (ERT), your mission is to save the wildlife on a beautiful island that has been threatened by pollution.
Features
â€¢ Heal wild animals. â€¢ Clean wild areas of pollution and recycle the waste you find. â€¢ Prepare the environment and reintroduce vegetative plants for the animals to eat. â€¢ Protect and rescue 12 wild animals: The island is a natural haven with four different environments (forest, taiga, savanna, desert) from a cold forest with bears to a dry savannah with lions. â€¢ Help the local inhabitants develop a greener village: Teach them to adopt eco-friendly friendly habits such as water conservation and recycling. â€¢ Live a great adventure: Team up with the other inhabitants of the island to solve its mystery; work closely with the other members of the ERT to save the island. â€¢ Calculate your carbon footprint: Understand your actual carbon footprint outside of the game.
